tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (hūm̐ dang*/mkhyen brtse'i bka' 'bum ca nang*/)༄༅/ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs bya tshul mthong ba don ldan zhe
(hūm̐ dang*/mkhyen brtse'i bka' 'bum ca nang*/)༄༅/ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs bya tshul mthong ba don ldan zhe

tei:div.tei:p: (hūm̐ dang*/ mkhyen brtse'i bka' 'bum ca nang*/)༄༅// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs bya tshul mthong ba don ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru bud+dha singha ya/ bla ma yi dam dbyer med dang*// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i// byin rlabs ji ltar bya ba'i tshul// cho ga'i rim pa cung zad 'bri// de la 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ bla chen 'phags pas mdzad pa'i byin rlabs kyi yi ge las rtogs par bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis las/ dang po slob dpon gyi bya ba ni/ mchod pa'i yo byad rnams la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor te/ oṃ sum+bha sogs kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a bdun las thod pa'i snod bdun gyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da āḥhūm̐/ rol mo dang ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi sogs gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sogs nas 'od gsal stong pa nyid du gyur par bsam/ ldang ba'i tshe rje btsun ma phyag mtshan med pa'i skur ldang zhes pa'i bar rje btsun rat+na ni ra bho gas mdzad pa'i yig cha ltar bya'o// mdun bskyed bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ bam̐ las chu/ lam̐ las sa/ kam̐ las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba'i steng du pam̐ las pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla bre/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su/

e yig nyis brtsegs las byung ba'i chos 'byung nyis brtsegs khog pa stong pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du pam̐ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bam̐ yig dmar po'i tha mar sogs nas zhes pas bskor te gnas pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sogs nas tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bo/ phaiṃ thugs ka'i sogs nas shud+dho3haṃ/ mchod pa byin rlabs snga ma ltar las shab+da āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī kun la sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da āḥhūm̐/ rol chen dang ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi sogs brjod/ mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i oṃ rū pa sogs nas spar+ṣe kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes sogs phyag rgyar bcas pas mchod/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlab/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo mkhyen pa'i ye shes brtse ba'i thugs rje mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyi mi khyab pa mnga' ba/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seṅge'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ nang mchod gtor/ rdo rje 'chang dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// grub chen nā ro pa dang pham thing pa// shes rab brtsegs dang mal gyo sa skya pa// rje btsun sku mched zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// sa skya paṇa chen 'phags pa rin po che// dkon mchog dpal dang chos rje brag phug pa// bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal ldan tshul khrims dang*// ye shes rgyal mtshan zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// kun dga' bzang po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang*// bsod nams seṅge sangs rgyas rin chen zhabs// lha mchog seṅge dkon mchog lhun grub dang*// bud+dha singha'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// gzhan yang dbang bskur sogs dang*/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sogs nas/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud sogs nas/ ldan par gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pa'i bar ma rgyud spyi dang mthun par bya'o// 'bru gsum gyis bdud rtsi rang gi lce la myong ngo*// na mo chos kyi dbyings sogs nas swā hās yid mchod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dpal ldan rdo rje sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma bsang sbyang sogs nas ha ho hrīḥ oṃ gsum ma'i rjes su oṃ a kā ro sogs nas phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ chos skyong gi gtor ma gtor chog ltar phul/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor bde mchog ltar bya'o// de nas bum pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyangs pa/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i bum pa'i chu'i dbus su rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas sogs nas thim zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar brjod/ mtshan sngags re re sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da rol chen dang bcas pas phyi mchod/ oṃ gsum ma'i rjes su 'bru gsum btags nas/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// zhes pas nang mchod/ dpal ldan sogs kyis bstod/ gzungs thag nas bzung ste/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten nas song bas bum nang gi rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs rgyud bskul nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zag pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ oṃ gsum dang*/ sum+bha dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/

zhes ci rigs bzla/ slar yang mchod bstod gong ltar bya/ 'dod don gsol gdab dang*/ he ru ka'i yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis bum nang gi lha 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur ces brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyi mdun du maṇ+ḍal me tog bum pa dang bcas pa sta gon byas te byin rlabs kyi 'jug pa nas brtsams te spyad du gsol gyi bar slob ma la ji ltar bskur ba bzhin bdag 'jug gi tshul du blang ngo*// gtor ma skabs 'dir phul kyang rung bas gang bde bya chog go /gnyis pa slob ma la bya ba la/ bde mchog lū nag sogs gang rung gi dbang thob pa'i slob ma gcig nas nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar du zung du ma gyur pa nang gshib pa rnams khrus byas nas g.yon skor du gral la 'khod pa la/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkye bsdu grub rjes/ slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du byin rlabs zab mo gsan la don tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la gsan rgyu'i byin rlabs la bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod pa'i nang nas/ 'dir rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la gdams pa rgya mtsho tsam bzhugs pa'i nang tshan/ gtso bor mchog sgrub pa la dmar mo skor gsum dang*/ las rgyas pa la dmar po skor gsum dang gnyis las/ 'dir dmar mo skor gsum gyi phyogs yin/ de la'ang rje btsun nā ro ta pas bde mchog le'u nyi shu rtsa gcig pa la brten nas nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs dang lam gyi cha rkyen la sogs pa mdzad de/ de rnams la nā ro mkha' spyod ces grags so// yang rgyal chen in+d+ra bhū tis rgyud de nyid la brten nas phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i byin rlabs dang*/

sngags btu la sogs pa'i gdams pa dang bcas mdzad pa rnams la in+d+ra mkha' spyod ces yongs su grags pa dang*/ yang grub chen mai tri pas rgyud ral pa gyen brdzes la brten nas rig pa 'dzin pa rtsen ma'i byin rlabs man ngag dang bcas mdzad pa la mai tri mkha' spyod ces grags pa rnams su yod pa las 'dir grub chen nā ro pa'i phyogs la brten pa yin/ de la'ang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga dang*/ bskyed pa'i rim pa nā ro mkha' spyod/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtsa dbu ma/ lam gyi cha rkyen pra sen dbab pa dang*/ laṅka lī ya la brten nas mkha' spyod sgrub pa la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod pa las/ 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs zab mo sgrub par byed pa yin/ de la gang gis sgrub par byed pa'i slob dpon ni/ 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag sogs gang rung gi dkyil 'khor du dbang thob pa/ 'di'i byin rlabs thob cing chag med rgyun du byed pa zhig dgos/ gang la bya ba'i slob ma ni/ dbang thob cing byin rlabs don du gnyer ba dam tshig dang sdom pa srung sdom byed pa'i slob ma zhig la brten par bya ba yin la/ nam bya ba'i dus ni rtsa rgyud las/ tshes bcu la ni de rab mchod// ces gsungs pas gtso bor 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong bar byed pa la mar ngo'i tshes bcu dang*/ mthun rkyen bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gsog par byed pa la yar ngo'i tshes bcu gnyis yod pa las/ da lan yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i skabs su babs pa yin/ de las gzhan pa'i tshes grangs la mi bya ste/ dus tshes ma dag par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// tshul ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga la sngon du 'gro ba slob dpon gyi bya ba dang dngos gzhi slob ma la bya ba gnyis las/ dang po sngon du 'gro ba slob dpon gyi bya ba la/ mchod pa byin rlabs sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa/

mdun bskyed sgrub cing mchod bstod bya ba/ gtor ma 'bul ba/ bum pa sgrub pa/ slob ma la ji tsam bskur ba'i byin rlabs thams cad slob dpon rang nyid kyis bdag 'jug gi tshul du blang dgos pa rnams sngon du legs par grub zin/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi slob ma la bya ba lha dang skal ba mnyam pa'i ched du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa/ zhugs nas byin rlabs dbang bzhi'i tshul du bskur ba rnam pa gnyis yod pa las/ thog mar byin rlabs kyi 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du slob dpon la rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pa'i sgo nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de nas maṇ+ḍal phul nas phyag snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma nas/ 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor mas// bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes gsol ba btab nas/ sngon chad rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa'am/ zhugs kyang bskyar nas 'jug pa'i mtshon byed du ras yug dmar po res gdong dam du bcings pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ zhes gdong bcings nas/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mjal ba'i tshe phyag stong du mjal du mi btub pas u dum+bā ra la sogs pa'i me tog gi phreng ba re byin par mos pa mdzod/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ zhes pas me tog gi phreng ba gtad la dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas khaṇ+ḍa ro hi'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros te/ khyed rang rnams la byin gyis brlab par sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par mos pa mdzod/

sum+bha sogs brjod cing bum chu gtor/ slob dpon gyis bdud rtsi khyed rang rnams kyi ljags thog dang sku la gtor te bsrung ba byas par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing de ltar lus thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang zhing zag med kyi bde bas byin gyis brlabs pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de nas sems bskyed pa'i slad du khyed rang rnams kyi thugs kar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa nya gang ba lta bu skya chil ba re gsal btab la/ de'i steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa gyen du langs pa re byung bar mos te/ bden gnyis dbyer med du sems bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa dā yā mi zhes brjod nas/ slob dpon gyis khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar rdo rje bzhag pa'i sgo nas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ su ra ti sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes pas bden gnyis dbyer med du sems bskyed nas/ gzhan yang 'og nas 'byung ba'i gsang sngags kyi kun spyod thams cad snod dang mi ldan pa rnams kyi mdun du ma smra zhig ces gsang bar gdams pa ni mgo bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ deng khyod rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rigs su zhugs kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no// zhes pas gsang bar gdams nas/ nang 'jug gi slad du slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la 'jus te dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs la me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar nas mgo dud pa dang bcas pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi drung du khrid nas shar du 'khod par mos pa mdzod/

rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar bzhugs par mos pa byas/ de dag gi spyan sngar rang gzhan gyi pha mas thog drangs mkha' mnyam gyis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad kyis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs lan gsum brjod/ ces rgyud dag par byas nas mdor na rigs lnga spyi dang khyad par gyi dam tshig dang sdom pa thams cad tshul bzhin du 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sras bcas sangs rgyas sogs gsum/ zhes pas sdom pa thams cad tshul bzhin du bzung nas/ slar yang de dag gi spyan sngar dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis bzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma// 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can// kun la rtag tu skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo// byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che// khyad par du yang slob dpon la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs dpa' bo// rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad sogs// byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag gis dus 'di nas bzung ste// ji srid gnyis med la gnas par// de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med pa// nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par gzung*// zhes dam tshig bzung ba dang bcas pa ni sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la khyed rang rnams dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bzhugs pa de nyid sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo yin snyam pa'i mos gus byas pa'i rkyen gyis bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas khyed rang rnams kyi lus kyi phyi nang thams cad khyab par gang bas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i nad gdon sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs/

'od zer rnams tshur 'dus te khyed rang rnams kyi lte ba'i nang du e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bam̐ yig sogs nas/ swā hā zhes pa dmar khyil gyis 'khor ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de las 'od zer 'phros snod thams cad la phog pas yongs su dag pa'i gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud kyi sems can la phog pas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ 'od zer de rnams tshur 'dus te khyed rang rnams kyi lte ba'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim par mos pa mdzod/ de yongs su gyur pa las khyed rang rnams rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sogs nas/ tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bo ste go cha rnams kyang ngo bo lha yin pa la rnam pa yig 'bru'i gzugs su gsal lam gyis btab nas/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ slob dpon khyed kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i dngos grub dang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub rnams stsal zhing brtan par mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ mdun bskyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ ye shes thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku mthe bong gi tshad tsam mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul gyis byung ste/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ mgrin pa dang snying ga nas dmar hril gyis song bas lte ba'i nang gi chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi dbus kyi bam̐ yig la thim pas/ de yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku can gsal lam par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/

slob dpon gyis oṃ gsum ma brjod cing ting lo sbyin/ khyed rang rnams dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi lte ba'i chos 'byung gi nang gi rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku bde ba chen pos yongs su gang bas lus kyi gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhir bde ba chen po'i gar stabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgyur bas khyed rang rnams kyi thugs rgyud la bde stong gi ye shes skyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ lte ba'i nang gi chos 'byung gi mdun rgyab gnyis spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon skor du 'khor ba la sems gtad pas bde ba chen po'i ye shes skyes par mos pa mdzod/ slar yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i phyi'i smin mtshams kyi thad kar dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon skor du dmar khyil gyis 'khor ba la sems gtad pas mi rtog pa'i ye shes skyes par mos pa mdzod/ yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig gi mtha' skor gyi sngags kyi phreng ba g.yon skor du 'khor ba dang*/ chos 'byung gi dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon skor du 'khor ba dang*/ phyi'i smin mtshams kyi thad ka'i dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon skor du 'khor ba rnams la dus gcig tu shes pa gtad pas khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud la bde ba dang stong pa gnyis su med pa'i ye shes skyes par mos pa mdzod/ de'i tshe slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer lcags kyu dang zhags pa lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi na bzhugs pa thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku che ba ri rab tsam/ chung ba rdul phran tsam bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te/

khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i gtsug ba spu'i bu ga dbang po'i sgo thams cad nas mar mtsho chen po la kha ba babs pa ltar gnyis su med par thim par mos pa mdzod/ slar yang slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas kyang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams sogs nas/ thim pas lus ngag yid gsum dang dbyer med ro gcig tu byin gyis brlabs pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyis ḍā dril rol mo sogs dang*/ ngag tu oṃ gsum ma brjod/ ces pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ de ltar byin rlabs kyi rgyun brtan par bya ba'i phyir du rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag ste brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes pas brtan par byas nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la me tog dor ba ni 'di na rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa yin te/ rim pa ltar byon nas g.yon pa'i phyag gis me tog de rje btsun ma'i dbu la phul bar mos te/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes gsung zhing me tog dor ba zhu/ de nyid slob dpon gyis blangs te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag ste sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa i maṃ sa twa ma hā bā la oṃ/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ slob dpon gyis oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa hā ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥ zhes pas khyed rang rnams kyi ma rig pa'i ling thog dang mig ras lhan cig tu phyes nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha ngo bstan pa ni/ 'di na rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa yin te 'og gi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor 'di ni kun rdzob brdar btags pa'i dkyil 'khor brda'am mtshan ma tsam yin la/ de'i steng du 'byung bzhi ri rab kyi steng du thod pa dkar po shin tu yangs shing rgya che ba bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i steng du pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje'i sa gzhi/

rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla bre/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su rnam thar sgo gsum gyi rang bzhin chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum nyis brtsegs yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas sogs nas bzhugs pa ste/ mdor na rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gdos bcas kyi rnam pa ma yin par me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar mngon sum lta bur gzigs pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ des 'jug pa'i cho ga grub nas/ dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rnal 'byor ma dpal dbang bskur ba// 'gro ba skyob pa'i gzi brjid can// ji ltar mkha' spyod ma dpal gtso// de bzhin bdag la'ang deng stsol cig /lan gsum/ dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su khru gsum gyi sar/ rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das ma rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku can re rer gsal bar gyur pa'i steng du bla bre/ g.yas su gdugs/ g.yon du rgyal mtshan/ mtha' skor kun tu mchod pa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor te bzhugs par mos pa mdzod/ phaiṃ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang bskur gyi lha 'khor lo bde mchog drug cu rtsa gnyis mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ ces spyan drangs te/ dbang gi lhas mdun gyi nam mkha'i ltos thams cad khyab nas bzhugs par mos pa byas te/ khyed rnams kyi phyogs su bum pa cung zad yo ba dang bcas pas me tog gi char dbab cing bkra shis kyi mnga' gsol bar mos pa mdzod/

bkra shis gang zhig ces sogs sh+lau ka gsum bya/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha'i gtso mo rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang rigs lngas bum pa dkar po ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ dpa' bo rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ dpa' mo rnams kyis glu len/ sgo mtshams ma rnams kyi bgegs bskrad pa dang bcas pa'i sgo nas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyis bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing*/ ngag tu ji ltar bltams pa nas shrī ye hūm̐/ tsakra bī ra s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa mī/ badz+rī bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang thams cad thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rje btsun ma 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po rgyal tshab tu rab tu gnas par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha sogs dang me tog spyi bor bzhag go /des rdo rje slob dpon du dbang bskur ba yin/ sngags kyi bzlas lung gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la rje btsun ma dngos yin snyam pa'i gus 'dud drag po byas pas thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags kyi phreng ba byi ru bstar la brgyus pa ltar bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung*/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi thugs ka nas gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang*/ byin rlabs thams cad sngags kyi phreng ba'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ zhal nas 'thon pa'i sngags phreng dbyer med du gyur pa de nyid khyed rnams rje btsun ma'i sku can du gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs thugs ka'i bam̐ yig gi mtha' nas phar g.yas skor du dmar khyil gyis 'khod par mos pa byas nas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

oṃ oṃ oṃ sogs lan gsum brjod/ de ltar bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par mos te slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul du me tog gtor te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la sogs lan gsum/ khyed rnams kyis me tog gi phreng ba phul ba de nyid slob dpon gyis sngags kyi phreng ba'i rang bzhin du byas te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag ste byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs brjod/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la bcom ldan 'das ma'i gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad 'jug par gyur cig ces sngags kyi rjes su gnang ba yin/ dam bca' ba'i lung gi slad du nyin re bzhin la sngags ji tsam bzla ba'i dam bca' khas len du bcug la/ dus da nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yi dam gyi lhar bzung zhing de'i gsang sngags oṃ gsum ma nyin re bzhin du nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa ma chags par dam bca' snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus da nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yi dam gyi lhar bzung zhing de'i gsang sngags oṃ gsum ma nyi ma re re bzhin nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa ma chags par 'don par dam 'cha' lags so// de rnams brtan pa'i phyir slob dpon gyis g.yon pa'i srin lag gis sin+dhu ra'i rdul tshon blangs te khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du reg pas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub ma lus pa thob par byas pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/

slob dpon gyis ngag tu oṃ gsum ma brjod/ de ltar na bum pa'i dbang bskur ba byin rlabs kyi tshul du thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag lam bskyed pa'i rim pa sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ gsang dbang byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bha ga nas byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ste/ maṇ+ḍal gyi 'og gi thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang 'dres pa de nyid slob dpon gyis blangs te khyed rang rnams kyi lce thog tu bzhag par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ gsum ma dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing*/ zhes byin pa'i bdud rtsi de sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor mos nas myang bas bdud rtsi des lus thams cad la khyab pas rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog rags rim 'gags nas gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skyes par mos nas de'i ngang la cung zad cig mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ de ltar na gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba byin rlabs kyi tshul du thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag lam tsaṇ+ḍa lī'i rnal 'byor sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi g.yon pa'i srin lag gis sin+dhu ra'i rdul tshon blangs te/ khyed rnams kyi dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga lte ba gsang gnas rnams su mas rim gyis reg pas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang bskur gyi lha 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs rnams thabs shes rab snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa de khyed rang rnams rje btsun mar gsal ba'i bha ga'i nang nas zhugs te lus thams cad la khyab pas rim pa bzhin lte bar byon pas dga' ba/

lte ba nas snying gar byon pas mchog dga'/ snying ga nas mgrin par byon pas dga' bral gyi dga' ba/ mgrin pa nas spyi bor byon pas lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i ye shes mngon du byas pa yin snyam du mos par byas te/ lus thams cad la byang chub kyi sems kyis khyab pas nyams myong lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa mdzad nas 'khyud rgya dang bcas pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ de'i don ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rjes su chags pa'i bdag nyid nga yin no zhes pa'i don yin no// de ltar na shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba byin rlabs kyi tshul du thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag lam phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ dbang bzhi pa byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba ni/ slob dpon rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i zhal nas/ dngos po med pa'i chos nyid chos// nam mkha' lta bur dri ma med// stong nyid ye shes rdo rje yi// stong pa nyid du rnam par bsgom// zhes gsungs pa'i don nyams su len par byed pa la/ lus bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan par byas/ ngag rlung rgyu ba sor bzhag sems kyis snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang sems kyi cho 'phrul tsam du thag bcad/ rang lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i phyag rgya la mnyam par sbyar ba dang*/ de'i sems rgyud phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyar ba las byung ba'i 'dzag med kyi bde bas rgyud gang ba de yid yul byas te/ de'i ngo bo la bltas pa'i tshe skye 'gag gnas pa la sogs pa thams cad kyis stong pa nam mkha' lta bu ste/ nam mkha' la skye 'gag med pa bzhin sems la skyes 'gag med/ nam mkha' la 'gro 'ong med pa bzhin sems la 'gro 'ong med/

nam mkha' la rtag chad med pa bzhin sems la rtag chad med/ nam mkha' la mtha' dbus med pa bzhin sems la mtha' dbus med/ nam mkha' la 'dus byas kyi gnod pas mi brdzi ba bzhin sems la glo bur gyi rkyen gyis mi brdzi/ nam mkhas phyi nang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad la khyab pa ltar/ sems kyis 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad la khyab pa ste/ mdor na spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la blo lhod kyis klod nas sems la sems kyis lta ba'i tshul gyis gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngang du cung zad re mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ de ltar dbang bzhi pa byin rlabs kyi tshul gyis thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag lam phyag rgya chen po sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ des dngos gzhi grub nas/ de dag gi gnas skabs su sogs rjes kyi chos gsum gzhan dang 'dra'o// des rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs zab mo gsan pa yin pas do nub nas bzung ste chag med la sogs par brtson pa dang rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/ slob dpon gyis bsod nams 'di yis sogs dang slob ma rnams rang gnas su gtang ngo*// gsum pa rjes chog ni/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyang nas phyi nang gi mchod bstod/ 'dod don gsol btab/ he ru ka'i yig brgya lan gsum brjod pa'i bar bum bskyed ltar ro// ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sogs nas badz+ra muḥ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi ye shes pa dang bum nang gi ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du oṃ bam̐ sogs kyis bsrung ngo*// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sogs bsngo smon/

bkra shis gang zhig sogs kyi bkra shis bya'o// spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor dang chos ldan gyi bya ba sogs la 'jug go /zhes pa 'di ni chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pas mdzad pa'i byin rlabs kyi yig char mi gsal ba rnams kyi gsal byed du bdag gi bla mas phyag len ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul rnams las dang po pa rnams la phan pa'i phyir du mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang dkon mchog lhun grub la sogs pa'i mkhas grub rnams kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa brang ti pa dge slong nam mkha' dpal bzang gis e wam̐ thar pa rtser sbyar ba'o/

slar yang phyi mo la mchan dkyus su shor ba sogs yig nor rgyun 'byams rigs cung zad dag par bgyis shing*/ byin rlabs kyi skabs 'phags pa rin po'i yig char zhal 'phar mdzad pa 'ga' zhig phyogs 'dir zhal 'dris med pa'i las dang po pa la phan par bsams nas dkyus su bris pa dge/ 'dis kyang bstan pa dang sems can la phan par gyur cig/ ༈ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs kyi zur 'debs nyung gsal bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru badz+ra yo gi nī pā dā ya/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs bya tshul mthong ba don ldan gyi zur 'debs cung zad brjod pa la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ tshes bcu rnam pa gnyis gang yang rung ba'i dus khyad par can gyi tshe/ gnas dben par stegs bu'i dbus su maṇ+ḍa lar rdul tshon gyis chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi nang thams cad tshon dmar po/ phyi rol gyi bar thams cad ljang gu/ bcad dkar po/ dbus su zla gdan la tshon phung dmar po bkod pa ni sku tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du mañdzi'i khar thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba dar ram ras dmar pos bkab pa ni gsung bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du me long la sin+dhu ra bkram par/ gser gyi thur ma'am rdo rje'i rtses chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa bzhi/ dbus su bam̐/ de'i mthar mdun nas brtsams te g.yon skor gyis oṃ gsum ma'i sngags kyis bskor ba bris te bshams pa ni thugs sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor ro// de'i mdun sogs gang bder ting lo chung ngu 'bri mog gis kha bsgyur ba dang*/ steng du dar dmar ram lwa dmar lta bu'i gur khang mdzes par phub pa'i mthar shar lhor mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog dang*/ shar du mchod yon sogs chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod g.yon skor/

shar lho nas byang shar gyi bar du gtor ma gnyis sam gsum/ rang gi mdun du nang mchod/ rdo rje dril bu/ ḍā ma ru/ bum pa bcud ldan/ maṇ+ḍal/ nye log ci bde bar sngon 'gro gtor ma/ slob ma la dgos pa'i mig dar/ me tog ting lo sogs nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad thams cad legs par 'du bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ dang po slob dpon gyi bya ba ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma la chab kyis bran/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis ka bstan la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas bskor zhing*/ phaiṃ/ badz+ra ā ral+li hoḥsogs kyis spyan drangs la mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ltar sngags lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing nang mchod srin lag gis gtor la rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar brjod pa'i mthar/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rje btsun rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir du/ sa'i phyogs 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang*/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur bar 'tshal na/ srung ma'i dbang po khyed rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ de nas kyang byang chub ma thob kyi bar du srung zhing dngos grub sgrub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/ ces dang*/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung po gdug pa can gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba de dag sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig

sum+bha sogs brjod cing rdo rje gsor/ dril bu drag tu dkrol la gtor ma phyi rol du dor/ gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad la dmigs te bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+rūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhis mdzes shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ a bdun las thod pa'i snod bdun sogs nas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du rgyun mi chad par gyur/ so so'i sngags rgya sogs dkyus bzhin las/ ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi lan gsum rol mo dang bcas pas byin dbab/ skyabs yul gsal btab la/ bdag dang 'gro ba sogs skyabs sems kyi rjes/ spro na rdor sems he ru ka'i sgom bzlas ma rgyud spyi ltar bya/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar sogs bla ma'i rnal 'byor nas brtsams te bdag bskyed rje btsun dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs ltar nyams su blangs pa'i mthar/ nā da yang mi dmigs pa 'od gsal stong pa nyid du gyur ces pa'i rjes/ slar yang rang skad cig gis rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur ces brjod cing bsams la/ rang gi mdun gyi nang mchod dang*/ gsung bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor gnyis char la dmigs te bsang sbyang rgyas par spro na bde mchog gi nang mchod byin rlabs ltar bya ba'am/ de tsam ma grub na sgrub thabs kyi mjug gi gtor ma ltar byin brlab/ de nas rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod blang*/ dkyil 'khor gsum char la gtor te bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung sogs nas/ yo ga shud+dho3haṃ zhes pa'i bar byin rlabs kyi dkyus ltar/

mchod pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a bdun sogs byin rlabs kyi dbu nas 'byung ba ltar byin brlab/ ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta mi dgos/ de nas mdun bskyed rdo rje rnal 'byor ma de nyid rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang tha mi dad pa'i steng gi char brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ mtha' skor du skyabs yul thams cad kyis bskor ba mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs par bsams la/ de rnams la mchod pa'i bsam pas rgyas par spro na phyi mchod chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod/ gos zung*/ rig ma bcu drug rgyal srid bdun/ 'dod yon lnga rnams tshigs bcad dang sngags spel bas spyi ltar 'bul/ bsdu na nyer spyod dang*/ 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa dkyus su gsal ba ltar gyis 'thus/ nang bdud rtsi'i mchod pa byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang mchod g.yon pa'i srin lag gis thog mar spyi gtsug nas 'thor zhing*/ phyogs bcu dus gsum sogs nas/ rdo rje 'chang rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje 'chang chen sogs nas/ singha'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ nam mkha' dpal bzang bsod nams lhun grub dang*// kun dga' bkra shis shes rab 'byung gnas zhabs// dpal mchog rgyal mtshan dam chos bsam 'grub dang*// sangs rgyas phun tshogs zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// bkra shis lhun grub bstan 'dzin lhun grub dang*// dpal ldan chos skyong rin chen mchog grub zhabs// nam mkha' 'chi med kun dga' bstan 'dzin dang*// 'jam dpal bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// gzhan yang dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag mnos/ chos kyi 'brel ba thob pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ snying ga'i thad nas gtor te rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud de/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

de nas rang gi lce rtse smin mtshams spyi gtsug rnams su thig le byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas lus kyi lha rnams mchod par bsam/ skabs 'dir gtor ma la bar phud bran la lte ba'i thad nas gtor te/ de nas oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang chos 'khor bsrung zhing bstan pa skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dpal mgon dam tshig can rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas/ zhing dang nye ba'i zhing*/ tshan+dho dang nye ba'i tshan+dho/ 'du ba dang nye ba'i 'du ba/ 'thung gcod dang nye ba'i 'thung gcod/ dur khrod dang nye ba'i dur khrod/ yul sum cu rtsa so gnyis/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa sprul pa'i skus 'gro ba sems can gyi don mdzad pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhing skyong bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad/ pho nya gnas las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/ sngags las skyes pa/ las las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang*/ gnas gsum gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ rjed byed/ ma mo/ zhing skyong*/ pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bod khams skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i brtan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag yul bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams dang*/ 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad tshim zhing zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang nas myur du bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal pa dang ldan par gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ rang gis kyang myangs la/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba sogs lan gsum brjod do// dpral bar nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas nas/ na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang*/

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje rnam par dag pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ gsang sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthu dang*/ bdag gi mos pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ smon lam gyi dbang gis 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed yod pa dang*/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig ces brjod cing se gol brdab/ yang phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā warta ya ā warta ya hoḥ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ a bhi sma ra ye/ s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ dharma dhā tu ā ka shā ya sa man+ta māṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta a pa ri sho dhā ya/ maṇ+ḍa le ma ma pra ṇi dhi/ puṇ+ya dz+nyā na ba le na/ sarba ta thā ga ta ba len+ta/ ban+dha swa s+tha na ba le na tsā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod cing se gol lan gnyis brdab pa ni yid byung gi mchod pa'o// bstod pa ni/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra wā rā hi bam̐ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na ma ār+ya a pa rā dzi te trai lo kya mā te ma hā bi d+ye shwa ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo sarba bhū ta bha ya ba he ma hā badz+re huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra ā sa ne a dzi te a pa rā dzi te wa sh+yaṃ ka ri ne tra bh+ra ma ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bi ṣa ni sho ṣa ni ro ṣa ni kro dhi ka rā li nī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo s+t+rā sa ni mā ra ṇi su pra bhai da ni a pa rā dzā ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bi dza ye dzam+bha ni s+t+ram+bha ni mo ha ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra wā rā hī baṃ ma hā yo gi nī kā me shwa ri kha ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces yum gyi rkang brgyad dang*/

dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs sh+lau ka gnyis kyis bstod/ rgyas par spro na/ ye shes chen po'i mdzod 'dzin sogs ngor chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'ang bya/ bsdu na/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs dang*/ bcom ldan 'das mas sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma dkyus su 'dir 'bul bar gsungs kyang bdag 'jug gi rjes su 'bul ba stabs bde bas phyag len la de ltar mdzad/ bum pa dkyus ltar bsgrub/ bdag 'jug ni/ rang gi mdun du maṇ+ḍal dang me tog sogs bsham/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/ shrī ye hūm̐ zhes brjod cing bum chus khrus bya/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi sogs maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma'i mthar/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pa la 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du sogs/ me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te/ gang gi drin gyis sogs nas/ brlab tu gsol/ lan gsum/ ā khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ lan gnyis kyis gdong bcings shing*/ me tog gi phreng ba blang bar mos/ mdun bskyed kyi rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ka nas khro mo khaṇ+ḍa ro hī'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros te rang nyid la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par gyur/ sum+bha sogs brjod cing bum chu gtor/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi myong bas nang khams kyi bar chad thams cad sbyangs shing bde ba chen pos byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ sarba sogs/ snying gar rdo rje bzhag la/ su ra ti sogs kyis bden gnyis dbyer med du sems bskyed cing brtan par mos/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng khyod sogs/ me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs la mgo dud tsam dang bcas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

zhes brjod pas rang nyid sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su 'khod par mos te/ mdun bskyed kyi tshogs zhing rgya mtshos bskor ba'i spyan sngar rgyun bshags/ sdom bzung*/ khyad par gyi dam tshig bzung ba rnams so sor lan gsum re bya/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ rang gi lus kyi phyi nang thams cad la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs sbyangs/ 'od zer rnams tshur 'dus te rang gi lte ba'i nang du e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bam̐ yig sogs nas zhes pas dmar khyil gyis bskor bar gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud kyi sems can thams cad rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ 'od zer rnams tshur 'dus te lte ba'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan zhes sogs nas tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bo zhes brjod nas/ slob dpon khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi dngos grub dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub rnams stsal zhing brtan par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas rje btsun ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo rje btsun ma'i sku mthe bong gi tshad tsam pa mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul gyis byung ste rang gi zhal du zhugs/ mgrin pa dang snying ga nas dmar hril gyis song ba lte ba'i chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi dbus kyi bam̐ yig la thim pa de yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku ru gyur/

des lus kyi gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhir bde ba'i gar stabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgyur ba dang*/ nang gi chos 'byung gi grwa bzhi dang*/ phyi'i smin mtshams kyi thad rnams su dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon phyogs su 'khor ba la sems gtad pas/ de'i tshe phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te rang gi lus la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ oṃ gsum ma brjod cing*/ gu gul gyis bdug rol mo'i sgra sbyar/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram gyi tshul du bzhag cing*/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras brtan par bya/ me tog gi phreng ba rje btsun mar phul ba'i mos pas/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes brjod cing dor ba'i tshul bya/ slar yang spyi bor bzhag par mos te/ oṃ pra tī gṛh+ṇa sogs brjod/ oṃ badz+ra nai tra sogs brjod la mig dar dbye ba'i tshul bya/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum bzhin du mthong bar gyur ces brjod cing bsams pa rnams ni 'jug pa'i chos 'khor dang bcas pa'o// dngos gzhi'i dbang gi slad du/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung gcig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pa la dngos gzhi'i chos rnams sogs/ thal mo sbyar te/ rnal 'byor ma dpal sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du/ rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku can du gsal ba'i steng du bla bre/ g.yas su gdugs/ g.yon du rgyal mtshan/ mtha' skor du mchod pa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ phaiṃ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ rdor dril 'dzin pas me tog gtor zhing*/

bkra shis gang zhig sogs nas/ bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /ces brjod nas/ bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing*/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang thams cad thob/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ dbang gi lhas/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ye swā hās spyi bor me tog bzhag par bsam/ rje btsun ma'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng las sngags kyi phreng ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ste zhal nas 'thon/ rang gi zhal du zhugs sa bon gyi mthar g.yon skor du 'khod par gyur/ oṃ gsum ma lan gsum bzla/ bcom ldan bdag la sogs lan gsum brjod cing me tog gtor/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs lan gsum brjod cing me tog rang gi spyi bor bzhag sin+dhu ra'i rdul tshon gnas gsum du reg pas byin rlabs kyi rgyun brtan par mos te oṃ gsum ma lan gsum brjod/ de ltar na bum pa'i dbang sogs nas/ rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// gsang dbang gi slad du/ mdun gyi rje btsun ma'i mkha' gsang nas byang sems dkar dmar bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ba thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang 'dres pa de nyid rang gi lce thog tu bzhag par bsams la/ oṃ gsum ma dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing bdud rtsi myangs pas rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog rags rim dbyings su dgag pa'i gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes par mos/ de ltar na gsang ba'i dbang sogs nas/ bzhag pa yin no// shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi slad du/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor nas blangs pa'i rdul tshon gyis rang gi gnas bzhir reg pas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang sems dkar dmar dpag tu med pa byung*/

rang rje btsun mar gsal ba'i mkha' gsang nas zhugs te/ gnas bzhir drangs pas dga' bzhi'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par mos te 'khyud rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ sarba sogs brjod/ de ltar na shes rab ye shes kyi sogs nas/ bzhag pa yin no// dbang bzhi pa'i slad du/ mdun gyi rje btsun mas gsungs par bsams la/ dngos po med pa'i nas/ bsgom zhes brjod cing de'i don bde stong nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang du cung zad re mnyam par bzhag de ltar na dbang bzhi pa sogs nas/ bzhag pa yin no// gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi nas/ dbang yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag tu dbul bar sogs dang*/ deng nas brtsams te sogs brjod/ gtor ma bsang sbyang byin brlabs la/ sgrub thabs ltar 'bul zhing 'dod don gsol/ gtor ma gnyis pa chos skyong gi gtor bsngo rgyas bsdus gang rigs dang*/ gsum pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi cho gas 'bul/ bsdu na chos srung la logs su ma phul kyang rung*/ de nas slob ma la bya ba'i rim pa ni byin rlabs kyi dkyus su gsal ba ltar ma 'khrul bar bgyis pas grub/ gsum pa rjes ni/ byin rlabs kyi cho ga'i dkyus ltar la/ bkra shis ni tshigs bcad kyi mtshams su dril bu gsil zhing me tog 'thor ba dang bcas/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung ba// he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku// shes rab phag mo'i pad+mar rdo rje rol mdzad pa'i// bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /he ru ka dpal 'bar ba'i sku mnga' ba// ha ha'i gad rgyangs sa gsum g.yo bar byed// hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa bdud kyi klad 'gems pa'i// bde mchog 'khor lo'i bkra shis deng 'dir stsol// e wam̐ mnyam par sbyor ba sngags kyi sku// ā li kā li gnyis med rol pa'i gsung*// oṃ gyi ngo bor son pa'i thugs mnga' ba// rdo rje phag mo'i bkra shis deng 'dir stsol// zhes dang*/

gzhan yang shis brjod ji ltar rigs pas bde legs su bya zhing*/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bsdu'o// skabs gzhan tu sgrub mchod rgyas par bya bar 'dod na'ang cho ga'i 'gros spyir gong ltar la/ mchod phreng dang*/ bstod pa sogs kha 'phangs su byas pa rnams sbyar ba tsam gyis legs par grub pa yin no// tshogs kyi mchod pa mdor bsdus byed na/ tshogs bsags par 'dod na yar ngo'i tshes bcu dang*/ sgrib pa sbyong ba la mar ngo'i tshes bcur/ sbyor ba'i skabs gzhan 'dra ba la/ dkyil 'khor gyi nye logs gang bder ma dā na

chang dang*/ sha bā la gtso bor gyur pa'i bza' bca' btung ba'i yo byad ci 'byor pa gtsang zhing bkod pas mdzes par bshams/ dngos gzhi bdag 'jug gtor bsngo yan legs par grub nas/ tshogs kyi yo byad rnams la nang mchod chu chang gis sbyang*/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor/ bsang sbyang byin rlabs gtor ma ltar bya zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang ha hoḥhrīḥlan mang du brjod pas bdud rtsir bsgyur ba'i dmigs pa nan tan tu bya/ de nas phud snod gtsang mar blugs la dkyil 'khor gyi mdun tu bzhag gtor ma rnams la'ang phul/ slar yang bdud rtsis bran/ gang gi drin gyis sogs bla ma la phyag 'tshal ba sngon tu 'gro bas/ oṃ gsum ma'i sngags kyi mthar a kā ro btags pa lan gsum mam lngas yi dam dang*/ chos skyong la so so'i gtor sngags sam/ bsdu na/ oṃ shrī badz+ra dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro sogs lan gsum dang*/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi sngags kyis phul/ tshogs pa yod na zhu 'bul spyi ltar dang bcas bza' btung gi tshogs rnams rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi mdun du bstar/ spro na ma dā na bdud rtsir bsam pa'i phud/ rdo rje 'chang chen sogs kyis nang mchod kyi skabs ltar 'bul/ gang ltar yang snying ga'i bam̐ yig sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor mchod par bsams la/ a ho ma hā su kha zhes brjod cing lag g.yon pas blangs te zhen pa med par longs spyad/ lhag ma rnams bsdus la lag pa 'bar ba'i phyag rgya byas pa'i bar nas/ phaiṃ/ zhes brjod pa dang bstun/ ma dā na'i kha phru gdab/ slar yang nang mchod chu chang gis bran/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlab/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi u ts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba lin+ta bhak+ṣa sī swā hā/ zhen lan gsum mam bdun gyis byin pas 'byung po thams cad tshims par bsams la/ mtshan mo yin na dpal 'bar dang bcas lam gyi bzhi mdor dor/

shes na brtag gnyis las 'byung ba'i kol+la i ret+ṭha sogs kyi rdo rje'i glu'am/ bde mchog las gsungs pa'i dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu blang*/ gang ltar yang rol mo'i sgra dang bcas/ bkra shis gang zhig sogs kyi mthar/ 'chi tshe mgon dang sogs smon lam gang shes gdab/ de nas rjes chog dkyus ltar bya'o// sbyin sreg gi cho ga ni paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gi gsung rab ltar la/ sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i slad du mar me'i sbyin sreg byed par 'dod na/ kong bu yangs par ras dmar gyi ldong bu sbom po btsugs/ mar dkar gyi khu bas dgang*/ de'i mdun tu 'byor na zlum gtor gcig dang*/ mchod pa lnga bsham/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa bya ba'am/ thun mtshams kyi lha rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dran pa tsam gyis kyang rung ste/ gang ltar yang mar me sbar la/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bam̐ yig dmar po yongs su gyur pa las skad cig gis rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sogs nas/ tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bo/ phaiṃ/ thugs ka'i nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mdun bskyed la gnyis su med par thim zhes pa'i bar gyis gsal gdab/ de nas mdun du bsreg rdzas til nag po bzhag la/ bdag gis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sna sgo nas sdig pa ra can gyi rnam pas thon te mdun gyi til la thim/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir bsgyur ba de nyid rje btsun ma'i zhal du phul bas sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs par bsams la mtheb srin gyis blangs te/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba pā paṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes sam/ oṃ gsum ma'i mthar/ sarba pā paṃ sogs btags pa gang yang rung bas mar me ma zad bar du phul/ mar me zad par brtsams pa na mchod gtor yod na oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ sogs kyis phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/

dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma bsang sbyang byin rlabs sgrub thabs ltar phul/ gang ltar yang*/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyi mthar/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ badz+ra muḥs ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ bsngo smon shis brjod dkyus ltar byas la/ mar me'i ro ma chu bo chen po'am gtsang sar dor ro// 'di ni sdig sgrib thams cad 'dag pa dang*/ rje btsun ma'i byin rlabs 'jug pa'i thabs khyad par can yin par gsungs so// gzhan yang lam gyi cha rkyen pra sen dbab pa sogs las tshogs phra mo rnams ni deng sang lag len du 'debs mkhan nyung bas 'dir ma bris te/ rtogs par 'dod na yig rnying sogs las shes par bya'o// zhes mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug thar rtse paṇ+ḍi ta chen po nam mkha' dpal bzang gi gsung byin rlabs kyi cho ga'i zhabs tog tu dmigs te/ 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung rab dang*/ mkhan chen bkra shis lhun grub kyi zur 'debs sogs kyi dgongs pa ji lta bar mdor bsdus snying por dril ba'i tshul gyis bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos sbyar ba'i dge bas bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang mchog la myur du reg pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba dā ka l+yā naṃ bha ban tu// ༈ /bum sgrub shin tu bsdus par 'dod na/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan steng du// bh+rūṃ las rin chen bum pa mtshan nyid rdzogs// nang bcud bdud rtsis yongs su gang ba'i dbus// e yig dmar po nyis brtsegs yongs gyur las// chos 'byung dbus su zla dkyil bam̐ yig mthar// sngags phreng g.yon 'khor zer gyis don gnyis bsgrubs// tshur 'dus yongs gyur skad cig dran rdzogs su// sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng*// rnam snang rigs kyi bdag po dang bcas pa// rnal 'byor ma dpal sogs/

rang gi thugs nas sngags kyi phreng ba ni// gzungs thag las 'khril bum lha'i sku la phog /ba spu'i bu ga kun nas ye shes kyi// bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs bum pa gang bar gyur// oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā// ༈ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bskyed rdzogs mdor bsdus pa mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i gsang lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor mar// btud nas de yi rim gnyis tshul// mdor bsdus mkha' spyod rdo rje'i grong*// bgrod pa'i gsang lam 'dir gsal bya// de la 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dang*/ 'di nyid kyi byin rlabs nyams khrid dang bcas pa legs par thob cing*/ dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa'i gang zag gis nyams su blang bya'i lam ni/ bskyed pa'i rim pa phag mo mkha' spyod/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtsa dbu ma/ lam gyi yan lag pra sen dbab pa/ sman chen mo bcud len/ gnod sbyin mo dbang du bya ba rnams su bshad pa las/ dang po ni/ rje sa skya pa chen po'i zhal nas/ nyal dang ldang dang bdud rtsi myang*// tshad med bla ma bdag lhar bskyed// 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*// dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis rlabs// ngag bzlas yid bzlas gnyis gcig yin// bsam mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor dang*// spyod lam gyi ni rnal 'byor te// de ltar rnal 'byor bcu gcig go /zhes gsungs pa 'dir 'du ba las/ dang po nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ nub mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor gyis 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du nyal ba'am/ stong nyid de'i ngang las thun mtshams kyi lhar ldang ste/ gnas khang chos 'byung dmar po 'od kyi rang bzhin can gyi nang du/ rang nyid seṅge'i khri la 'khod pa'i sngas mgor seng khri pad zla'i steng du/

rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje chos kyi rnam par bzhugs pa la mos gus dung nge ba dang*/ lha yi gsal snang ma bral ba'i ngang nas gnyid log gnyis pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ tho rangs nam gyi brgyad cha tsam lon pa na/ nam mkha' nas mkha' spyod kyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor mas ḍā ma ru'i sgra oṃ gsum ma'i gdangs su bsgrags pas bskul te/ 'od gsal stong nyid de'i ngang las chu las nya 'phar ba ltar thun mtshams kyi lhar ldang ba'am/ nyal lugs phyi ma ltar na/ rang dang bla ma gnas khang sogs cir snang thams cad lha dang gzhal yas khang du gsal bzhin pa'i ngang nas ldang la/ sngas mgo'i bla ma la mos gus byas pas 'od du zhu ste rang la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlab par bsam mo// gsum pa bdud rtsi myong ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ bdud rtsi ril bu dngos su 'byor na dang*/ ma 'byor na byin gyis brlab pa'i nang mchod srin lag gis blangs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis myong bas snying ga'i bam̐ yig sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor mchod par bsam/ bzhi pa tshad med pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ thog mar tha mal gyi snang ba thams cad dbyings su thim pa las gnas yul dag pa'i zhing khams chen por gsal ba'i ngang*/ rang gi smin mtshams kyi thad khru gang tsam gyis mtho ba'i nam mkhar seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje chos/ sku mdog dmar po rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan cing*/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs sangs rgyas/ yon tan nor lha/ phrin las mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gsal btab/ de'i mdun du rang nyid/ rang gi g.yas g.yon du pha ma/ mdun du gnod byed/ mthar skor kun tu rigs drug gi sems can thams cad 'khod de/ 'dun pa phyogs gcig pas skyabs su 'gro bar mos la/ nges 'byung dang snying rje chen po'i shugs drag tu bskyed bzhin pa'i ngang*/

bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes ci nus dang*/ mthar/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ gdan seng khri nas yar 'od du zhu/ dbu'i gtsug tor nas mar 'od du zhu ste/ thugs ka'i thad du 'od dmar po'i rnam par gyur pa rang gi smin mtshams nas thim pas/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang*/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med du gyur par bsam la rig pa 'dzin med kyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag de nas tshad med dngos ni/ bdag gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byas la/ sems can thams cad srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral bar bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes pa'i don dran bzhin pas lan gsum brjod/ spro zhing nus na rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas kyang stobs bzhi tshang ba'i dmigs gnad dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas ma rgyud spyi ltar bya/ lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor la/ thun mong ba ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad zla'i gdan la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dpa' bo rdo rje chos sku mdog dmar po/ phyag g.yas ḍā ma ru dang*/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba dang*/ gru mo g.yon na kha ṭ+wām̐ ga bsnams pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing*/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ lang tsho dar la bab pa'i rnam pa can/ skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur par bsam la mos gus drag pos/

gang gi drin gyis sogs dang*/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te// bla ma dpal ldan he ru kar// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsol ba btab pas 'od dmar po bde ba chen po'i rnam pas rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig la thim pas/ de nyid je cher song ste thar nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur par bsam la/ gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngang du ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag yang na man ngag thob pas thun mong ma yin pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su blangs te/ de'i tshul ni gzhan du shes par bya'o// drug pa bdag gi gzhi sbyangs bsgyur gyis lhar bskyed pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ de'i ngang las/ rang gi snying gar e e las chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐ yig dmar po'i mthar/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags phreng g.yon skor du gnas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ lus kyi phyi nang thams cad gang bas sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag ste lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi gzhal yas khang gi dbus su sna tshogs pad nyi'i gdan la/ rang nyid rnam snang rigs bdag dang bcas pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma brdzis shing*/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo rgyab tu bltab pa'i gdong mnan pa sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dag pa mkha' spyod du gzigs pa/ g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyang zhing*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang*/

dril bu dang*/ 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang bzhin pa bsnams pa/ bde stong gi nyams mchog tu rgyas shing*/ dbu skra nag po sil bur grol pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag rgya spyi bor rus pa'i 'khor lo/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ gdu bu/ ske rags rnams so// lngas brgyan cing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gsal btab/ bdun pa gzhan gyi gzhi sbyang bsgyur 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ rigs drug gi brtan g.yo thams cad la phog pas/ ma dag pa'i snang ba sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs te/ snod gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur par bsam/ brgyad pa dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlabs te dam ye dbyer med du bya ba ni/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar g.yon du lan gsum bskor zhing*/ phaiṃ/ rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*/ 'gro ba rnal 'byor mar gyur pa thams cad kyang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs rang nyid la gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ skabs 'dir man ngag thob pa yin na lus dkyil gsal btab pa ni/ de'i rkyen gyis snying ga'i bam̐ yig 'od du zhu ba las dbus su bam̐ yig gi ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mo/ shar nas brtsams te g.yon skor gyi bam̐ yig gi cha shas ya ra la wa bzhi'i ngo bo snying po'i rnal 'byor ma dkar ljang dmar ser bzhi dang*/ mtha' skor sngags kyi yig 'bru so gnyis kyang re re nas/ yul nyer bzhi'i rnal 'byor ma dang*/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi ngo bo rnal 'byor ma dmar mo re re ste thams cad kyang rgyan cha lugs phyi'i rnal 'byor ma ji lta ba bzhin gsal bar gyur par bsam mo// gang ltar yang*/

mthar pad skor 'khyud rgya dang bcas/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i bde chen gyi ye shes su bdag nyid rnam par dag la/ de bzhin du chos thams cad kyang rnam par dag go snyam du nga rgyal bzung zhing rig pa 'dzin med du bzhag de nas go cha bcings pa ni/ rang gi lus kyi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmong byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bor gyur/ ces brjod cing*/ de yang gnas so sor zla dkyil la rgyab yol gyi tshul du byas pa'i ngo bo lha la rnam pa yi ge'i gzugs su

'di la bzhed tshul 'dra min gzhan yang snang ngo*// mchan/ sbreng tshar du gsal btab/ dgu pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor la gnyis te/ dang po mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i lam gyi gtso bo ngag bzlas ni/ lus dkyil gsal gdab na/ lus dkyil gyi gtso mo'i thugs kar chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po nyis brtsegs kyi nang du zla dkyil bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa gsal ba dang*/ ma btab na sngar gsal bzhin pa'i sngags phreng la yid gtad pas/ de las 'od zer dmar po dpag tu med pa 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' pho nya gsum gyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub thams cad 'od dmar po'i rnam pas sngags phreng la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsam la/ yid gzhan du ma yengs par byin gyis brlab pa'i phreng ba bzung ste oṃ gsum ma dam bcas pa'i grangs las mi nyung bar bzlas/ gnyis pa spros bcas kyi rdzogs rim yid bzlas ni/ lus gnad dang bcas rlung ro bsal/ 'og rlung cung zad 'then/ steng rlung chil gyis mnan pa dang mnyam du mchil ma sgra med zhig mid pas snying ga'i chos 'byung zla ba lus dkyil bcas/ bde ba bskyed par 'dod na gsang gnas dang*/ mi rtog pa bskyed par 'dod na lte bar phabs la rlung kha sbyor du 'dzin pa dang lhan cig yid kyis lus dkyil gyi lha rnams yig 'bru'i gzugs su bsgyur/ ya ra la wa bzhi bam̐ yig la thim par bsam la/ sngags phreng yid kyis klog pa'i tshul dang bcas rlung bum can ci thub 'dzin/ mthar bzlas pa bsdu ba ni/ phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bcug la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

zhes brjod cing phreng ba mgo thog tu bzhag zhar byung gi rdzogs rim gnyis bsgom par 'dod na/ dang po ni/ chos 'byung gi mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' 'khyil dmar po g.yon du shugs drag tu 'khor ba la sems gtad pas bde ba'i ye shes skyes par bsam la rlung kha sbyar du 'dzin/ gnyis pa ni/ chos 'byung sngags phreng sogs re zhig mi dmigs pa'i ngang*/ lus kyi dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ yar sna spyi bo nas smin mtshams su gug pa/ mar sna gsang gnas kyi pad+mar zug pa'i nang du dga' 'khyil dmar po dang*/ smin mtshams su dga' 'khyil dkar po chung ngu g.yon skor shugs drag tu 'khor ba la sems gtad pas/ mas yar nas rim gyis byung ste bde ba dang*/ stong pa'i ye shes skyes/ mthar snying gar 'dres te dbu ma'i stong pa'i ngang du mi dmigs par bsams la 'dzin med du bzhag go /de nas bskyed rim la rim gyis bslab pa'i tshe/ nga rgyal la sems 'dzin pa/ rnam pa spyi la sems 'dzin pa/ bye brag rgyan med dang*/ rgyan can la sems 'dzin pa/ lus dkyil la sems 'dzin pa rnams reg mthong gi mtshan ma brtan po ma skyes kyi bar du bsgom zhing*/ de thams cad 'dzin med kyi lta ba dang zung 'brel du nyams su blang ngo*// bcu pa bsam mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor la/ thun mong ba ni/ rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros pas/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu ste/ gzugs med khams 'od sngon po'i rnam pas lus kyi stod kyi cha la thim/ gzugs khams 'od dmar po'i rnam pas lus kyi bar gyi cha la thim/ 'dod khams 'od dkar po'i rnam pas lus kyi smad kyi cha la thim/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba snying ga'i chos 'byung la thim/ de zla ba la thim/ de sngags phreng la thim/ de bam̐ yig la thim/ bam̐ yig gi khog pa mgo bo la thim/ mgo bo zla tshes la thim/

zla tshes thig le la thim/ thig le nā da la thim/ nā da yang mi dmigs pa 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du gyur par bsam la mnyam par bzhag pa'am/ man ngag thob pa yin na bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa bsgom ste/ de'i tshul ni gzhan du shes par bya'o// bcu gcig pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la dngos dang*/ yan lag gnyis las dang po ni/ rtog pa nam 'phro ba na/ slar yang rang skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rgyan dang phyag mtshan spangs pa'i skur gyur pa'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du sogs/ go cha bkod pas bdag dang rnal 'byor srung*/ gnas srung ba'i slad/ lag pa g.yon pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis se gol phyogs g.yon skor dang*/ mtshams g.yas skor du brdab cing sngags brjod pa ni/ oṃ sum+bha ni sogs brjod cing*/ shar dang steng du khwa gdong ma sngon mo/ de bzhin du/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa sogs brjod cing*/ byang du 'ug gdong ma ljang gu/ oṃ gṛh+ṇā pa ya sogs brjod cing nub dang 'og tu khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ oṃ ā na ya sogs brjod cing*/ lhor phag gdong ma ser mo rnams grub par bsam/ yang*/ oṃ sum+bha sogs tshar gcig gis/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms pa ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba rnams grub par bsam/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma dang po gnyis ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'og ma gnyis gri thod thogs pa/ spyan gsum ma/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gis stabs kyis bzhugs par gsal btab/ slar yang thun mong du oṃ sum+bha ni/ tshar gcig brjod pas/ de rnams la de 'dra ba'i sku grangs med pa dang*/ rdo rje'i gur/

mda'i drwa ba/ ye shes kyi me dpung gi phreng ba dpag tu med pa spros te bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ dpag tshad brgya yi tshad tsam tshun chad du srung ba'i gur khang gsal zhing brtan par bsam nas/ dge ba 'di yis sogs bsngo smon bya/ spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe snang ba thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i sku/ sgra grags pa thams cad oṃ gsum ma'i gdangs/ yid kyi dran rtog gang shar thams cad gsal stong 'dzin med du 'jog pa ste sku gsung thugs kyi dga' ba gsum dang ma bral bar lam du khyer nas tha mal gyi snang zhen spang*/ gnyis pa yan lag la/ kha zas/ phyi rol mchod pa/ sbyin sreg tshes bcu'i mchod pa/ gtor ma'i rnal 'byor dang lnga las/ dang po ni/ rgyas par byed na/ bza' btung rnams mdun du bdar la/ sum+bhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rlung me dang*// thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum gyi khar// a yig las byung ka pā lar// bza' bca' btung ba'i dngos po kun// sha lnga bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga// bskol zhing 'od du zhu ba las// dam tshig ye shes dbyer med pa'i// bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i// snying gar bla ma yi dam dang*// lte bar chos srung nor lha'i tshogs// gtum mo'i me lce'i klong na bzhugs// lag gnyis rdo rje'i dgang blugs kyis// kha zas ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun// phul bas zag med bde ba ches// dgyes shing byin gyis brlab par gyur// ces brjod cing bsams la/ zhen pa med par longs spyad/ de tsam mi nus na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥs byin gyis brlabs la snying ga'i bam̐ yig sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor mchod par mos pa'am/ bsdu na/ lha la lha thim pa'i tshul gyis rol/ gnyis pa ni/ tshar chen rin po che'i sgrub dkyil dang*/ gnas gsar rjes nag 'gros su mdzad pa sogs las rtogs par bya/

gsum pa la/ sbyin sreg dngos dang*/ mar me'i sbyin sreg gnyis las/ dang po la'ang rgyas pa dang*/ mdor bsdus te bya ba'i tshul gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyi gsung gnas gsar rin po che'i nag 'gros su mdzad pa dang*/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang sogs kyis mdzad pa'i yig cha khungs thub las shes par bya la/ gnyis pa mdor bsdus pa ni/ sngags kyi nus pa dbyung ba dang sdig sgrib zhi ba sogs kyi slad du/ rgyun gyi dus sam ji ltar rigs pa'i dus su/ rje sa skya pa chen pos/ spros pa la mi dga' na/ rje btsun ma nyid mchod pa nas bzung te lha mnyes pa nyid kyis cho ga ma tshang ba med pa yin no// zhes gsungs pa'i don kun mkhyen rin po che bsod nams seṅges ji ltar bkral ba bzhin brjod na/ thab stegs kyi ngos re khā zlum po gnyis skor gyi nang du chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi thig gdab/ chos 'byung gi ri mo rdul tshon dkar pos bcad/ nang thams cad rdul tshon dmar pos bkang*/ mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' 'khyil g.yon skor dang*/ dbus su nyi gdan la tshom bu dmar po bkod/ rang gi g.yon thab kyi g.yas su mchod pa lnga dang gtor ma/ rang gi g.yas thab kyi g.yon du mar khu dang*/ bsreg rdzas til nag po 'ba' zhig bshams/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ thab dang yo byad rnams/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i thab khung yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bud shing brtsegs pa dang bcas pa dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ hūm̐/ zhes yang yang brjod/ mchod rdzas dang bsregs rdzas rnams kyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba'i mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa so so'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis brlab/ de nas/ oṃ gsum ma'i rjes su/

oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes pas me sbar/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las me 'bar ba'i dbus su chos 'byung gi nang du pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bam̐ yig dmar po'i mthar g.yon skor gyis/ oṃ oṃ oṃ nas/ swā hā zhes pa'i sngags phreng kha dog dmar pos bskor ba de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yig 'bru rnams la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyang pas sogs nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i steng 'og phyogs mtshams mtha' skor kun tu bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis bskor bar gsal btab/ ye shes pa gzhug go cha bkod/ dbang bskur/ rgyas gdab/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis phyi mchod/ oṃ gsum ma'i mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags pas nang mchod phul/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs kyis bstod/ rang gzhan gyi sdig sgrib thams cad til la bstim zhing de nyid ye shes kyi bdud rtsir bsgyur te/ thog mar oṃ gsum ma'i rjes su/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa gsang sngags kyi lhag chad la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ lan gsum sogs kyi rjes/ oṃ gsum ma 'ba' zhig gis phul la grangs bzung*/ de'i tshe nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems sku mdog dkar po phyag na bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba thogs pa rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur bas sdig sgrib thams cad dag lus ye shes kyi bdud rtsis khengs te rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang thob/ mdun bskyed las kyang 'od zer dkar po 'phros pas bdag gzhan thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs par bsam/

skabs skabs su mar gyis me gso/ mthar gong bzhin mchod cing bstod la gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma dang po rje btsun ma dang*/ gnyis pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ltar phul/ rje btsun ma'i zhabs drung nas blangs par mos pas 'di ye shes pa gshegs pa'i rjes su byas kyang rung*/ thabs kyi thal ba cung zad blangs te gnas gsum du byugs/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyi sogs kyis mthar/ badz+ra muḥs thab kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dam tshig pa rang la thim/ rang gi gnas rnams su sogs go cha bkod/ bsrung ba bya/ bsngo smon bkra shis brjod/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// gnyis pa mar me'i sbyin sreg ni/ rang gi mdun du stegs kyi khar mar me'i kong bu yangs par/ ras dmar gyis dkris pa'i sdong bu spom po btsugs/ mar dkar gyi khu bas bkang la bzhag ma 'byor na gtor ma dang*/ mchod pa lnga bshams/ bsreg rdzas til nag po dang*/ gzhan yang rdor dril nang mchod sogs 'du byas la/ bdag bskyed rgyas par bya ba'am/ thun mtshams kyi rje btsun mar dran par byas te/ mchod rdzas nang mchod dang*/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i snod du 'bru gsum zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod rdzas dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mkha' klas par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar dang*/ ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi tas byin gyis brlabs/ de nas oṃ gsum ma'i rjes su/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐/ zhes pas mar me sbar/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las e e las chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du/ pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐ yig dmar po'i mthar/ oṃ oṃ oṃ nas/ swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags phreng g.yon skor du 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phros 'dus don gnyis byas/ de yongs su gyur pa las rnam snang rigs bdag dang bcas pa'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni/

zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas sogs nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ phaiṃ/ thugs ka'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsogs/ de'i gnas rnams su sogs/ go cha bkod/ phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ bstod pa rnams bya/ de nas mdun du til bzhag la/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad snying ga nas kam̐ nag po'i rnam pas 'thon sna sgor sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur pa til la thim pa de nyid rje btsun ma'i zhal du phul bas lte ba'i gtum mo'i ye shes kyi mes bsreg cing sbyangs par bsam la/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis til blangs te 'bul zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na swā hā/ zhes pa'am/ oṃ gsum ma'i rjes su/ kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba pā paṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ gang rung gis 'bul/ rdzas rdzogs pa na/ mchod bstod gong ltar dang*/ gtor ma yod na gtor chog ltar phul ba'i rjes/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag pa dang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ yig brgya'i mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang*/ sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ oṃ khyed kyi sogs kyi mthar/ badz+ra muḥs ye shes pa gshegs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dam tshig pa rang la thim/ bdag bskyed rgyas pa dang 'brel na/ go cha bkod cing bsrung ba bya/ gang ltar yang bsngo smon shis brjod rgyas par bya'o// de ltar 'bad pas sdig pa thams cad byang zhing*/ rje btsun ma'i byin rlabs myur du 'jug par 'gyur ro// bzhi pa tshes bcu'i mchod pa la'ang rgyas bsdus gnyis las/

dang po ni/ sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gsum bshams shing sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ dbang blang ba dang*/ tshogs kyi mchod pa sogs gnas gsar ba'i yig cha ltar ro// gnyis pa ni/ rje sa skya pa chen po'i tshes bcu'i mchod pa'i yi ge las ji ltar 'byung ba kun mkhyen rin po ches gsal bar mdzad pa bzhin brjod na sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ gnas dben zhing yid dang mthun par tshogs gsag par 'dod na yar ngo dang*/ sgrib pa dag par 'dod na mar ngo'i tshes bcur/ gnas khang phyag dar bya zhing dri bzang po'i chus chag chag gdab/ bris sku sogs rten ji ltar rigs pa'i mdun/ ras dmar pos bkab pa'i stegs kyi khar mañdzi'i steng du/ maṇ+ḍa lar tsan+dan dmar mo'i chus srin lag g.yon pas chos 'byung gru gsum g.yon skor du bris pa'i nang thams cad tsan+dan dmar po'i chus byugs/ tsan+dan dmar po'i chu ma 'byor na chang bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs pas de ltar byas la/ dbus su me tog gi tshom bu gcig bkod la bzhag de'i g.yas su/ me tog
