rtsa ba'i yig rnying sogs su mchod pa lnga kho na las ma bshad kyang*/ spro na chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod kyang rung*/ bdug spos/ mar me/ g.yon du dri chab/ gtor ma/ lha bshos/ mdun du ma da nā'i phud dang*/ bā la sogs tshogs kyi yo byad/ gzhan yang nang mchod/ rdor dril/ ḍā ma ru sogs dgos pa'i yo byad rnams 'du bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ thog mar bdag bskyed brgyud 'debs dang skyabs 'gro nas/ thun mtshams kyi lhar ldang ba'i bar bya/ de nas mdun bskyed gsal gdab pa ni/ tshom bu sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang gi lte ba'i bam̐ yig las bam̐ yig gnyis pa zhig mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du chad de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pas sogs nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin brjod/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ phaiṃ/ rang gi thugs ka'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs mdun bskyed la gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhoḥsogs kyis brtan par bya/ de'i gnas rnams su nas/ tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bor gyur/ bar gyi go cha bkod/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nas shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ slar yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can la brgyud pa'i bla ma dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs tshogs zhing spyan drang*/ nang mchod/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ kam̐ las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ de'i nang du go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bi ra shu ma mu las bdud rtsi lnga rnams gsal ba'i/ 'og gi rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ rdzas thams cad khol bas 'od du zhu nas dam tshig pa dang ye shes dbyer med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsam la/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin sbyar bas chos 'byung g.yon skor du bris te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ zhes brjod pas byin gyis brlabs pas rdzas thams cad la gtor te/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ gzhan yang rol mo la sogs pa mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis brlabs la/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas/ shab+da'i bar dang*/ ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi tas rol mo bya/ oṃ gsum ma'i rjes su 'bru gsum btags la nang mchod 'bul/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum brnyes// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya bar rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/

de nas gtor ma nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs la/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis ka bstan la/ bya khyung gyis phyag rgya bcas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥs brlabs/ phaiṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma chos skyong dang 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad skor gyi rjes rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i mthar se gol gtog pa dang bcas te/ oṃ gsum ma'i rjes su/ oṃ a kā ro sogs btags pa lan lnga'am bdun gyis phul/ oṃ badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis phyi mchod/ oṃ badz+ra ā ral+li hoḥ.oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// zhes pas nang mchod 'bul/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// sogs kyis bstod/ 'chi tshe mgon dang dpa' bo ma tshogs kyis// me tog gdugs dang rgyal mtshan thogs nas su// rol mo glu dbyangs sil snyan sogs mchod cing*// mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su khrid par shog /ces gsol ba gdab/ de nas gtor ma gzhan rnams gur zhal sogs chos srung rnams dang*/ dur khrod bdag po yab yum dang*/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi bar ji ltar rigs pas btang*/ de nas mdun gyi tshogs rdzas rnams la nang mchod 'thor zhing bsang sbyang byin rlabs bdud rtsi ltar byas rjes/ tshogs phud snod gcig tu blugs pa dang*/ ma dā na snod gcig tu blugs pa maṇ+ḍal gyi mdun du bzhag gtor ma rnams la'ang phul/ slar thams cad nang mchod chu chang gis bran la/ thog mar/ gang gi drin gyis sogs kyis bla ma la phyag bya ba sngon du 'gro bas/ dman pa'i yul las rab 'das shing*// rgyal ba kun gyi dam tshig mchog /dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur pa// bdud rtsi mchog gis mchod par bgyi// sgrib pa dri ma kun bsal nas// rtog pa kun las rnam grol ba// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig

/ces pas sman phud 'bul/ de nas tshogs phud dang po ni/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan zhing sogs kyis mthar/ oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa sa pā ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs kyis bla ma dang dkon mchog yi dam spyi la phul/ de rjes/ oṃ gsum ma'i mthar/ a kā ro btags pas rje btsun ma la 'bul zhing*/ gzhan yang gur zhal sogs kyi gtor ma yod na so so'i gtor sngags kyis rgyas par 'bul ba'am/ de tsam ma nus na/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ma hā kā li de bī sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ces dang*/ oṃ shrī dharma pā la tsa turmu kha sa pa ri sogs dang*/ oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khum this swā hā/ shrī sh+ma sha nā a dhi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra sogs kyis 'bul zhing*/ mthar 'jig rten pa la mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi sngags kyis phul/ thun mong du phyi nang gi mchod pa sngar bzhin mchod/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang*/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi zhing mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ ces gsol ba gdab/ tshogs kyi yo byad la gtsang sme'i rnam rtog spangs te/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor mchod par bsam la/ a ho ma hā su kha ho/ zhes brjod cing tshim par rol/ lhag ma bsdus te chang gi kha phru 'bar ba'i phyag rgya'i bar nas 'thor zhing*/ phaiṃ/ uṣa tsi ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa sī swā hā/ 'byung po lhag ma la dbang ba rnams la sbyin no// ngoms shing tshim pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig ces phyi rol du dor/

kol+la i raṭa ṭha sogs rdo rje'i glu dang*/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung ba// he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku// shes rab phag mo'i pad+mar rdo rjes rol mdzad pa'i// bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par/ gang gis lam gyis grol 'gyur ba// de yis sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces sogs bkra shis dang smon lam bya'o// gsum pa rjes ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos shing*/ bsang sbyang byin rlabs bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe sogs kyis phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ dpal ldan rdo rje sogs kyis bstod/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag dang sems can thams cad dag pa mkha' spyod kyi gnas su 'khrid par mdzad du gsol/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ he ru ka'i yig brgya lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis nongs par gsol/ rten yod na/ 'dir ni gzugs dang sogs brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na/ oṃ khyed kyi sogs kyis/ tshom bu'i ye shes pa dang*/ gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams gshegs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dam tshig pa rnams rang la gnyis su med pa thim par bsam la/ rang gi gnas rnams su sogs go cha bkod/ bsrung ba bya/ dge ba 'di yis sogs bsngo ba dang*/ mkha' spyod zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam gdab/ phun tshogs dge legs sogs kyis shis pa brjod cing me tog gi char sil ma dgram/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// de ltar bzlas bsgom rnam pa gnyis dang*/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa ma chags par nyams su blangs pa ni las dang po pas mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i lam gyi gtso bo yin pas shin tu gal che'o// lnga pa gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ni/

dku bag ste sha chang gi dam rdzas nges par tshang zhing bsgrub pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu dang sbyar ba'i gtor ma pad+ma'i snying po ltar zlum pa/ 'phral gtor la pad 'dab dang*/ 'dzin gtor sogs la mtheb kyus bskor ba gtsang sbra dang ldan pa bshams/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa'i skabs su bshad pa ji ltar bzhin phul pa las/ mchod pa'i skabs su chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod kyis mchod pa tsam gyi khyad par ro// 'dis ni bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang bsam pa'i don 'grub pa sogs dgos pa khyad par can mang ngo*// de ltar dbang po rab rnal 'byor bcu gcig po 'di ma chags par nyams su blangs shing*/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa la brtson pa tsam gyis tshe 'dir lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur la/ 'di nyid bskyed rim phag mo mkha' spyod ces gtso bor gsungs pa ma gtogs/ don gyis bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug yin te mngon rtogs kyi dkyus gcig la dbang bzhi'i lam mtha' dag tshang ba'i phyir ro// dbang po 'bring gis gzhi'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin pa na/ laṅka li'i shing la brten nas sin+dhu ra'i bsgrub pa tshul bzhin du byas pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mi mo'i rnam pa can gyi rjes su bzung zhing mkha' spyod kyi grong du 'khrid pa ste/ de'i tshul ni/ deng dus lag len la 'debs pa nyung bas 'dir ma bris la/ rtogs par 'dod na khrid yig chen mo dang*/ 'jam mgon kun dga' bsod nams kyi yig cha sogs las shes par bya'o// dbang po tha mas de lta bu lag tu ma blangs pa'am/ blangs kyang ma grub na bzlas bsgom la brtson pas/ 'chi kha'am bar dor bzlas bsgom byed pa'i snang ba shar ma thag rnal 'byor mas mdun bsus te mkha' spyod du 'khrid par nges na'ang*/ ches myur bar byed pa'i thabs lam gyi chad mthud 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang ba'i tshul la/ sbyang ba dang*/ las la sbyor ba'o// dang po la'ang rje btsun yab yum zhal sbyor dang*/

yum rkyang gi 'pho ba gnyis las/ 'dir phyi ma cung zad bshad na/ gsal gdab pa dang*/ sbyang ba dngos gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bdag bskyed dang 'brel na thun mtshams kyi lhar gsal bzhin pa'i ngang dang*/ ma 'brel na skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas rang skad cig gis rnal 'byor mar gsal gdab gang ltar yang*/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus drang po rtsa dbu ma phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ rtsa ba phra ba mda' smyug tsam la/ rtse mo sbom pa sba lcag tsam pa/ yar sna spyi gtsug tshangs bug tu zug cing rgya mthong ltar kha bye ba/ mar sna lte bar zla gdan la zug pa/ chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum pa'i nang du zug par bsgom kyang rung*/ de'i steng du rang gi rlung sems dbyer med pa'i ngo bo bam̐ yig gam/ thig le dmar po che chung ril ma tsam pa 'phur la khad pa zhig gsal gdab/ rang gi spyi bor seng khri pad zla 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par bzhugs pa la/ brgyud pa'i bla ma gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ de dag kyang 'ja' gur gyi dbus na bzhugs shing*/ me tog gi char chen po rgyun mi chad par 'bebs pa/ 'ja' mdung tshugs su zug cing spos kyi dri zhim po 'thul pa sogs mkha' spyod dngos dang mtshungs par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems sogs skyabs yul thams cad oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim pas skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor bsam mo// gnyis pa sbyang ba dngos ni/ rang gi lus longs spyod dge tshogs rgya mtsho dang bcas par rgyur byas pa las byung ba'i mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod par mos te/ oṃ gu ru badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/

shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs kyis bstod/ spro na brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dang*/ gang ltar yang*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma mkha' spyod rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag 'dzin blo yis thongs par byin gyis rlobs shig /dgos med rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs shig /lam mchog 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs shig /'phyugs med mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs shig /zhes tshar grangs ci nus brjod cing gsol ba phur tshugs su btab la/ 'og rlung drag tu 'then pa dang mnyam du bshang sgo'i rlung g.yos zla dkyil la phog rang sems bam̐ yig gam thig le gsal ba de nyid dbu ma'i nang nas skar mda' 'phang ba ltar song*/ bla ma rje btsun ma'i gsang ba nas zhugs te thugs ka'i bam̐ yig la sib kyis thim par bsam la sems bzung*/ yang steng rlung rngubs pas bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'byung ste sngar ltar gdan la 'khod par bsam la rlung bum pa can kha sbyar du 'dzin/ slar yang mchod bstod bya ba'am/ gsol 'debs kyi mthar sngar bzhin dmigs pa'i rten goms pa la bslabs pa ni rlung gi 'pho ba dang*/ skabs su/ ī hik ces brjod pas thig le spar ba dang*/ ka hi/ zhes pas 'bebs pa ste sgras 'pho ba'ang nyams su blangs/ 'di gnyis kyi snga ma 'byongs dka' yang 'byongs phyin brtan pa yin la/ phyi ma 'byongs sla yang brtan dka' ba yin zhes gsungs/ de ltar dus rgyun du lan bdun sogs dang*/ 'di kho na sbyang ba'i tshe zhag bdun sogs thun bzhir bcad la 'bad rtsol drag pos rtags ma byung bar nyams su blang bar bya zhing*/ rtags ni spyi bo za ba dang*/ skrangs pa dang*/ chu ser 'dzag pa dang*/ sgrub khang la 'ja' zug pa sogs 'byung ngo*// thun las ldang ba/ rlung sems mar phabs pa'i rjes/ mtha' skor gyi skyabs yul rnams bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor mar thim/

de nyid rang gi tshangs bug nas brgyud snying gar dbu ma'i nang du zhugs/ spyi gtsug sna tshogs rdo rje sra zhing 'thas pas bkag par bsam/ rtags byung ba sogs kyi tshe tshe sgrub byed par 'dod na/ snying ga'i rnal 'byor ma'i 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun du gyur nas lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob/ ba spu'i bu ga tshun chad kyang bdud rtsi'i zil pa phram mer yod par bsam la rlung bum can ci nus su 'dzin/ mthar bdag bskyed dang 'brel na go cha bkod pa sogs dkyus ltar dang*/ ma 'brel na bsngo smon bkra shis sogs bya'o// gnyis pa las la sbyar ba ni/ nges pa'i 'chi ltas byung zhing dus la babs pa'i tshe/ sngar bzhin gsal gdab/ khyad par rang gi lus longs spyod dgra gnyen bar ma'i 'gro ba dang bcas pa bla ma rnal 'byor mar phul nas/ chags sdang rmongs gsum gyi zhen pa btsan thabs su spangs/ dam tshig nyams chags bshags sdom gyi 'dun pa drag po bya/ dmigs gnad sngar bzhin la rang sems bla ma'i thugs kar thim/ bla ma rje btsun mar gsal ba yang mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing du gshegs par bsam la/ dbyings stong nyid du rjen ne/ gdangs gsal rig tu lam me/ de gnyis dbyer med pa brjod bral blo 'das kyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag pas/ de'i ngang du dbugs chad na 'pho ba thebs pa yin no// gal te gza' gdong thug lta bu rkyen glo bur bas dmigs pa'i gsal 'debs rgyas pa long ma byung na/ rang sems dang bla ma'i thugs dbyer med du bsres pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag de ltar dran pas ma zin pa'am/ 'pho ba ma 'byongs nas bar do'i snang ba shar na/ de sbyang ba'i tshul ni/ da lta nas gang shar gyi snang ba spyi dang*/ khyad par 'jigs skrag sogs glo bur du 'char ba'i tshe bar do'i snang ba shes par byas la/ rang gzhan gyi snang ba thams cad sbyang bsgyur gyis lha dang gzhal yas khang du bsgyur/

rig pa brjod med du cham mer 'jog pa la bslab pas bar dor yang dran pas zin nas lam gyi 'phro mthud de grol bar 'gyur ro// dbang po shin tu tha mas 'da' ka ma'am/ bar do'i gdams ngag ma theb na/ skye ba phyi mar lam gyi 'phro mthud nas mkha' spyod kyi go 'phang don du gnyer ba ste/ de nyid 'grub pa'i slad du mkha' spyod zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam sogs gdab cing*/ bla ma la mos gus dang ma bral na nges par 'grub pa yin no// de rnams kyis gtso bor bskyed rim gyi rnal 'byor yan lag dang bcas pa bstan nas/ gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa la/ spyir chos nyid dngos su ston pa dang*/ brgyud nas ston pa gnyis las/ 'dir phyi ma dpe gsum gyis don gcig gtan la 'bebs par byed pa la/ gzhi chos can 'khor ba'i dus su 'khrul snang gi gtso bo rtsa rlung thig le thams cad kyi khyab byed nang gi pho nya mchog rtsa dbu ma kho na la gnad du bsnun pas/ gnyis med kyi ye shes myur du 'char ba'i gnad shes par byas nas/ de la gnad du bsnun pa'i lam ji ltar bsgoms pa'i gnad rje btsun yab dang thun mong dang*/ yum rkyang thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsa dbu ma'i rnal 'byor gnyis las/ phyi ma la'ang chags can pho nya'i lam la dga' ba dang*/ chags bral rnal 'byor gyi lam la dga' ba gnyis kyi phyi ma ltar bsgom pa'i tshul la/ thog ma sbyang ba'i tshul sogs rgyas par 'khrid yig chen mo las shes par byas nas/ 'dir rgyun du nyams su blangs pa'i tshul cung zad tsam bshad na/ rtsa dbu ma kha dbye ba'i rnal 'byor dang*/ dbye nas bsgom pa'i man ngag gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rgyun gyi nyams len la zhar byung gi rdzogs rim gyi mjug tu lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun dang ldan pas/ rang rnal 'byor ma'i lus dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma mar sne lte 'og sor bzhir slebs pa/ yar sne spyi bor zug pa'i nang du byang sems haṃ yig dkar po mgo thur bstan gyis mtshan pa/

g.yas su ro ma dmar mo/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar mo/ gnyis ka'ang gro sog 'bring po tsam yar sne spyi gtsug nas gug ste sna bug gnyis su ha re zug pa/ mar sne lte ba'i thad du dbu ma dang sbubs gcig tu gyur pa'i nang du/ tsaṇ+ḍa lī ram̐ dmar po me'i rang bzhin can ril ma tsam gyis mtshan pa/ me 'bar la khad pa de'i 'og tu rlung dkyil ljang nag sran ma bkas pa tsam gsal btab/ rlung ro dgu phrugs su phyag len ltar bus la/ 'og rlung phyed 'then tsam dang*/ steng rlung rdzogs par rngubs/ slar 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum gsum tsam gyis 'og rlung rdzogs par drangs pas rlung dkyil la phog rlung g.yos ram̐ yig las me lce dmar nyug nyug 'bar bar bsam la bum can 'dzin/ mthar 'dzin med pa'i lta bas rgyas 'debs/ de nas lus khol bur drod skye ba sogs cung zad goms pa na/ rim gyis rtsa gsum gyi nang thams cad mes gang*/ de nas rtsa phran thams cad kyang mes khengs te sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa'i ngo bo khams snyigs ma thams cad cham cham bsregs/ dwangs ma bdud rtsir zhu ba dang*/ spyi bo'i haṃ la reg pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun dngul chu lta bu'i dwangs mas rtsa thams cad khengs te bde drod bsam gyis mi khyab pa skyes par bsam la rlung bum can 'dzin/ gnyis pa bsgom pa'i man ngag la/ rlung lus la gnas pas bde ba dang*/ sems la zhugs pas stong par bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis las/ dang po ni/ ro rkyang gnyis mi dmigs par bzhag dbu ma sba lcag 'bring po tsam yar sna spyi gtsug nas smin mtshams su gug pa'i nang du/ chos 'byung dmar ser 'od kyi rang bzhin can gyi rtsa ba phra ba dbu ma'i nang du zug pa la bug pa thal le yod pa/ mar sne gsang gnas kyi pad+ma'i nang du ha re yod pa'i nang chos 'byung snga ma lta bu zhig gsal gdab/ smin mtshams kyi chos 'byung nang thig le dkar la sdo mdangs chags pa/ 'od kha dog lnga 'phro ba sran ma tsam zhig gsal la/

'og rlung cung zad 'then/ steng rlung cung zhig rngubs pa'i rkyen gyis de las 'od kha dog lnga ldan 'phro bar bsam la sems bzung nas smin mtshams su na lhang lhang ba'am bde ba skye ba sogs kyi rtags byung na/ thig le de bug pa nas yar song*/ spyi gtsug gi dbu ma'i nang du ri rtser skar ma shar ba bzhin 'od phram phram du gnas par bsam la sems bzung*/ mthar de las bde chen gyi thig le shel dkar bzhu ba lta bu pad+ma'i snal ma tsam pa zhig nar gyis babs/ spyi bo/ mgrin pa/ snying ga lte ba/ gsang gnas rnams kyi dbu ma'i nang du babs pa la sems bzung bas yas babs kyi dga' bzhi'i ye shes skyes par bsam/ de nas gsang gnas kyi chos 'byung gi nang nas kyang phyir sor phyed dang gsum nyug ge yod pa la sems gtad/ slar chos 'byung gi bug pa nas gyen du byung ste/ lte ba nas spyi bo'i gzhir gnas kyi thig le la thim pa'i bar gnas so sor sems bzung bas/ mas brtan gyi dga' bzhi skyes par bsam la rig pa 'dzin med du bzhag gnyis pa ni/ dbu ma chos 'byung bcas sngar bzhin gsal ba'am/ yang na chos 'byung mi dmigs par bzhag dbu ma'i yar sna smin mtshams dang*/ mar sna gsang gnas kyi mtshams su thad bcad du yod par bsam/ de nas smin mtshams kyi chos 'byung gi nang ngam dbu ma'i yar sner thig le bsgom pa de la sems bzung ste spyi gtsug tu spo ba'i bar sngar bzhin la/ spro na bde chen gyi thig le 'bebs bzlog gi dmigs pa yang bya/ gang ltar yang spyi bo'i thig le la sems zhugs pa bzhin cher gyis gtad pas/ de las 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan 'ja' tshon lta bu bun gyis 'phros/ dbu ma'i nang brgyud rtsa khams gang la reg pa thams cad 'ja' tshon du song*/ de nas cher 'phros pas lus ril po/ gnas khang*/ lung pa/ yul phyogs/ mthar khams gsum thams cad 'od kha dog lnga 'ja' tshon lta bu khra shig shig na bun long long du gyur par bsam la sems bzung*/

mthar de thams cad nam mkha' la du ba yal ba bzhin bde stong gi ngang du mi dmigs par bsam pa'am/ yang na de thams cad rang gi lus la thim/ lus spyi bo'i thig le la thim/ de nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar chos nyid kyi ngang du thim par bsam/ sdud rim snga ma ltar na/ rang lus lha sku rtsa thig dang bcas skad cig gis lam gyis gsal 'debs/ phyi ma ltar na/ thog mar rang gi smin mtshams kyi thig le de khra chem gyis grub/ de nas rim bzhin du lus rtsa dang bcas pa grub par bsam la dmigs pa bskyar/ de ltar na rlung lus la gnas pas khams snyigs ma dwangs ma dang*/ sems la zhugs pas dwangs ma 'ja' lus su bsgyur bar byed pa'i thabs dam pa ste/ tshul 'di la goms pas cir snang bde chen ye shes su 'char ba na/ gsang ba'i spyod pas bogs dbyung zhing*/ phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa dang*/ phyag rgya'i nye rgyus mtshams sbyar te tshe gcig gis mchog gi dngos grub mngon du byed par 'gyur ro// gsum pa lam gyi yan lag pra sen dbab pa sogs ni/ deng sang lag len 'debs pa nyung bas 'dir ma bris te/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i gsung rab rnams las shes par bya zhing*/ 'dir 'phros don du bsnyen pa byed tshul gyi lag len cung zad bshad na/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ rten gyi gang zag nges 'byung dang snying rje chen pos rgyud sbyangs te dbang thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa/ byin rlabs kyis smin zhing nyams khrid zab mo thob pa chag med kyi rgyun dang ldan zhing brtson 'grus yal bar mi 'dor bas/ gnas dben zhing yid dang mthun la rang dbang 'dus pa'i gnas su/ mar ngo'i tshes bcu lta bu dus khyad par can gyi snga dro gnas khang phyag dar bya/ rang nyid kha nub tu phyogs pa'i mdun rnal 'byor ma'i sku bris 'bur gang rigs kyi mdun du/ gtor ma lnga tshar sogs ji ltar rigs pa mchod pa dang bcas pa bshams/

bsgul bskyod mi dgos pa'i mal 'og tu sna tshogs rdo rje bris pa'i steng 'bru dkar dang ku sha'i chun po dgram/ mdun du nang mchod rdor dril/ ḍā ma ru sogs nyer mkho'i yo byad dang*/ mal sa de min pa zhig tu rang 'khod pa'i mdun gtor ma cha gsum sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams sta gon bya/ gnyis pa ni/ phyi dro'i cha la babs pa nas/ grogs dam tshig pa dang bcas te cha gsum yid ches pa btang ba'am/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dkyil chog nas 'byung ba bzhin la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsnyen sgrub zab mo 'gyid par 'tshal na/ zhes dang*/ bsnyen sgrub kyi bya ba mthar ma phyin bar zhes bsgyur/ gtor ma phyir dor ba'i tshe/ mdun mkhar bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs par mos te/ bden stobs brjod pas de rnams kyi sku las rdo rje khro bo dang me dpung mtshon cha'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ yungs kar yang 'bru re re nas sprul pa'i pho nya srin po khros pa lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur te bgegs thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad/ bsad bcad btub cing chos dbyings su thim/ sprul pa'i khro bo'i tshogs rnams tshur 'dus te srung ba'i gur du gyur par bsam la/ gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brab/ mtshams g.yog dang sman pa sogs dmigs khong du bcug dgos pa rnams kyang 'jug spro na sher snying bdud bzlog dang bcas pa'ang bya/ de nas sgo yi phyi rol du tho dkar po btsugs la/ rang nyid grogs dang bcas rdor dril yungs kar spos sogs thogs la/ rgyas par rmor chen gyis mdzad pa'i tho 'dzugs ltar bya/

ngor lugs la cha gsum tsam las gzhan mi mdzad/ mchan/ de tsam mi nus kyang*/ tho 'jam mgon kun blo'i gsungs/ mchan/ sum+bha ni sogs brjod cing yungs kar gyis brabs/ gu gul bdug me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te/ ye dharmā tshar gsum/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sogs brtan bzhugs spyi ltar la/ bye brag tu tho 'di la rgyal chen bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa brtan par bzhugs nas bdag gi bsnyen sgrub mthar ma phyin gyi bar du/ phyi'i bar chad nang du mi gtong zhing*/ nang gi dngos grub phyir mi yal bar bsam pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i sdongs grogs phrin las rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha dang*/ ye dharmā brjod cing me tog 'thor/ bkra shis brjod/ nang du log la rang nyid mal du 'khod/ nges 'byung dang byang sems gsal gdab la/ brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku bstod mos gus shug drag pos byas/ de nas gnas yo byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas/ skyabs 'gro nas bsam mi khyab pa'i bar tshar lugs ltar na gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang dang*/ ngor lugs ltar na rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyi yig cha'i dkyus nas 'byung ba ltar nyams su blangs rjes thun mtshams kyi lhar ldang zhing gtor ma 'bul/ go cha bkod cing bsrung ba dang bsngo smon rgyas par bya/ gong gi yig cha de gnyis ma 'byor na sngon du kho bos bshad pa'i sgrub thabs 'di kho na ltar nyams su blangs kyang rung ngo*// slar srod thun skyabs 'gro nas bsdu rim bar dkyus ltar la/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyis nyal/ sang nangs par ldang ste bdud rtsi myong ba dang*/ skyabs 'gro sogs dkyus ltar/ nyi ma shar tsam gyi tshe thun grol/ gtor ma brgya rtsa dang tshe sgrub sogs byed na skabs 'dir bya/ de nas thun tshugs la nyin phyed ma zin tsam la grol/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ phyag bskor mdo 'don pa sogs dge ba'i bya ba ci 'grub bya zhing cung zad ngal gso/

de nas gnas yo byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas thun la zhugs/ nyi ma nub la nye ba na grol nas gtor ma'i rnal 'byor rgyas par bya/ spyir grub na thun snga ma gnyis kyi mjug tu'ang gtor bsngo bya bar gsungs/ bir srung dang brag rdzong ma sogs srung 'khor gyi rigs yod na nyams su blangs/ de nas srod thun la 'jug cing*/ nam gung ma zin tsam la grol nas nyal ba'i rnal 'byor sogs sngar bzhin bya ste/ de ltar thun bzhi'i spyir tshar lugs la thun bzhi dang*/ ngor lugs la thun gsum mdzad kyang*/ skabs 'dir rdo rje 'chang gis kyang*/ thun bzhi bsgom zhing gus pas gsol btab pas// zhes gsungs pas thun bzhi kho na legs so// mchan/ tshul gyis thog mar thun rnams la sngon 'gro/ skyabs 'gro/ rdor sems/ maṇ+ḍal rnams rim pa gtso bor byas te/ rab 'bum ther dang*/ de min kyang mtshams kyi dngos gzhi yun ring thung la ltos te zhag gsum/ bdun sogs ji ltar 'os pa bya/ dngos gzhir gtso bo ngag bzlas dang*/ thun mjug tu yid bzlas/ zhar byung gi rdzogs rim mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i lam khyad par can bsam mi khyab thun min rnams ma chag par bya/ gzhan 'pho ba dang*/ rtsa dbu ma'i rnal 'byor sogs kyang ji ltar rigs par bsgom/ lam dus ni thor thun grol nas snga thun ma tshugs pa'i bar bya zhing*/ de min kha 'don chung ngu'i rigs rnams thun mtshams gang rung la ma chag tsam bya/ thun la zhugs nas ma grol bar ja sogs bzhes kyang ngag mtshams dam par bcad/ thog mar khog grim la sos dal ba/ bar du sgo gsum 'jug pa chig bsgril/ mthar je lhod la btang nas mtshams dang zhe ma 'gras par bslab/ bzlas pa 'gro che ba dang nyams dang rmi lam gsal ba sogs bzang rtags dang*/ bzlas pa 'gro ba bul zhing nad gdon sogs rkyen ngan gang byung yang re dogs kyi rnam rtog tshab tshub mi bya bar blo bla ma dang dkon mchog la gtad nas lhod kyis glod/

dam bca' yal bar mi 'dor ba'i snying rus bskyed/ rig pa brjod med du cham mer bzhag pas gegs thams cad rang grol du 'gro/ bzlas pa'i thog mar/ thod pa'am bo dhi tsi'i phreng ba brgya rtsa brgyad la/ oṃ pa de pa de ma hā dz+nyā naṃ sarba bud+dha ma yaṃ bha be ta hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho āḥkhaṃ swā hā/ lan gsum bzlas pa'i kha rlangs phreng bar phog par byas te byin gyis brlabs/ dngos gzhi'i bzlas dmigs ni gtso bo sngar bshad pa bzhin dang*/ dmigs pa gcig kho nas skyo na/ res lha sku snang la rang bzhin med par gsal lam me ba la sems gtad/ res sku yi cha shas re re nas sems 'dzin/ res sngags kyi yig 'bru dang sgra tsam la sems bzung*/ res gnas lugs brjod bral gyi ngang du ngal gso/ res 'od zer gyi rtse las mchod pa'i rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros te sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la mchod pa dang*/ res snod bcud thams cad lhar gsal ba dang*/ de thams cad kyis kyang oṃ gsum ma'i sgra 'ur dir gyis sgrogs par bsam la bzla ba sogs dmigs pa'i rtsal sbyang bas gcig grogs gcig gis byas te rnal 'byor la bogs thon par 'gyur zhing*/ mdor na sems ma yengs pa'i ngang du bzlas pa bya ba ni shin tu gal che'o// bzlas pa'i grangs ni/ gzhi'i bsnyen pa la 'bum phrag bzhi/ khri phrag bzhi/ stong phrag bzhi/ brgya phrag bzhi rnams kyis don 'grub par gsungs la/ 'bru 'bum byed na 'bum phrag so bdun mdzad pa phyag len no// de yang sgrub pa po nam 'chi cha med/ 'khor ba la nges 'byung*/ sems can la snying rje/ bla ma la mos gus rnams lam gyi srog tu bzung*/ khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la gces spras su byas nas rtse gcig tu bsnyen na dngos grub rnam gnyis myur du 'grub pa ni/ rgyud sde'i bzhugs tshul/ bsgom bya'i lha/ bzla bya'i sngags/ zab mo'i rdzogs rim rnams kyi sgo nas gzhan las ches khyad du 'phags pa'i dbang gis te/

de yang rgyud sde'i bzhugs tshul gyi dbang du byas na/ rgyud sde thams cad kyi mthar thug pa ni rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud yin la/ de la'ang lū nag dril gsum rnal 'byor ma dang bzhi las/ phyi ma 'di kho na mchog tu zab pa'i phyir yang rtse nā ro mkha' spyod ces grags so// bsgom bya'i lha yi dbang du byas na/ ri rab sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pas mtshon/ mkha' 'gro ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni/ mkha' 'gro ma bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi 'du la/ de stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis su/ de bdun cu rtsa bdun du/ de so bdun du/ de nyi shu rtsa bzhir/ de yang brgyad/ de'ang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'di kho na la 'du ba'i phyir/ 'di bsgoms pas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ji snyed thams cad bsgom par 'gyur ba nyid do// bzla bya'i sngags kyi dbang du byas na/ gsang sngags oṃ gsum ma 'di nyid phag mo so bdun ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha nyid yi ge'i gzugs su shar ba yin cing*/ de las 'phros te sngar smros pa bzhin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsam gyis mi khyab par shar ba'i phyir na/ sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi ngo bo 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi sngags thams cad 'dus par bshad pas de thams cad kyi byin rlabs zhugs par 'gyur ba dang*/ dam tshig dang ldan pa'i sngags pas bklags pa tsam gyis don thams cad grub pa'i phyir/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ 'di las shin tu mchog gyur pa// 'jig rten gsum na ci yang med// sogs nas/ bklag pas 'di dag thams cad 'grub// zhes sogs rdo rje 'chang rang nyid kyis rgya cher bsngags pa mdzad do// rdzogs rim gyi dbang du byas na/ rtsa rlung thig le thams cad dbu ma ye shes kyi rlung thig le dang bcas pa 'ba' zhig la 'dus pas/ 'di kho nar gnad du bsnun pas gzhan thams cad shugs kyis 'byongs zhing dngos grub myur ba'i zab gnad khyad par can yin pa'i phyir ro// de lta bu'i lam zab mo 'di la brten nas 'phags bod du mkhas grub bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'ja' lus mkha' spyod kyi go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa'i tshul la dran pas nye bar bzhag ste/

bdag legs su 'dod pa'i skal bzang rnams kyis tshul 'di kho nar nyams len gyi snying por dril bar bya'o// gsum pa ni/ bsnyen pa'i grangs thebs pa dang grub na zhag gsum gyi bar phyi rol mchod pa bya/ gnas de nyid dam phyi rol gzhan gyis mi mthong ba'i sar kha skong gi sbyin sreg lha sngags oṃ gsum ma dang rdzas til 'ba' zhig la grangs bzung nas bsnyen pa ji tsam song ba'i bcu cha 'bul/ de nas gza' skar bzang ba'i thor thun gyi mjug tu gtor bsngo rgyas par bya zhing gtor ma 'bul/ sgo drung gi rgyal chen la gtang rag dang*/ gshegs gsol bya/ de nas grogs dam tshig dang ldan pa rnams dang rim gyis 'phrad pa sogs bya'o// de dag gi gnas skabs thams cad du rgyas 'debs par byed pa chos nyid dngos su ston pa'i nyams len gyi gnad cung zad bshad na/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos/ skye 'gag gnas gsum bral ba gdod ma'i gshis// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i don/ 'khor 'das snang srid kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang sems kho na'i rnam 'phrul las don logs su grub pa rdul tsam yang med cing*/ sems de la yang kha nang du ldog nas cher gyis bltas pas/ dang por skye ba'i rgyus stong*/ bar du gnas pa'i ngo bos stong*/ mthar 'gags pa'i 'bras bus stong pas na gdod ma nas rang chas su gnas pa'i gshis lugs ngo bo stong pa/ mtshan nyid gsal ba de gnyis dbyer med pa'i zung 'jug nyams su myong bzhin du brjod pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i blo 'das kyi rig pa skad cig ma 'di ka don dam lhan cig skyes pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor mar rang ngo 'phrod nas thag bcad nges shes bskyed/ 'dzin pa ma zhugs par byas te nyams len gyi rgyun skyong*/ rnam rtog gang skyes kyang de ka rang gi steng du bzo bcos ma byas par klod nas sems la sems kyis blta ba'i tshul gyis ma yengs tsam du bzhag pas rtog pa kho rang gsal stong zung 'jug tu rjen lhang gis 'char ba zhig yong*/

des mtshon te bskyed rdzogs bsgom pa la sogs mnyam gzhag dang rjes thob kyi gnas skabs thams cad du lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi nyams len dang ma bral ba gal che ste/ de'i tshul yang*/ bla ma sa skya pa chen pos/ bskyed rim rtog pa yin mod kyang*// rtog pa'i ngo bo sems yin te// sems kyi mtshan nyid gsal rig yin// gsal rig rang bzhin stong pa nyid// stong pa gdod nas chos kyi dbyings// 'khrul pa chos kyi dbyings nyid du// shes pas rtog pa thams cad kyang*// ji ltar bsgom kyang mi rtog nyid// btsal yang 'khrul ba ga la srid// ces gsungs pa ltar/ sems kyi gshis lugs brjod bral gyi ngang nas/ mdangs bde chen du ma 'gags pa'i rang rtsal lha dang gzhas yas khang sogs dwangs pa'i mkha' la 'ja' tshon shar ba ltar snang stong zung 'jug chen po'i lam la bslabs pas bskyed rdzogs dbyer med dang cir snang ye shes su 'char ba'i don la rim gyis dbang 'byor bar 'gyur ro// de ltar rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lam gyi rim pa zab mo 'di la/ spyir 'phags bod kyi mkhas grub du mas bkral ba'i gzhung dang*/ khyad par rang lugs nyams len snying por dril ba'i dbang du byas na/ ngag 'don thun mong tsam du tshar chen dang*/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ thun mong ma yin par gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang gi sgrub thabs nag 'gros ma dang*/ de dag gi go don 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i khrid yig chen mo la gzhi byas/ 'jam mgon sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyi rnam bshad dang*/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs yig chung*/ tshar chen rin po ches mdzad pa'i lus dkyil/ bsam mi khyab thun min/ 'pho ba rnams kyi yig chung gis brgyan pa dang*/ zhal shes kyi gnad 'ga' zhig zhi bzang 'phags pa dge legs rgyal mtshan gyis gnas gsar ba'i gsung ji lta ba bzhin zin bris su mdzad pa rnams su mi gsal ba gang yang ma mchis shing*/

de mtshungs tshes bcu'i mchod pa dang*/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gnas gsar ba dang*/ bsnyen yig rmor chen dang*/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pas mtshon byin rlabs dang legs bshad rmad du byung ba glegs bam du longs pa du ma yod bzhin du/ 'di lta bu 'bri ba la dgos pa gang yang ma mchis mod/ 'on kyang zab chos 'di nyid khyab brdal du dar ches pas/ grub mtha' gzhan gyi phyogs su gong gi dpe de rnams thams cad rnyed dka' ba dang*/ rang re'i rjes 'brangs 'ga' zhig kyang dpe mang klog pa'i ngal pa mi nus shing*/ blo gros dman pas yig cha phan tshun gung bsgrigs mi shes pa sogs dang*/ spros pa chung bas tshes bcu'i mchod pa sogs rgyas par mi nus pa rnams la phan pa'i bsam pa kho nas ngag 'don dang dmigs rim mdor bsdus dkyus gcig tu bkod pa la mkhas pa rnams kyis bzod par mdzad du gsol/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i// bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i tshul 'di la// brten nas 'gro kun mkha' spyod grong*// bgrod pa'i gsang lam nyid gyur cig /ces pa'ang lam 'di la mos pa'i dge slong gu ṇa lak+ṣ+mis tshes bcu'i mchod pa mdor bsdus pa zhig dgos zhes ched du bskul bas mtshams sbyar te/ don gnyer blo gros dman pa gzhan la'ang phan pa'i bsam pas bskyed rdzogs yan lag dang bcas pa nyung gsal snying por dril ba 'di ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor gyur pa mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa byams pa rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po sogs yongs 'dzin dam pa chos bzhin du spyod pa rnams kyi bka' drin las tshul 'di'i smin grol gyi bdud rtsi mang du thos pa'i rgyal khams kyi bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos/ mkhas shing dngos grub brnyes pa rnams kyi zhal lung dri ma med pa la nye bar btus te sbyar ba'i dge legs kyi snang bas phan bde'i pad+mo mchog tu rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig

/sarba dā maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bskyed rdzogs mdor bsdus dang 'brel ba'i nyams len mkha' spyod gsang lam mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bde stong zung 'jug ye shes sku// bla ma rnal 'byor ma dpal la// btud nas bskyed rdzogs mdor bsdus dang*// 'brel ba'i gsang lam mdzes rgyan bskrun// 'di la gsum/ rdor sems bsgom bzlas/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong ma yin pa/ bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa ji ltar bsgom pa'i tshul lo// dang po la gsum/ lha bsgom pa/ sngags bzla ba/ bshags bsdam bya ba'o// dang po ni/ skyabs sems kyi rjes/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang pad+ma dkar po'i sdong bu tshangs bug la zug pa/ zla ba'i steng du skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dpal he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyem ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis pa ni/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rnam par spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas hūm̐ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ he ru ka'i sku gang*/ de nas dbyibs brgyud/ yum gyi sku gang*/ yab yum gnyis kyi sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi babs/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu'am rnag khrag srog chags mi sdug pa'i rnam pas bshang gci gnyis dang*/

rkang mthil gnyis nas thon/ shul thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsams la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ shrī yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñtsa/ he ru ko bha wa mahā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces nyer gcig sogs ci nus bzla/ gsum pa ni/ mthar thal mo sbyar te/ mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes pa dang ltung ba dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu/ rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas lus shel gong g.ya' dag pa lta bur gyur par bsam mo// gnyis pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong ma yin pa la bzhi/ tshogs zhing gsal gdab pa/ gsol ba gdab pa/ mchod pa 'bul ba/ dbang blang zhing de kho na nyid la mnyam par bzhag pa'o// dang po ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar ye shes kyi rang snang las grub pa'i gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i lte bar seng khri pad zla nyi ma'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can/ sku mdog dmar po rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol te 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ mtha' skor du mdun nas brtsams te pad zla'i gdan re re'i steng du brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can/

sku mdog dmar po g.yas ḍā ma ru dang*/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba dang*/ gru mo g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyang zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing*/ gzhon nu lang tsho dar la babs pa'i rnam pa can/ skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ skyabs gnas re re'ang skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur par bsam mo// gnyis pa ni/ mos gus gdung shugs drag pos/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// ces dang*/ spro na brgyud 'debs bya/ gang ltar yang*/ drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs so// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes ci nus kyi sgo nas gsol ba phur tshugs su gdab bo// gsum pa la gnyis/ zhen pa spang ba dang*/ mchod pa dngos so// dang po ni/ rang gi mdun du longs spyod/ g.yas su gnyen/ g.yon du dgra/ mtha' bskor du bar ma'i sems can thams cad 'khod pa/ de thams cad ltos med du ling gis phul bar bsam la/ bdag gi lus longs spyod dgra gnyen bar ma'i 'gro ba dang bcas pa thams cad dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la 'bul bar bgyi'o// bdag chags sdang rmongs gsum dang bral bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ gnyis pa la drug las/ dang po phyi mchod ni/ rang gi snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo nam mkha' gang bas me tog la sogs pas mchod par bsam la oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da'i bar phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod cing*/

slar rang la bsdu/ gnyis pa nang mchod ni/ yang mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi thod pa'i nang du spyan drangs te rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la re re bzhin phul/ ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus drangs shing gsol/ zag med kyi bde bas mnyes par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing rang la bsdu/ gsum pa gsang mchod ni/ slar yang spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis snyan pa'i glu len/ bde ba'i gar bsgyur/ mthar gcig la gcig thim ste rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur pas bla ma rnams kyi sku la 'khril nas zag med kyi bde bas mnyes par gyur pa'i mos pa bya'o// bzhi pa de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ de lta bu'i 'khor gsum rang bzhin ma grub par shes pa'i ngang du 'dzin med la blo bzhag lnga pa ku sā li'i tshogs bsag gi mchod pa ni/ rang gi snying ga nas rang sems kyi ngo bo rnal 'byor ma mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam pa rtsa dbu ma'i lam brgyud/ tshangs bug nas thon/ phyag g.yas pa'i gri gug gis phung po'i smin mtshams su reg pa tsam gyis ling gis gog thod pa'i sgyed bu chen po ri rab tsam gsum grub pa'i steng du bzhag pas stong gsum gyi tshad dang mnyam par gyur pa'i nang du/ lus kyi rkang pa g.yas nas brtsams te dum bur gtub cing bskyur bas sha khrag rus pa'i phung po zad mi shes par gyur/ de nyid la dmigs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥzhes brjod pas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar bas thod pa dros/ rdzas zhu zhing khol bas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsam/ rang sems rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ka nas mchod pa'i lha mo thod pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ bdud rtsi'i phud kyis rtsa ba'i bla ma la mchod par bsam la/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan bdun/ de bzhin du/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

gzhan yang bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma gnod sbyin nor lha dam can gter bdag rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnod byed gdon bgegs rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa'i sems can thams cad zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsis tshim ste myur du bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes byin pas thams cad sems rtog med chos sku dang*/ lus zag med rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ lha mo rnams rang la thim/ rang gi lus sngar bzhin gyur cing*/ thod pa sogs mi dmigs par bsam/ drug pa maṇ+ḍal gyi mchod pa ni/ khrid dang bsnyen pa sogs kyi skabs maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma spyi ltar phul/ spro na so bdun ma'ang bya/ bzhi pa dbang blang zhing de kho na nyid la mnyam par bzhag pa ni/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la dmigs nas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag la dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par bskur du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas/ rtsa ba'i bla mas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la spyan cher gzigs te/ dbang bzhi bskur mi bskur gyi gnang ba zhus pas/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis rtsa ba'i bla ma la spyan cher gzigs nas de bzhin bgyi/ zhes gnang ba sbyin pa'i tshul gyis bla ma brgyud pa rnams g.yas skor gyi mas yas rim bzhin thim mthar rdo rje 'chang yang rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ rang gi dpral bar thim pas bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ 'bras bu sprul sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas/ mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ rang gi mgrin par thim pas gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag lam tsaṇ+ḍa lī bsgom pa la dbang*/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/

'bras bu longs sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po 'phros/ rang gi snying gar thim pas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag pho nya'i lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ 'bras bu chos sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas/ slar yang gnas gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la thim pas dbang bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag lam phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas par bsam la so so'i mthar dbang don la blo bzhag de nas ngag tu/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la gsol ba 'debs so bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod cing gsol ba btab la bla ma de nyid dbu'i gtsug tor nas mar 'od du zhu/ gdan seng khri nas yar 'od du zhu ba thugs ka'i thad du 'od dmar ser li khri'i mdog can snum la 'dril ba bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur pa de nyid bde hril gyis byung nas rang gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig dmar po de nyid la sim ste thim pas bam̐ yig de nyid je cher song nas 'ja' yal ba lta bur gyur par bsam la rig pa brjod med kyi ngang du ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag de nas rang gi snying gar e e las sogs bdag lhar bskyed pa'i rnal 'byor la 'jug go /'di'i skabs su mchod pa bsdu na ku sā li'i tshogs bsag kho nas kyang rung gsungs/ gsum pa bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa la gnyis/ sngon 'gro rtsa lam sbyang ba dang*/ dngos gzhi bsam mi khyab kyi 'od gsal la 'jug pa'o// dang po ni/ zhar byung gi rdzogs rim gyi mjug tu lus gnad bsrang*/ rlung ro bsal/ rang gi lus kyi dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma phyi dkar/

nang dmar sbom phra srin mdzub tsam/ yar sna spyi gtsug tu thug pa/ g.yas su ro ma dmar mo/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar mo/ gnyis ka'ang dbu ma las sum 'gyur gyis phra ba/ yar sna spyi gtsug nas gug ste sna bug gnyis su zug pa/ gsum ka'i mar sna lte 'og sor bzhi'i thad sbubs gcig tu gyur pa'i dbus su bam̐ yig dang rang sems dbyer med pa'i ngo bo rnal 'byor ma mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam gsal btab/ de la sems gtad pas thugs ka nas sku chung ngu zhig nar gyis chad/ rlung phyir rgyu ba dang lhan cig rtsa g.yas ro ma'i nang nas yar dmar khyug gis byon/ sna g.yas pa'i sgor slebs pa dang*/ de las de 'dra ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad la khyab/ 'phags pa rnams mchod cing thugs dam bskul/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs shing rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ rlung nang du rngubs pa dang sna g.yon pa'i bu ga nas zhugs/ rkyang ma'i lam brgyud lte ba'i rnal 'byor ma la thim par bsam zhing rlung ci thub tu bzung ngo*// de lta bu lan bdun sogs ci nus su bya/ gnyis pa ni/ nang gi rnal 'byor ma las 'od zer 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad khyab/ yan lag thams cad 'od du zhu nas khog pa la thim/ de nyid kyang 'od dmar po'i phung por gyur/ lte ba'i rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod du 'byon pa la ring bas yar byon/ rim bzhin dbu ma dbu gtsug dang ro rkyang gnyis kyang zhabs mthil la thim pas je thung du gyur cing*/ phyi dbyibs kyi lus kyang rim par thim/ spyi gtsug tu byon pa dang rtsa dang lus lhag ma ma lus par thim/ de'i rkyen gyi rang sems rnal 'byor ma rtsal po ches mda' nam mkha' la 'phang ba bzhin mkha' spyod du gshegs te/ 'od gsal stong nyid kyi ngang du thim par bsam la/ gsal stong zung 'jug gi dbyings su mnyam par bzhag slar nam mkha' nas rang sems rnal 'byor mar gsal ba de nyid thol gyis byung*/

rang gnas su phebs pa dang phyi'i lus dang rtsa sogs kyang sngar bzhin du grub par bsam/ de lta bu tshar nyer gcig gam/ bdun nam/ gsum sogs skabs dang sbyar la bya/ thun bsdu ba na/ rang nyid phyi dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i sku la go cha dgod pa sogs sgrub thabs kyi dkyus bzhin bya'o// de ltar bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang*/ bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa 'di dag so so'i man ngag thob pas nyams su blang bar bya ba yin no// mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i gsang ba'i lam// mdzes byed man ngag 'di sbyar ba'i// dge bas yid can thams cad kun// bde ba che la rol par shog /ces pa'ang rang nyid kyis sngar bgyis pa'i nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bskyed rdzogs mdor bsdus pa mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i gsang lam gyi lhan thabs su/ don du gnyer ba 'ga' la sman pa'i bsam pas mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos nyung gsal snying por dril te bris pa dge legs su gyur cig/ ༈ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs snying por dril ba mkha' spyod lam bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ ༈ /bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i// zhabs kyi pad+mor gus btud nas// gang de'i myur lam la brten te// mkha' spyod gong 'phang thob 'dod na// 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum gyi// dbang dang byin rlabs zab mo yis// rgyud smin dam tshig sdom ldan pas// bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi /dang po nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni// rang dang snang ba thams cad kun// lhar snang sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang*// gnyid kyi 'od gsal dbyings su 'jug /gnyis pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni// dpa' bo ḍā ki'i sngags kyi sgras// bskul nas gnyid las sad par mos// bskyed rim gsal ba'i ngang nas ldang*// gsum pa bdud rtsi myong ba ni// dngos sam yid kyis bdud rtsi'i bcud// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis myong ba las// zag med bde bas tshim par bsam// bzhi pa tshad med rnal 'byor la// thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba ni// tha mal snang ba dbyings thim par// snod bcud dag pa'i zhing gi dbus// mdun mkhar bla ma rdo rje chos// skyabs kun 'dus pa'i ngo bor gsal// pha mas thog drangs bdag gzhan 'gro// rtse gcig gus pas skyabs 'gror dmigs// bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus kun// dus 'di nas bzung byang chub snying po'i bar// bla ma sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// mi phyed gus pa chen pos skyabs su mchi// ci nus rjes su mos gus ches// bla ma mchog dang dkon mchog rin po che// rnam pa gsum la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// khyed kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi// lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes pas gsol btab tshogs zhing gi

/'od kyis bdag sogs 'gro ba kun// sgrib dag sku bzhi'i go 'phang bkod// skyabs yul rang la thim par bsam// de nas sems bskyed dngos gzhi ni// bdag gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob byas nas// 'gro kun srid pa'i mtsho las bsgral bar bya// de yi ched du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i// lam gyi rim pa nyams su blang bar bgyi// lan gsum rdor sems bsgom bzlas kyang*// spro na ma rgyud spyi ltar bya// lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni// mdun mkhar seng khri pad zla'i gdan steng du// rtsa ba'i bla ma dpa' bo rdo rje chos// dmar gsal phyag gnyis ḍā ru thod pa dang*// gru mo g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga yis mtshan// rus pa'i rgyan ldan rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur// rigs kun khyab bdag drin can bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// zhes pas gsol btab bde chen ngo bor zhu// snying dbus bam̐ la sib kyis thim pa yis// rdo rje gsum gyi byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs// bam̐ yig nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon bzhin du yal// drug pa bdag lhar bskyed pa ni// de yi ngang las rang gi snying ga ru// e yig dmar po nyis brtsegs yongs gyur las// chos 'byung dbus su zla dkyil bam̐ yig mthar// sngags phreng g.yon 'khor zer gyis lus nang gang*// sdig sgrib kun byang 'od kyi phung por gyur// de nyid yongs gyur chos 'byung gzhal yas dbus// sna tshogs pad nyi'i gdan la skad cig gis// rang nyid rnam snang rigs bdag dang bcas pa'i// rnal 'byor ma dpal zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// zhabs gnyis g.yas brkyang dus mtshan dmar mo dang*// g.yon bskum 'jigs byed nag po'i gdong pa mnan// sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me lta bu// spyan gsum dag pa mkha' spyod phyogs su gzigs// phyag g.yas rdo rje'i gri gug thur du brkyang*// g.yon pas thod pa khrag bskang steng phyogs bzung*// phrag pa g.yon par rdo rje'i kha ṭ+wāṃ bsten// bde stong nyams rgyas lang tsho'i gzi 'od 'bar// dbu skra gnag snum sil mas sku stod khebs// thod skam dbu rgyan do shal ring du 'phyang*// rus pa'i phyag rgya rnam lngas sku la spras// ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs// bdun pa 'gro ba dag pa ni// snying ga'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng bcas pa las// 'od 'phros rigs drug brtan g.yo'i snang ba sbyangs// de las phyi snod rdo rje btsun mo'i zhing*// nang bcud 'gro kun lha yi ngo bor gyur// brgyad pa dam ye bsre ba ni// 'bar ba'i phyag rgya g.yon du bskor// phaiṃ/

slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon 'od zer gyis// rnal 'byor ma dpal 'khor bcas spyan drangs shing*// 'gro ba rnal 'byor mar gyur thams cad bcas// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrang la gnyis med thim// de mthar pad skor 'khyud rgya bcas// oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ thabs shes gnyis med bde chen ye shes su// bdag dang snang ba thams cad rnam dag pa'i// lus kyi gnas su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng*// lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo phag mo dang*// snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma// kha la hrīṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma// dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo bskyod byed ma// spyi gtsug hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma// tshig brgyad phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi kā// kun kyang lha nyid yi ge'i gzugs su shar// dgu pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor la// thog mar ngag gi bzlas pa ni// thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng bcas pa las// 'od 'phros 'phags mchod 'gro kun sgrib gnyis sbyangs// pho nya gsum gyi byin rlabs nus mthu kun// rang thim bdag rgyud byin gyis brlabs par gyur// oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ dam bcas grangs las mi nyung bzlas// khyad par lha yi nga rgyal dang*// rnam pa spyi dang bye brag la// sems 'dzin bsam gtan dug dbyung zhing*// gsal snang mchog tu brtan par bya// de nas yid kyi bzlas pa ni// kha sbyor rlung bzung steng rlung gis// snying ga'i sngags phreng lte bar phab// yid ngor klog pa'i tshul gyis bzla// phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas kyi// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyis// bdag sogs 'gro kun byin gyis brlabs nas kyang*// mchog thun dngos grub thob par mdzad du gsol// zhes pas 'dod don gsol ba gdab// zhar byung rdzogs rim dang po ni// chos 'byung grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil// g.yon du 'khor la sems gtad pas// bde ba'i ye shes skyes par bsam// gnyis pa lus dbus drang po ru// spyi bo nas bzung gsang gnas bar// a ba dhū ti'i yas mar snar// dga' 'khyil dkar dmar gsal btab nas// gsang gnas dang ni spyi bo ru// sems bzung yas mar 'dzegs babs kyis// bde stong ye shes bskyed pa'i mthar// brjod bral mi rtog ngang du bzhag

/bcu pa bsam mi khyab pa ni// snying ga'i bam̐ las 'od 'phros khams gsum po// 'od kyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim// de yang rim gyis thugs srog nā da'i bar// 'od zhu spros bral stong pa nyid du gyur// bcu gcig spyod lam rnal 'byor ni// slar yang gzugs snang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar// gsal ba'i gnas rnams go chas rgyas btab cing*// sgra grags sngags la dran rtog 'od gsal dang*// snod bcud dga' ba gsum gyi ngo bor shar// dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rnal 'byor ma dpal go 'phang 'grub gyur nas// mtha' klas 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la myur du 'god par shog /'chi tshe mgon dang dpa' bo ma tshogs kyis// me tog gdugs dang rgyal mtshan thogs nas su// rol mo glu dbyangs sil snyan sogs mchod cing*// mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'khrid par shog /lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsung tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin pas// bden pa de yis lha mo de rnams kyis// bdag cag rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam rnal 'byor ma// mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i bden stobs kyis// gnas skabs mthar thug rgud pa kun zhi zhing*// phan bde'i dpal la rol pa'i bkra shis shog /de ltar brtson pas tshe 'di 'am// bar dor skye ba bcu drug tshun// rnal 'byor ma yis rjes bzung nas// kha sbyor bdun ldan go 'phang 'grub// tshul 'di rig 'dzin grub pa'i phul// gang de'i bka' stsal lhur blangs nas// 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po yis// dpal 'khor chos sde'i chos grwar bris// de las byung ba'i dge ba dang*// rim gnyis zab mo'i rnal 'byor gyis// khams gsum brtan g.yo'i dngos po kun// bde chen thig ler ro gcig shog /sarba dā maṅga laṃ// ༈ /nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs mkha' spyod lam bzang la nyer mkho'i lhan thabs mkha' spyod grub ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༈ /'khor lo'i mgon po rnal 'byor mar// btud nas de yi sgrub thabs dang*// rjes 'brel nyer mkho'i gdams pa la// dang por rdor sems bsgom bzlas ni// skyabs song byang chub sems bskyed rjes// rang gi spyi bor pad zlar rdo rje sems// rab dkar rdo rje dril 'dzin snyems ma dkar// gri thod 'dzin pa'i yum dang mnyam par sbyor// dar dang rus pa'i rgyan rdzogs skyil krung bzhugs// yab kyi thugs kar zla steng hūm̐ dkar po// de las 'od 'phros de bzhin gshegs kun gyi// byin rlabs ye shes bdud rtsi spyan drangs thim// bla ma bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' yis// bdag sogs 'gro kun sdig ltung sbyang mdzad gsol// hūm̐ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs rang nyid kyi// spyi gtsug nas zhugs nad gdon sdig sgrib kun// yongs su sbyangs te lus kun gang bar 'gyur// ces brjod stobs bzhi'i gnad dang bcas// yi ge brgya pa ci nus mthar// mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// gsang gsum rtsa ba yan lag gi /dam tshig nyams chags mthol zhing bshags// sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs// ma lus byang zhing dag mdzad gsol// rdor sems 'od zhu rang la thim// rang lus dag pa'i shel ltar bsam// gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i// bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni// mdun gyi nam mkhar ye shes gzhal med khang*// de dbus seng khri pad zla nyi ma'i steng*// rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje chos// dmar gsal rdo rje dril 'dzin longs sku'i chas// mtha' bskor pad zlar brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams// dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam par bzhugs// gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa las// 'od 'phros skyabs yul thams cad spyan drangs thim// skyabs gnas ma lus 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur// skyabs kun 'dus zhal rtsa brgyud bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// mos gus drag pos gsol btab nas// rang gi snying ga nas 'phros pa'i// lha mo'i tshogs kyis mchod par bsam// phyi mchod nyer spyod nang mchod bdud rtsi'i sprin// gsang ba snyoms 'jug bde stong de kho na// 'khor gsum dmigs med phyag rgya chen po yis// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams mchod par bgyi// khyad par nang gi tshogs mchod ni// rang sems rnal 'byor ma dpal mkha' la thon// phyag g.yas gri gug phung po'i smin mtshams su// reg pa tsam gyis thod pa ling gis gog

/thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum gyi khar bzhag pas// stong gsum dang mnyam yangs pa'i snod gyur nang*// rkang g.yon nas brtsams dum bur gtub ste blugs// oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang ha ho hrīḥbarjod pas// ye shes me 'bar thod pa'i dam rdzas kun// zhu zhing khol bas ye shes bdud rtsir gyur// thugs nas sprul pa'i lha mo'i tshogs kyis mchod// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan bdun/ brgyud pa'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// gzhan yang mchod 'os zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// gdon bgegs rigs drug 'gro ba kun la sbyin// tshogs rdzogs sgrib byang rnam mkhyen myur thob shog /mthar ni lha mo rang la thim// mchod pa'i rdzas sogs mi dmigs bzhag /spro na maṇ+ḍal ci nus 'bul// mjug tu dbang bzhi blang ba ni// sangs rgyas kun dngos dpal ldan bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so dbang bzhi bskur du gsol// zhes pas gsol btab brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams// 'khor lo'i mgon po'i thugs kar dbyer med thim// de yi gnas gsum rdo rje'i 'bru gsum las// dkar dmar mthing kha'i 'od zer rnam pa gsum// rim dang gcig car byung nas rang nyid kyi// gnas gsum thim pas dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob// sgrib dag lam bzhi bsgom pa'i snod du gyur// byin rlabs sku bzhi'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag /bla ma 'od zhu snying dbus bam̐ yig dang*// dbyer med spros bral 'od gsal gnyug ma'i ngang*// mthar ni bam̐ yig 'ja' tshon bzhin du yal// de yi ngang nas bdag gzhan gzhi// sbyang bsgyur la sogs gzhung ltar bya// gsum pa lus dkyil thun min ni// ye shes gzhug pa'i rkyen gyis snying ga'i bam̐// 'od zhu dbus su mkha' spyod dmar mo dang*// byang nas g.yon skor ljang dmar ser dang dkar// mtha' bskor sngags kyi yig 'bru so gnyis kyang*// rnal 'byor ma dpal dmar mo re rer gyur// de nas nga rgyal bzung ba dang*// go cha gzhung ltar bkod pa'i rjes// lus dkyil gtso mo'i thugs kar chos 'byung dbus// zla steng bam̐ mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor// 'od 'phros la sogs gzhung ltar sbrel// yid bzlas skabs su snying ga yi// lus dkyil lte bar drangs pa dang*// lhan cig lha rnams sngags su bsgyur// bzhi pa thun mong ma yin pa'i// bsam mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor ni// zhar byung rdzogs rim bsgoms pa'i mthar// lus gnad bsrang zhing rlung ro bsal// rang gi lus dbus rtsa dbu ma// phyi dkar nang dmar spyi gtsug zug

/g.yas g.yon ro rkyang dkar dang dmar// yar sna sna bug gnyis su gug /rtsa gsum mar sna lte ba'i 'og /sbubs stong gcig tu gyur pa'i dbus// bam̐ yig rang sems dbyer med pa// rnal 'byor ma dpal mtheb sor tshad// gsal btab de la sems gtad pas// rlung phyir 'gro dang lhan cig tu// thugs las rang 'dra chung ngu 'phros// ro ma'i lam brgyud sna g.yas sgor// byon nas de las sprul pa'i tshogs// dpag med nyi zer rdul bzhin 'phros// 'phags mchod 'gro kun sgrib gnyis sbyangs// rnal 'byor mar gyur tshur 'dus pa// sprul pa'i rnal 'byor ma la thim// de nyid sna bug g.yon nas rlung*// nang du 'jug dang lhan cig par// rkyang ma'i lam brgyud lte ba yi// rnal 'byor ma la thim par bsam// de ltar lan bdun la sogs pas// rtsa lam sbyangs nas dngos gzhi ni// lte ba'i rang sems rnal 'byor ma'i// thugs las 'od 'phros lus kun gang*// 'od phung dmar po gcig tu gyur// rnal 'byor ma yang mkha' spyod la// 'byon par ring pas yar byon te// dbu ma dbu gtsug ro rkyang gnyis// zhabs mthil la 'byar je thung gyur// spyi bor byon tshe rtsa gsum dang*// lus kun lhag ma med par thim// rnal 'byor ma dpal mkha' spyod gshegs// 'od gsal dbyings su thim par bsam// bsam gyis mi khyab ngang du bzhag /slar yang rang sems rnal 'byor ma// mkha' las sprin ltar brdol nas kyang*// mar byon gzhi lus sngar bzhin grub// slar yang 'pho sogs ci nus sbyangs// mthar ni go cha dgod pa sogs// gzhung ltar nyams su blang bar bya// khyad par gdams pa 'di rnams ni// man ngag thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas// tshul bzhin nyams su bstar ba na// mkha' spyod go 'phang tshe 'dir 'grub// de ltar rang gis sngon sbyar ba'i// sgrub thabs mkha' spyod lam bzang dang*// rjes su 'brel ba'i gdams pa 'di// mang du thos pa'i spong ba pa// 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po yis// dam pa gong ma'i gsung bzhin du// mdor bsdus tshigs bcad phreng bar bsdebs// dge bas yid can rgya mtsho kun// mkha' spyod chen po myur 'grub shog

/sarba dā ba ra s+ya sid+dhaṃ sid+dhi rastu// ༈ /nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru badz+ra yo gi nī ye/ de la 'dir dbang thob cing byin rlabs zab mos rgyud smin pa'i gang zag gis/ bsdus pa'i tshul gyis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs yul gsal btab nas/ bdag sogs 'gro kun deng nas byang chub bar// bla ma dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// rdzogs byang go 'phang la brten sems can kun// bsgral phyir zab mo'i rnal 'byor bsgom par bgyi// lan gsum/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad zla'i steng*// rtsa ba'i bla ma dpa' bo rdo rje chos// dmar gsal ḍā ru thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams// rus pa'i rgyan mdzes rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// skyabs gnas kun 'dus drin can bla ma la// snying nas gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba 'debs// bla ma 'od zhu rang la thim pa yis// rang sems bam̐ yig spros bral dbyings su yal// de yi ngang las snying gar e e las// chos 'byung zla dkyil dbus su bam̐ yig mthar// sngags phreng 'khor ba'i zer gyis gzhi lus sbyangs// 'od kyi phung por gyur las skad cig gis// rang nyid pad nyi dus mtshan 'jigs byed steng*// rnam snang rigs bdag bcas pa'i rnal 'byor ma// dmar gsal spyan gsum nam mkha'i dbyings su gzigs// phyag g.yas gri gug thur du brkyang nas 'dzin// g.yon pas thod khrag steng phyogs bzung bas gsol// phrag pa g.yon par rdo rje'i kha ṭ+wāṃ bsten// thod skam dbu rgyan do shal phyag rgyas spras// zhabs zung g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum dor thabs bzheng*// bde chen nyams 'bar ye shes me dbus rol// thugs srog 'od kyis snod bcud dngos 'dzin sbyangs// rdo rje'i btsun mo'i zhing skur lam gyis gsal// 'bar ba'i rgya dang bcas/ phaiṃ/ slar yang thugs ka'i bam̐ las 'od 'phros pas// lhan skyes zhing sngags rnal 'byor ma dpal kun// tshur 'dus dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrang la thim// dam tshig ye shes gnyis su med par gyur// oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/

lus gnas so sor zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng*// ngo bo lha la rnam pa yi ge'i gzugs// oṃ baṃ ham̐ yoṃ hrīṃ moṃ hriṃ hriṃ dang*// hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa rnams kyis mtshan pa yi// thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng bcas pa las// 'phros pa'i 'od kyis 'phags mchod 'gro sgrib sbyangs// pho nya gsum gyi byin rlabs nus mthu kun// bsdus thim mkha' spyod dngos grub thob par gyur// oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ dam bcas grangs las mi nyung bzla// spro na yid bzlas sogs kyi mthar// bla ma rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas// 'gro kun mkha' spyod 'khrid par mdzad du gsol// khams gsum 'od du rang dang rang nyid kyang*// nā da'i bar thim 'od gsal dbyings su yal// slar yang rgyan dang phyag mtshan spangs pa yi// lha sku go chas mtshan par gsal ba'i ngang*// snang grags rtog tshogs lha sngags chos kyi sku// dga' ba gsum dang dbyer med 'dres par gyur// dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di yis bdag gzhan kun// mkha' spyod chen po'i go 'phang 'grub gyur nas// srid dang zhi ba'i rgud pa kun sel zhing*// don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa'ang las dang po pa dang blo gros dman pa rnams la phan pa'i ched du 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos dpal rdo rje gdan gyi chos grwar lhag bsam dag pas bris pa'i dge bas 'gro kun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ ༈ /nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sgom bzlas shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru badz+ra yo gi n+yai/ de la dbang dang byin rlabs zab mos rgyud smin pa'i gang zag gis/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgom bzlas mdor bsdus te nyams su blang ba ni/ skyabs sems rgyas bsdus gang rigs sngon du 'gro bas/

mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad zla'i steng*// rtsa ba'i bla ma dpa' bo rdo rje chos// dmar gsal ḍā ru thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams// rus pa'i rgyan mdzes rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid// bla ma mchog dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// gnyis su med la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// bdag rgyud byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// bla ma 'od zhu rang la gnyis med thim// rang gi snying gar e yig nyis brtsegs las// chos 'byung zla dkyil dbus su bam̐ yig mthar// sngags phreng 'khor ba'i zer gyis sdig sgrib sbyangs// rang lus 'od phung gyur las skad cig gis// pad nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan gdan gyi steng*// rnal 'byor ma dpal zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// dmar gsal spyan gsum nam mkha'i dbyings su gzigs// phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug thur du brkyang*// g.yon pas thod khrag steng phyogs bzung bas gsol// phrag pa g.yon par rdo rje'i kha ṭ+wāṃ bsten// thod skam dbu rgyan do shal phyag rgyas spras// zhabs zung g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum dor stabs kyis// bde chen nyams 'bar ye shes me dbus rol// lus gnas so sor zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng*// lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo phag mo dang*// snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma// kha la hrīṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma// dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma// spyi gtsug hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma// tshigs brgyad phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi kā// kun kyang lha nyid yi ge'i gzugs su shar// thugs srog 'od kyis snod bcud dngos 'dzin sbyangs// rdo rje btsun mo'i zhing skur lam gyis gsal// phaiṃ/ slar yang thugs ka'i bam̐ las 'od zer 'phros// lhan skyes zhing sngags rnal 'byor ma dpal kun// tshur 'dus dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrang la thim// dam tshig ye shes gnyis su med par gyur// oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/

thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng bcas pa las// 'phros pa'i 'od kyis 'phags mchod 'gro sgrib sbyangs// sras bcas rgyal ba'i byin rlabs nus mthu kun// bsdus thim bdag rgyud byin gyis brlabs par byas// oṃ oṃ oṃ

sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mkha' 'gro ma gang gi ched du/ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ rdo rje'i kha dog ma gang gi ched du/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad ma gang gi ched du/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes dam bcas pa'i grangs las mi nyung bar bzla/ spro na yid bzlas sogs kyang bya/ thun bsdu ba na/ khams gsum 'od zhu rang thim rang nyid kyang*// nā da'i bar thim 'od gsal dbyings su yal// slar yang rgyan dang phyag mtshan spangs pa yi// lha sku go chas mtshan par gsal bar gyur// ces brjod cing bsams la/ bsngo smon gyis mtshams sbyar te/ dga' ba gsum gyi rnal 'byor dang ma bral ba'i ngang spyod lam dge ba'i bya ba la 'jug par bya'o// zhes pa'ang blo dman rnams la sman pa'i slad/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog lhun grub kyi gsung rab kyi dgongs pa ji lta bar bya bral ba mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos tshigs bcad kyi phreng bar spel ba'i dge bas 'gro kun rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang mchog la myur du reg pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rnal 'byor ma'i bsnyen thabs nyung gsal bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru badz+ra yo gi n+yai/ dbang dang byin rlabs zab mos rgyud smin cing dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub myur du 'grub pa'i slad rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bsnyen pa byed pa'i tshul la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ gnas dben zhing yid dang mthun la rang dbang 'dus pa'i sar/ yar mar gyi tshes bcu lta bu'i dus khyad par can gyi snga dro'i char gnas khang phyag dar bya/ go yul gyi bde na rang nyid kha nub tu phyogs pa'i mal stan bshams pa'i 'og tu sna tshogs rdo rje bris pa'i lte bar 'bru dkar dang ku sha'i chun po dgram/

mdun du rnal 'byor ma'i bris sku yod na dgram pa'i spyan sngar gtor ma lnga tshar sogs ji ltar rigs pa mchod pa dang bcas pa dang*/ rang gi mdun du nang mchod/ rdor dril/ ḍā ma ru sogs nyer mkho'i yo byad dang*/ gzhan yang sngon 'gro gtor ma sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad 'du bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ phyi dro'i char gtor ma cha gsum gtang ba'am/ yang na skabs 'dir 'brel che bas sngon 'gro gtor ma dkyil chog nas 'byung ba bzhin la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsnyen sgrub zab mo bgyid par 'tshal na zhes dang bsnyen sgrub kyi bya ba zhes bsgyur/ gtor ma phyir bskyal ba dang mnyam du sngags gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brab/ bgegs rnams kyang rgyang ring du byer bar bsams la/ phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur bla bre ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung 'khor du gyur par mos te/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod pas brtan par bya/ sgo rtsar mi mang srung thub nges kyi tho brtsigs la dkar rtsis bran/ de nas mtshams dam par bcad de rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku bstod sogs chos spyod rgyas bsdus gang rigs kyi rjes/ mchod pa byin rlabs dang*/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi myong ba sngon du 'gro bas/ skyabs 'gro nas bsam mi khyab pa'i bar rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs sogs yig cha khungs thub ltar nyams su blang*/ thun mtshams kyi lhar ldang zhing sgrub thabs ltar gtor ma 'bul/ kye rdor dang gur zhal sogs yi dam chos skyong gi gtor bsngo gzhan byed na phyag len ltar shes par bya zhing*/ mi shes na/ dur khrod bdag po'i gtor bsngo dang*/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gnyis sam de yang mi nus na mkha' 'gro spyi gtor kho nas kyang 'thus/ gang ltar yang mthar go cha dgod cing bsngo smon sogs byas la thun grol nas ja sogs btung*/

slar srod thun la skyabs 'gro nas bsdu rim gyi bar dkyus ltar la/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyis nyal/ sang tho rangs ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis ldangs te bdud rtsi myong ba nas brtsams ji skad bshad pa'i nyams len rnams thun bzhir bcad la nyams su blang*/ gung thun gyi mtshams zas kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ phyi thun gyi mjug tu gtor 'bul sogs spyi ltar bya/ de yang bsnyen pa dngos gzhi yun ring thung la ltos te/ thog mar skyabs 'gro dang*/ rdor sems sgom bzlas gtso bor bton te so sor zhag bdun gsum sogs dang*/ de nas dngos gzhir/ gzhi'i bsnyen pa ni 'bum phrag bzhi kha skong dang bcas pa yin la/ 'bru 'bum byed na/ 'bum phrag sum cu so gnyis sam/ so lnga bzla zhes gsungs kyang*/ deng sang phyag len la 'bum phrag sum cu so bdun bzla bar mdzad do// bzlas dmigs gcig kho nas sems dub na/ sku'i rnam pa spyi dang*/ bye brag dang*/ sngags kyi gzugs dang*/ sgra rnams la so sor sems 'dzin pa dang*/ gnas lugs brjod bral gyi ngang du ngal gso ba/ snod chos 'byung gi zhing*/ bcud rnal 'byor ma'i sku/ sgrar grags pa thams cad oṃ gsum ma'i sngags su gsal ba la yid gtad pa sogs mdor na tha mal gyi rnam par rtog pa'i dbang du skad cig kyang mi gtong bar mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis dus 'da' bar bya zhing*/ gzhan mtshams kyi spang blang sogs bsnyen yig spyi ltar shes par byas nas nyams su blang ngo*// gsum pa rjes ni/ bsnyen pa'i grangs rdzogs pa dang*/ grub na sgrub pa'i mtshon byed du/ zhag bdun nam gsum sogs ji ltar rigs pa dkyil 'khor gsum tshul bzhin du bshams te sgrub mchod thun gnyis su bya/ yig cha paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga la kho bos bgyis pa'i zur 'debs dkyus ltar sbyar/ tshogs kyi mchod pa'ang thun so so'am phyi thun gyi mjug tu bgyis na legs/

kha skong gi sbyin sreg paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gi gsung rab ltar la/ sngags oṃ gsum ma dang*/ rdzas til 'ba' zhig la grangs bzung ba'i bsnyen pa'i bcu cha 'bul/ de nas gza' skar bzang ba'i thor thun gyi mjug tu gtor bsngo rgyas par bya zhing gtor ma 'bul/ tho rangs la mtshams grol te grogs dam tshig ldan pa rnams dang rim gyis 'phrad pa sogs spyi ltar bya ba nyid do// zhes pa'ang nyer mkho'i yan lag tu mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bris pa dge legs su gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la brten pa'i rgyun gyi tshogs mchod mdor bsdus pa bsod nams rtag pa dam pa'i sprin chen zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru badz+ra yo gi n+yai/ gang zhig snying rje chen pos yid lhag par drangs te/ dus myur ba nyid du gzhan don rdzogs byang gi go 'phang thob par 'dod pa'i don gnyer gyi rdo rje theg pa bla na med pa'i thabs la brten nas bde stong dbyer med kyi rtsis zin pas tshogs zung rgya mtsho skad cig gis rdzogs pa'i thabs lhur len pa dag gis/ bza' btung gi dngos po la brten rgyun gyi tshogs mchod mdor bsdus te bya ba'i tshul la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku bris 'bur gang rung ba'i spyan sngar rang nyid kyi bza' ba dang btung ba'i phud gtsang zhing bkod pas mdzes pa dang*/ 'byor na mchod pa'i bye brag gzhan yang ji ltar rigs pa bsham/ nang mchod chu chang gis bran pa'am/ chab gtsang mas bran/ dngos gzhi ni/ bdag gi rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro ba'am/ thun mtshams kyi lha sku sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi gsal snang brtan pos bza' btung gi dngos po rnams/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che bar tshogs rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bskol zhing 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'dod yon rgya mtsho'i sprin phung 'phro bar gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan mang du brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral ba'i dbyings su g.yon du bskor zhing*/ phaiṃ/ zhes brjod pa dang*/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas tshogs zhing mkha' khyab tu sad pa'i spyan sngar/ rang las sprul pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis bde stong gi nyams 'gyur phun sum tshogs pas mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtshos mchod pa la brten skyabs yul rnams zag med kyi bde bas mchog tu dgyes pas bdag gzhan yid can thams cad kyi tshogs zung mtha' dag skad cig gis rdzogs par mos la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gang shar bde stong rol pa las byung ba'i// tshogs mchod 'dod yon bdud rtsi'i sprin chen po// rtsa brgyud bla ma mchog gsum mnyes phyir 'bul// bzhes nas thugs rjes byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ gu ru tri rat+na sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs kyis bla ma dang dkon mchog oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gang shar bde stong rol pa las byung ba'i// tshogs mchod 'dod yon bdud rtsi'i sprin chen po// yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// bzhes nas mchog thun dngos grub stsal du gsol// oṃ maṇ+ḍa la de ba ga ṇa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis bla ma yi dam gyi lha spyi dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gang shar bde stong rol pa las byung ba'i// tshogs mchod 'dod yon bdud rtsi'i sprin chen po// rnal 'byor ma dpal 'khor bcas mnyes phyir 'bul// bzhes nas bde stong ye shes skyed du gsol/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī sogs kyi mthar/ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis khyad par rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/

gang shar bde stong rol pa las byung ba'i// tshogs mchod 'dod yon bdud rtsi'i sprin chen po// rdo rje'i chos srung rgya mtsho mnyes phyir 'bul// bzhes nas bar chad kun sol mthun rkyen sgrubs// oṃ shrī badz+ra dharmā pā la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis chos skyong srung ma/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gang shar bde stong rol pa las byung ba'i// tshogs mchod 'dod yon bdud rtsi'i sprin chen po// gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mnyes phyir 'bul// bzhes nas zab mo'i lam gyi grogs mdzod cig /mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi sngags sam/ oṃ tri s+thā na ḍā ka ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs kyis gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas par phul/ de nas tshogs kyi cha bar pa rang nyid kyis rol pa'i slad du/ bdag nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i// snying gar yi dam lha tshogs dang*// lte bar gtum mo'i me lce'i khrod// chos srung nor lha'i tshogs bcas gsal// tshogs mchod ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun// lag gnyis rdo rje'i dgang blugs kyis// phul bas zag med bde bas mnyes// mchog thun dngos grub stsol bar gyur// ces brjod cing bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis chos nyid gsal khyab kyi ngang du rol/ lhag ma/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥs brlabs/ phaiṃ/ ush+tsi ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa sī/ gang shar bde stong rol pa las byung ba'i// lhag ma'i 'dod yon bdud rtsi'i sprin chen po// 'byung po lhag mar dbang ba'i tshogs la sbyin// ngoms shing tshims pa'i skal ba ldan gyur cig /ces brjod cing phyi rol gtsang sar bskyal/ spro na rdo rje'i glu'am dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu blangs/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings nas legs byung ba'i// he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku// shes rab phag mo'i pad+mar rdo rjes rol mdzad pa'i// bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog
