/'chi tshe mgon dang dpa' bo ma tshogs kyi// zhes sogs dang*/ lha mo tshad ma sogs smon lam gdab/ mthar/ oṃ gu ru badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hās phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs kyis bstod/ yi ge brgya pa'i mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ rten yod pa rnams/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hās me tog 'thor zhing brtan bzhugs bya/ rten med pa'i gtor mgron/ badz+ra muḥs gshegs/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rnal 'byor ma dpal 'grub 'gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces bsngo smon dang*/ gnas 'dir nyin mo bde legs sogs shis brjod ji ltar rigs pas mtshams sbyar te de ltar phul ba'i tshogs rdzas rgya che ba yod na yon tan gyi zhing bla ma dang dge 'dun la chos ston du gsol ba'am/ phan 'dogs pa'i zhing nad pa dang dbul phongs sogs la sbyin pas mtshon slar yang tshogs zung spel ba'i thabs la brtson par bya'o// zhes pa'ang yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ngag gi dbang phyug byams pa phun tshogs kyis 'di ltar bris zhes lha rdzas kyi me tog dang bcas bka' stsal phebs pa gus pas mchod de bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bris pa'i dge bas 'gro kun tshogs zung rgya mtsho myur du rdzogs nas mkha' spyod rdo rje btsun mo'i go 'phang tshe gcig kho nas reg pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ ༈ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i tshogs mchod bya tshul mdor bsdus pa bsod nams sprin gyi gru char zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru we/ dran pa tsam gyis mkha' spyod mchog ster ba// bla ma rdo rje btsun mo la btud nas// gang de tshogs kyi mchod pas mnyes byed tshul// bsod nams sprin gyi gru char 'dir 'bebs so// de la 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod sogs dang 'brel bar tshogs kyi mchod pa mdor bsdus bya ba'i tshul la/

sbyor 'jug gi chos rnams gzhan du shes par byas nas/ dngos gzhi'i cho ga la/ thog mar byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ ma dā na dang bā la sogs pa'i yo byad rnams la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor zhing*/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ snod bcud thams cad mi dmigs stong par gyur// stong pa'i ngang las a yig yongs gyur las// phyi snod bde chen ye shes ka pā la// yangs shing rgya che stong gsum khyon dang mnyam// de dbus nang bcud sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga// 'od du zhu las ye shes bdud rtsi'i sprin// 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa thams cad pa// zag med 'char ba nam mkha'i mdzod du gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum/ tshogs zhing spyan drangs pa ni/ phaiṃ/ 'og min rdo rje btsun mo'i zhing khams dang*// sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor nas// rgyal kun yum gyur rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// rtsa brgyud bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems dang*// yi dam lha tshogs dpa' bo rnal 'byaur ma// chos skyong srung ma nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas// longs spyod tshogs kyi 'du bar spyan 'dren na// tshad med thugs rje'i dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas mkha' khyab tu byon par bsam/ de nas sman phud 'thor la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dman pa'i spyod yul dag las rab 'das shing*// rgyal ba kun gyi bsten bya'i dam tshig mchog /dngos grub rnam gnyis kun gyi gzhir gyur pa// zag med bdud rtsi mchog gi mchod pa 'di// phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas kyi// mkhyen brtse nus gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i dngos// dran pas srid zhi'i rgud pa kun sel ba'i// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// rdo rje 'chang chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// grub chen nā ro ta pa pham thing pa// shes rab brtsegs dang mal gyo sa skya pa// rje btsan sku mched zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// sa skya paṇa chen 'phags pa rin po che// dkon mchog dpal dang chos rje bsod nams dpal// bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal ldan tshul khrims zhabs// ye shes rgyal mtshan zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// ngor chen rdo rje 'chang dngos kun dga' bzang*// sems dpa' chen po bdag chen rdo rje 'chang*// kun spangs chos rje kun dga' legs pa dang*// tshar chen chos rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug bslab gsum rgyal mtshan dang*// dbang phyug rab brtan bsod nams mchog ldan zhabs// bsod nams mchog grub mkhyen rab byams pa'i dpal// kun dga' lhun grub zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang dbang kun blo'i zhabs// nam mkha' 'chi med bstan pa'i nyi ma dang*// ngag gi dbang po khyab bdag kun dga' mtshan// 'jam dpal bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// gzhan yang tshad med thugs rje'i sprin mdzes las// dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag bdud rtsi yis// bdag blo'i thar pa'i myu gu 'phel mdzad pa// dngos brgyud bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dhā ḍā ki sogs nas phaṭa swā hā/

khyad par dran pa tsam gyis lhan skyes kyi// ye shes rmad du byung ba sbyin mdzad pa// rgyal kun yum gcig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// skyabs gnas kun 'dus zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// gzhan yang bya ba spyod pa rnal 'byor dang*// rnal 'byor bla med rgyud dang rjes 'brel ba'i// gang 'dul sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rnam rol can// yi dam lha tshogs zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje'i chos srung nor lha rgya mtsho dang*// gnas gsum bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma// yul lha gzhi bdag rigs drug tshogs bcas rnams// lha ru gsal ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// sgrib pa gnyis kyi dri ma kun bsal nas// gzung 'dzin rtogs pa kun las rnam grol ba// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems kyi dngos// bde ba chen po'i mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ tshogs phud cha gsum du bsgos la/ phud dang po bla ma dang dkon mchog la 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas kyi// ye shes sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rnam rol can// bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la// zag med bdud rtsi'i tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul// zhes pa'i mthar spro na/ khyab bdag dang po'i sangs rgyas rdo rje chos// rgyal ba'i yum gyur rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// grub pa'i dbang po rdo rje dril bu par// zag med bdud rtsi'i tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul// zhes sogs kyis phul ba'am/ bsdu na/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang nas bzung ste// paṇa grub dbang po nā ro ta pa sogs// 'phags bod brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad la// zag med bdud rtsi'i tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul// zhes pa'i mthar/ spangs rtogs mthar phyin rgyal ba sras bcas dang*// yi dam dkyil 'khor 'khor lo rab 'byams sogs// skyabs gnas mchod 'os rgya mtsho thams cad la// zag med bdud rtsi'i tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul// bzhes nas bdag dang mtha' yas sems can kun// bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs shing*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnam gnyis kyis// phan bde'i dga' ston rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dho sa twa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis phul/

phud bar pa yi dam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phul te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ e dbyings rdo rje btsun mo'i grong khyer du// bam̐ yig bde ba chen po'i rol rtsed las// zung 'jug mtshan dpe'i gzugs su yongs shar ba// skyabs gnas kun 'dus rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// dran pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi// rnam kun mchog ldan lang tsho dar babs shing*// yid 'ong spyan gyi zur mdas reg pa'i mod// sgrub po mkha' spyod grong du 'khrid mdzad pa'i// gnas gsum zhing sngags lhan cig skyes pa yi// grangs med ḍā ki rgya mtsho'i 'khor dang bcas// mkha' dbyings khyab par bzhugs pa'i tshogs rnams la// zhal zas bdud rtsi'i tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul// bzhes nas bdag dang mtha' yas sems can kun// sku gsung thugs kyi gsang bas rjes bzung nas// gnas skabs mkha' spyod grong du dbugs dbyungs shing*// mthar thug mchog dngos 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes dang*/ oṃ gsum ma'i mthar a kā ro btags pas phul/ phud tha ma mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma sogs la 'bul te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje'i ye shes 'bar ba'i me po che// log 'dren bgegs kyi bud shing kun bsregs nas// grub gnyis snang ba rtag tu rgyas mdzad pa'i// chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams thams cad dang*// sgrub pa po yi rgyud la lhan skyes kyi// ye shes rmad du byung ba'i dpal ster ba// gnas yul dur khrod kun na bzhugs pa yi// sprul pa'i gar mdzad dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma// bsod nams nor bu'i sprin chen rol pa las// 'dod dgu'i gru char lhug par 'bebs mkhas pas// srid zhi'i 'byor pa mtha' dag sbyin mdzad pa'i// gnod sbyin nor lha rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas dang*// gzhan yang yul lha gzhi bdag rigs drug mgron// thams cad ye shes gcig gis byin rlabs pas// mkha' spyod dga' ma'i gzugs su yongs shar bar// zhal zas bdud rtsi'i tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul// bzhes nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi// lam gyi 'gal rkyen mtha' dag nyer zhi zhing*// mthun rkyen ma lus yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*// mchog thun dngos grub thob pa'i phrin las mdzod// zhes dang*/

chos skyong so so'i gtor sngags dang*/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi sngags kyis phul/ yan lag brgyad ldan mchod yon rgya mtsho dang*// dri med gaṅgā'i rgyun gyi zhabs bsil sbreng*// rab mdzes mtshar sdug rdzogs pa'i me tog dang*// bdug spos sprin gyi dud pas phyogs kun khyab// nyi zla nor bu'i sgron me'i snang gsal dang*// ga bur tsan+dan bgos pa'i dri chab g.yo// ro brgya ldan pa'i zhal zas sna tshogs dang*// dbyangs bdun snyan 'gyur rdzogs pa'i rol mor bcas// bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dang*// rgyal kun yum gyur rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod 'bul/ byin rlabs rmad byung rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// dngos grub mchog stsol yi dam dkyil 'khor lha// skyabs gnas dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la// sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo// chos sku'i ngang las lhan skyes longs spyod rdzogs// zhing skyes sprul pa'i rnam rol mtha' yas bdag /sngags skyes dkyil 'khor 'khor lor yongs shar ba'i// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// zhi dang khro chags rnam 'phrul sna tshogs kyis// 'gal rkyen sel zhing mthun rkyen bsgrubs mdzad pa// chos skyong srung ma nor lha rgya mtsho dang*// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha// rgyal kun yum gyur rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams dang*// gzhan yang ye shes gcig gi rnam rol la// mchog dang dman pa'i rtog pa ma dmigs phyir// yul lha gzhi bdag rigs drug tshogs bcas la// 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa thams cad pa// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa phul ba'i mthus// 'gro la phan bde ma lus 'byung ba'i sgo// rgyal ba'i bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang*// bstan 'dzin skyes bu thams cad zhabs brtan cing*// bshad sgrub phrin las 'phel bar mdzad du gsol// 'jig rten pa kun yang dag lta ba la// gus shing rnam dkar las la brtson pa'i mthus// snod bcud phun sum tshogs pa'i ngo mtshar gyi// dge mtshan nub pa med par mdzad du gsol// gzhan yang rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// gnas skabs 'jigs chen brgyad dang bcu drug sogs// dam chos bsgrub la 'tshe ba'i 'gal rkyen kun// zhi ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzad du gsol// tshe bsod dpal 'byor thos bsam shes rab dang*// khyad par rim pa gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin// gong nas gong du 'phel zhing brtan pa yis// grub gnyis dga' ston rgyas par mdzad du gsol// brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad skad cig tsam// dran pa'i mod nas dbang du bgyid nus pa'i// brtul zhugs zla med sngags rigs grub pa yis// phun tshogs mtha' dag 'du bar mdzad du gsol// zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul du ma 'tshal ba'i// nag po'i rtsa lag sder bcas dpung tshogs kun// drag po'i phrin las mchog gis tshar bcad nas// ming gi lhag mar bgyid par mdzad du gsol// tshe yi mthar yang dpal ldan bla ma dang*// dbyer med rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis mdun bdar nas// mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid par mdzad du gsol// mdor na myur du zung 'jug phyag rgya che'i// go 'phang mchog de mngon sum brnyes pa dang*// de ma thob pa'i tshe rabs thams cad du// don gnyis yid bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol// zhes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/

de nas tshogs pa mang po yod na zhu 'bul sogs tshul bzhin bya/ gang ltar yang mthar/ 'dod pa'i yon tan sna tshogs sprin 'phro ba'i// bza' bca' btung ba'i khyad par rnam mang po// ting nge 'dzin gyi mig 'phrul las byung ba// ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho'i mchod sprin 'dis// rang sems bla ma yi dam rnal 'byor ma// dbyer med sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i dngos// snying dbus bam̐ yig thig ler rtag mchod na// 'du 'bral med pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes brjod cing bsam la tshim par rol/ mthar lhag ma chu chang gis bran la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lhag ma'i gtor ma zhal zas bdud rtsi'i sprin// 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa thams cad pa// zad pa med pa nam mkha'i mdzod lta bu// dpag yas srid zhi'i khams kun khyab par gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis brlabs/ phaiṃ/ zhes pas mgron bkug nas/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi ush+tsi ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa sī swā hā/ zhes dang*/ 'byung po lhag ma dbang ba'i tshogs rnams la// 'dod yon tshogs kyi lhag ma 'di sbyin na// zag med bde ba mchog gis lus dang sems// ngoms shing tshim pa'i skal pa ldan gyur cig /ces pas bsngos la phyi rol du dor/ shis pa brjod pa dang*/ smon lam gyis mtha' bsdus/ 'di ni rang nyid kho na tsam gyis bya ba'i tshul yin la/ tshogs pa mang po yod na bar mtshams rnams su zhu 'bul sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar bya'o// smras pa/ bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa dang*// dam tshig nyams chags nyes ltung kun byang ba'i// thabs tshul sprin gyi gru char g.yo ba 'dis// phan bde'i pad+mo rtag tu rgyas gyur cig /zhes pa'ang sgrub brtson dam pa dge slong 'jam dpal bstan 'dzin gyis/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyi mchod pa bya tshul tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis bsdebs pa rgyas bsdus 'di lta bu zhig sbyar bar 'os so zhes nan tan gyis bskul ba'i ngo ma ldog par/

dam pa snga ma rnams kyis mdzad pa dang mthun par/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal po byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin sogs yongs 'dzin dam pa du ma'i gsung gi bdud rtsis reg pa'i rmongs brtul gyi na ba gzhon nu mkhyen brtse'i ming can gyis dpal e wam̐ chos ldan gyi bla brang thar pa rtser sbyar ba la/ rang bzo'i nongs pa'i cha shas mchis pa thams cad snying nas bshags shing*/ dge bas 'gro kun rje btsun rdo rje btsun mo'i go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba dā maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la bstod cing gsol ba gdab pa mkha' spyod ḍā ki dgyes pa'i rol mo ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru sh+tsā bhe da badz+ra yo gi n+yai/ rab dmar rnam thar gsum ldan dkyil 'khor dbus// rab sgeg pad+ma baṃ ro nyi ma'i steng*// rab mdzes bden gnyis zhal can rnal 'byor ma// rab 'byams rgyal ba kun yum bstod par bgyi// shin tu rnam dag rnam kun mchog ldan las// zung 'jug sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i zlos gar ni// bzhin legs mtshan dpe'i snang char yongs shar ba'i// longs spyod yongs rdzogs 'khor lor phyag 'tshal bstod// thabs mchog he ru kaḥdapal lang tsho la// shes rab dbyings kyi btsun mo'i sgyu ma yis// e wam̐ gnyis su med par legs 'khyud pa'i// kha sbyor rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// gzung 'dzin srid pa'i 'pho chags rgyu dang bcas// zag bral dpyid kyi thig ler 'char ba las// 'bar g.yo brtan pa'i nyams brgyas sgeg pa po// bde chen nā da'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod// rdul bral zhi ba dam pa'i grong khyer du// rnam mang spros pa'i 'jug ldang sim gyur pas// gnyis snang glo bur mtshan ma las grol ba'i// rang bzhin med pa'i thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod// gzhan phyir brtse ba'i brlan gyis drangs pa yis// khyod zhabs nor bu'i chu gter la reg pas// grub gnyis 'dod dgu lhug par 'jo ba'i phyir// yon tan snying rjes yongs gang phyag 'tshal bstod// brtan g.yo kun la khyab pa'i bdag nyid ni// mtha' klas yid can khams dbang bsam pa dang*// rjes su mthun par sna tshogs gzugs 'chang ba'i// phrin las rgyun mi chad la phyag 'tshal bstod// mchog tu mi 'gyur chos dbyings snying po las// thabs mkhas ye shes sku yi rol mo yis// srid dang zhi ba'i pha mthar mi gnas pa'i// rnam 'phrul 'gogs pa med la phyag 'tshal bstod// de ltar bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// gnas skabs lam mchog sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen gegs// mtha' dag spangs shing mthun rkyen phun tshogs pas// rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i bdud rtsis smin par shog

/khyad par phyi snod thar pa chen po'i grong*// nang bcud 'gro kun rje btsun ḍā ki'i skur// yongs shar tha mal snang zhen kun bcom pas// bum dbang grub mtha' rnyogs par byin gyis rlobs// shes rab rdo rje rnal 'byor gtum mo'i mes// thabs mchog bde chen dam tshig bsregs bzhu'i phul// zung 'jug dhū ti'i dbyings su thim pa las// gsang dbang grub mtha' rnyogs par byin gyis rlobs// dngos yid phyag rgya mdzes ma'i snyoms 'jug gis// char yang e wam̐ mā yar drangs pa'i mod// zhu bde mi rtogs dga' bzhi'i ting 'dzin ros// sher dbang grub mtha' rnyogs par byin gyis rlobs// lhan skyes bde stong 'bar ba'i snang ba ches// mkha' khyab mkha' yi rdo rje btsun mo'i zhal// dus gsum 'du 'bral med par mjal ba yis// tshig dbang grub mtha' rnyogs par byin gyis rlobs// gal te dus 'dir grub mtha' ma rnyogs na// nam zhig 'phos tshe dpa' bo rnal 'byor mas// yid 'ong mchod pa'i sprin gyis mdun bdar te// dag pa'i zhing du 'khrid par byin gyis rlobs// mthar thug gnas dang yul gyi rlung sems kun// 'od gsal a ba dhū tir phyag byas pas// sku gsum dbyer med badz+ra wā ra hī'i// go 'phang mchog la 'gro kun 'dren gyur cig /de ltar au ḍī yā ni sa spyod dbang po'i blos legs par bkral ba'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la bstod cing gsol ba gdab pa mkha' spyod ḍā ki dgyes pa'i rol mo zhes bya ba 'di yang gtsug lag du mar gzigs pa'i spyan yangs bla ma dam pa wā gin+d+ra su sid+dhi'i bkas bskul ba las/ kun rmongs dā ri dra pa tshangs sras dgyes pa'i blo ldan du bod pas yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas dpal e wam̐ chos ldan gyi bla brang thar pa rtser sbyar ba dza yan+tu// ༈ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyi mchod pa'i rdo rje'i glu bde chen rtag pa dam pa'i sprin gyi rol mo zhes bya ba//

༈ /'od gsal rnam kun mchog ldan ye shes kyi rol mo// zung 'jug dwangs ma'i gzugs skur mngon sum du shar ba// dran pas snying gi gdung sel dpal ldan gyi bla mas// bde stong ye shes skyes bar byin gyis rang rlobs shig /e dbyings shin tu rnam dag spros bral gyi gnas lugs// wam̐ yig bcu drug dga' ba'i mtshan dpe ru bzhengs pa'i// lhan skyes mkha' la spyod pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang mos// rlung sems dbu mar thim pa'i dngos grub zhig stsol dang*// yul chen nyi shu rtsa bzhir rang bzhin gyis snang ba'i// thabs shes phyag rgya'i gzugs 'chang dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gros// zhing skyes pho nya'i tshogs kyi 'du ba la brten nas// bde chen nyams brgyas sgeg pa'i skal bzang la sbyor zhig /stong nyid mkha' la bris pa'i ting 'dzin gyi nyams 'gyur// ngo mtshar dbang po'i gzhu bzhin sna tshogs su 'char ba'i// sngags skyes rdo rje btsun mo'i bsam gtan gyi dga' ma// cir snang bde chen 'dren pa'i skyo grogs la phebs dang*// rmad byung rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang gi mthar thug /rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i bdud rtsi'i dga' ston la spyod pas// brtan g.yo'i tshul du shar ba'i tha mal gyi dngos kun// he ru ka dpal 'grub pa'i smon lam zhig zhu'o// zhes pa'ang 'jam mgon bla ma rin po che ngag gi dbang phyug byams pa phun tshogs dpal bzang pos 'di ltar bris zhes rdo rje'i bka' stsal spyi bor mchod de/ bya bral ba kun tu rgyu mañdzu gho ṣas gsol ba btab pa sid+dhi rastu// ༈ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo tshim pa drug ldan gyi smon lam dpa' bo dang ḍā ki dgyes pa'i glu gar ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /ting nge 'dzin gyis sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor lha// phyi nang mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po yis// zag med bde chen ngang du tshim pa'i mthus// bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs par shog

/snying dbus pad+ma'i ge sar bzhad pa'i rtser// rang sems bla ma yi dam dbyer med pa// ye shes bdud rtsis tshim pa'i byin rlabs kyis// gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i kun rtog 'ching gyur cig /chos skyong 'byung po'i tshogs rnams ji snyed pa// rnam mang 'dod yon rgya mtshor 'khyil ba'i dpyid// bza' bca' btung ba'i gtor mas tshim pa las// bar chad kun sel phrin las 'grub par shog /smin byed dbang thob sdom gsum la gnas pa'i// rnal 'byor pa rnams khyad par bza' ba yi// dam tshig tshogs kyi 'khor los tshim pa dang*// ting 'dzin zas la rtag tu spyod gyur cig /skye mched

lus dkyil lha/ lha rnams rdo rje'i glu gar dang*// bde stong rol mo'i sgra yis nyer tshim nas// gang shar snang ba lha dang ye shes kyi// dag pa'i snang ba gcig tu 'char bar shog /dngos kun bde chen lhan cig skyes pa yi// ye shes mchog gis rtag tu tshim pa las// 'khor 'das dbyer mi phyed pa'i thig le ru// phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub brnyes gyur cig /mdor na phyi nang dkyil 'khor 'khor lo kun// zag med tshogs kyi 'du bas mnyes pa'i mthus// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i dge legs kyi// bkra shis snang ba sa gsum khyab par shog /zhes pa'ang gzhon nu mkhyen brtse'i ming can gyis blo mtsho las byung ba'o// ༈ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bkra shis dge legs mchog sbyin ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /rdo rje 'chang chen kha sbyor bdun gyi go 'phang brnyes// rnal 'byor ma dpal shes rab zag med bde bas myos// nā ro ta pa paṇa grub rgya mtsho'i gtsug gi nor// bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /pham mthing sku mched 'khor lo sdom pa'i sngags rig grub// shes rab brtsegs ni skad gnyis smra ba'i pha rol son// blo gros grags pa bar dor mchog gi dngos grub brnyes// bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /kun dga' snying po pad dkar 'chang ba mi yi zol// bsod nams rtse mo mkha' spyod grong du yud kyis gshegs// grags pa rgyal mtshan gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i mdzod du gyur// bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /sa skya paṇa chen 'dzam gling 'di na mkhas pa'i phul// 'phags pa'i mtshan can khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla mar gyur// zhang ston chos rje zab rgyas gdams pa'i dpal la rol// bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /puṇ+ya shrī rtse gcig sgrub pa'i srog shing 'dzin// bsod nams rgyal mtshan thams cad mkhyen par yongs su grags// seṅge'i mtshan can snyan brgyud rgya mtsho'i bka' babs che// bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog

/rgyal ba mchog dbyangs lung rtogs yon tan dpal gyis phyug /nam mkha'i mtshan can mkhyen rab mthu stobs pha mtha' yas// blo gros rgyal mtshan brtse ba chen po'i rnam 'khrul dngos// bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /rdo ring pa ni grub reg bye ba'i gtsug na mdzes// tshar pa chos rje rtsod pa'i dus kyi rdo rje 'chang*// mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs ngur smrig bla gos can// bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bslab gsum rgyal mtshan snyan brgyud bstan pa'i srog shing che// dbang phyug rab brtan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i 'khor los sgyur// bsod nams mchog ldan zab rgyas chos kyi mdzod gcig pu// bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bsod nams mchog grub rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i pha mthar son// mkhyen rab byams pa grub gnyis dpal la bdag gir spyod// kun dga' lhun grub snyigs dus bstan pa'i gsal byed che// bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /gnas gsar chos rje smra ba'i seṅger yongs su grags// kun dga' blo gros mkhas dang grub pa'i pha rol son// nam mkha' 'chi med yongs rdzogs bstan pa rgya mtsho'i bdag /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bstan pa'i nyi ma rdo rje btsun mo mi yi zol// ngag gi dbang po zab rgyas snyan brgyud rgya mtsho'i bdag /kun dga'i mtshan can sras bcas rgyal ba'i ye shes sku// bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /rtsa ba'i bla ma rigs kun bdag po'i rnam rol gyis// dran pa tsam gyis mkha' spyod dngos grub ster ba la// rnal 'byor ma dang gnyis su med par nges rnyed pa'i// bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /chos sku'i ngang las lhan skyes longs spyod rdzogs sku'i gzugs// zhing skyes sprul pas 'gro ba 'dul ba'i rnam rol can// sngags skyes mkha' spyod dga' ma'i mtshan bzang bsgoms pa yi// bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog

/grub brnyes rnal 'byor dbang phyug bye ba gshegs pa'i shul// he ru kaḥdapal nyung ngu'i rgyud kyi snying po'i phul// bklags pa tsam gyis grub pa'i gsang sngags rab bzlas pa'i// bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /kha sbyor cho gas rlung sems dbu mar 'ching ba dang*// bde chen 'bar dang 'dzag pa'i zlos gar ci yang rtsen// gsal stong brjod bral gnyug ma'i ngang du mnyam bzhag pa'i// bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /thabs shes phyogs kyi ḍā ki 'du ba'i dus bzang por// rnal 'byor ma dpal dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa dang*// zag med bdud rtsi tshogs kyi 'du bas mnyes byas pa'i// bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /gnas skabs rnam bzhi'i phrin las kun la dbang 'byor zhing*// 'chi tshe mkha' spyod grub pa'i grong du rol pa las// mthar thug rtsa rlung thig le e wam̐ dbyings thim nas// sku gsum dbyer med go 'phang brnyes pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa'ang gzhon nu mkhyen brtse'i ming can gyi blo mtsho las byung ba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi brgyud pa'i bla ma la phyag 'tshal zhing gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bzhugs so// ༈ /gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// gang gis skye dang 'jig pa dag /ring du yongs su spangs gyur pa// sems can kun la thams cad du// phan dgongs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyud rnams kun gyi don 'dzin cing*// sems can kun la phan brtson pa'i// kun mchog rdo rje 'chang dbang la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// rdzogs sangs rgyas las mngon sum du// khyod kyis chos rnams thugs chud cing*// mda' 'dzin spyod pa mdzad pa las// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// thub pas thub par lung bstan cing*// chos rnams don ston klu sgrub mchog

/bde ba can du gshegs pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// nyid kyi de nyid mchog brnyes nas// dman mos sems can don gyi phyir// rngon pa'i cha lugs 'dzin pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// yi ge'i sbyor ba spangs nas su// brtson pas nya rgyu gsol mdzad de// brtse bas gzhan don mdzad pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// rgyal po'i bya ba rab spangs nas// sbrul tshong rjes su bsgrub mdzad de// kañtsī grong du grub pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// ye shes mkha' 'gros rjes gnang zhing*// gzhan don spyod pa mngon sum mdzad// rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// dam pa'i de nyid don rtogs te// brtse bas ru sbal zhabs ldan pa// sems can smin par mdzad pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// khyod ni brtse bas grub brnyes te// 'bar bas 'bar ba'i spyod pa 'dzin// kun las phan par mdzad pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// nus pa la ni mnga' mnyes shing*// spyod pa kun gyi rmad byung ba// 'jig rten 'dren pa mdzad pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// rnal 'byor dbang phyug gu h+ya ba// brtse bas log 'dren rnal 'byor ma// btul nas 'gro ba skyong ba la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// mi mthun phyogs rnams rab spangs te// dkar po rnam par 'phel mdzad pa// rnam par rgyal ba'i zhabs pad la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// grub nas grub pa'i lam ston cing*// grol nas rnam par phan mdzad pa// bar ma'i slob dpon dam pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// til rdung pas ni rab grub pa// skal ldan gzhan la brtse ba can// mu stegs rnam par sun 'byin cing*// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// bram ze las ni rab byung zhing*// gnas lnga la ni rab sbyangs pas// dka' bas dam pa bsten pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// shes bya la ni rab sbyangs shing*// nus pa kun las thogs med ldan// pha na phing gur grags pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// skad gnyis smra ba'i mchog gyur cing*// shes rab ldan pas phan mdzad pa// brtsegs pa'i mtha' dang ldan pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// brtson pas dka' ba cher mdzad de// rgyud kun 'dzin mdzad skad gnyis smra// rje btsun blo gros grags pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis mngon sum du// khyod la byin gyis brlabs pa yis// shes bya kun la thogs med ldan// rgyud rnams kun gyi bdag por gyur// kun dga' snying por grags pa yi// dpal ldan sa skyar bzhugs gyur cing*// bde ba can du gshegs pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// gang gi sras kyi thu bo ba// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin rlabs pas// gnas lnga la ni rab mkhas shing*// bsod nams ye shes rtser gyur pa// nyid kyis gzhan don rdzogs mdzad nas// 'jig rten rnams ni gzhug pa'i phyir// bde ba can du mngon sum gshegs// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// khyod kyi thugs ni 'jam dbyangs ltar// shes bya kun la ma rmongs shing*// 'jig rten kun la rtsa lag ltar// dgongs pa khyod kyi grags pa yi// rgyal mtshan dri ma med pa thob// ngo mtshar du ma'i spyod pa 'dzin// kun nas yon tan ldan khyod la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// brtse bas sems can thams cad la// dpal 'byor chen po'i 'od zer gyis// rtag tu skyong bar mdzad khyod la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid ngur smrig gi

/chos gos 'dzin par legs sprul pa'i// sa skya paṇa chen zhabs pad la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// 'khor los sgyur ba'i dpal 'byor dang*// mkhas shing grub pa'i blo gros can// chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// sbyangs pa'i yon tan lhur mdzad pas// rim pa gnyis la thugs brtan pa// zhang ston dkon mchog dpal ba la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// bla ma'i zhabs tog dka' ba spyad// rtse gcig sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin// grub chen bsod nams dpal ba la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rjes bzung ste// 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i khrir 'khod pa'i// 'gro mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// snyan brgyud gdams pa'i dpal ldan zhing*// rnam dag tshul khrims gos bzang can// rgyal sras rdo rje 'dzin pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// gnyis med ye shes legs gzigs shing*// gzhan phan lhag bsam cher bskyed pa'i// chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// e wam̐ rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu// zung 'jug chos kyi sku brnyes pa// kun bzang rdo rje 'chang chen la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// gcig tu bsgrub la brtson mdzad cing*// rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin pa'i// mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// bsod nams gangs ri'i spor gnas shing*// lung dang rig pa'i mche sder can// kun mkhyen smra ba'i seṅge la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// rig pa'i gnas kun rab sbyangs te// grub pa'i sa brnyes chos kyi rje// grags pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// dkon mchog gsum dang dbyer med cing*// lhag pa'i lha yi ngo bo nyid// nges don gdams pa 'phel mdzad la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// mkhyen pas shes bya'i de nyid gzigs// brtse dang nus pa rmad byung ba// rje btsun legs pa'i 'byung gnas la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// dam chos rin chen kun gyi gter// dge 'dun 'dus pa'i gtsug rgyan pa// rig pa'i gnas lnga la sbyangs shing*// grub pa'i byin rlabs bka' bab pa// 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// shes bya thams cad mngon sum du// gzigs nas gzhan la 'doms mkhas pa// rje btsun dkon mchog lhun grub la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// phyi nang rig gzhung rgya mtsho gzigs// grub pa'i go 'phang mchog brnyes pa// paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa nyid// ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i rnam rol can// kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// gsan bsam sgom pa'i mthar son nas// 'chad rtsod rtsom pas gzhan don mdzad// mkhas grub dpal mchog rgyal mtshan la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// bla ma rnams dang lhag pa'i lhas// rjes bzung phrin las mtha' yas pa// 'jam mgon sangs rgyas phun tshogs la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// rim gnyis zab mo'i rnal 'byor gyis// grub pa gnyis kyi mthar phyin pa// mtshungs med bsod nams dpal ldan la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// rmad byung dam pa'i rigs 'khrungs shing*// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mdzod du gyur// 'dren mchog nam mkha' bsam 'grub la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// sras bcas rgyal ba'i ye shes sku// snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma mchog

/sa chen kun dga' blo gros la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// mkhas shing grub pa'i gtsug rgyan che// yongs rdzogs bstan pa rgya mtsho'i bdag /rje btsun nam mkha' 'chi med la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// rnal 'byor dbang phyug brtse ba che'i// zab gsang snyan brgyud rgya mtsho'i bdag /mkhan chen 'jam dpal bzang po la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i dngos// dran pas srid zhi'i gdung sel ba// dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// dngos kun khyab bdag bde ba'i mchog /gsang gsum 'khor lo'i he ru ka /shes rab sgyu ma'i btsun mo dang*// rol mdzad bde ba chen por 'dud// zung 'jug de nyid ma thob bar// rje btsun bla mas rjes bzung ste// mngal sgong rdzus skyes dkyil 'khor du// sbyin bya dbang bzhis smin par shog /zab mo'i lam gyi rtsa ba mchog /thun mong thun mong ma yin pa'i// 'khor lo sdom pa'i dam tshig rnams// ma nyams tshul bzhin bsrung bar shog /ma dag skye gnas bzhi sbyangs pa'i// gsal dag bskyed rim legs bsgoms te// snang ba lha ru 'char ba dang*// zhi sogs phrin las dbang bsgyur shog /brgyud rim gnas lugs shes byas nas// sngags rim gtum mo'i rnal 'byor gyis// ye shes dga' bzhi'i rim pa bskyed// gsang ba'i rim pa 'grub par shog /de ltar rim gnyis la brtson pas// drod thob spyod pas mtshams sbyar te// rab dga' la sogs sa bgrod nas// rtse gcig phyag chen 'grub par shog /khyad par skye ba 'di nyid la// mtshan 'dzin kun rtog rab spangs nas// ḍeṃ gi dha ri ka pa bzhin// gsang chen spyod pa mthar phyin shog /'khor lo sdom pa'i rnal 'byor dang*// nam yang mi 'bral gnas gsum gyi// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang lhan cig gnas// rig 'dzin dbang po nyid gyur cig /bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang*// yi dam mkha' 'gro'i nus mthu yis// bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can kun// zung 'jug rdo rje'i sa thob shog

/ces pa'ang rje btsun sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa'i 'khor lo bde mchog gi bla brgyud gsol 'debs kyi brgyud pa phyi ma rnams rim par bsnan pa 'jam mgon kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa'i nā ro mkha' spyod kyi dkyil chog las 'byung ba ltar la/ dkon mchog lhun grub man chad kyi kha skong rnams ngor e wam̐ pa chen po nas brgyud pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud rim dang mthun par 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bris pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ bha wan tu// ༈ /nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i brgyud 'debs bsdus pa bzhugs so// ༈ /rdo rje 'chang chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// grub chen nā ro ta pa pham mthing pa// shes rab brtsegs dang mal gyo sa skya pa// rje btsun sku mched rnams la gsol ba 'debs// sa skya paṇa chen 'phags pa rin po che// dkon mchog dpal dang chos rje brag phug pa// bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal ldan tshul khrims dang*// ye shes rgyal mtshan rnams la gsol ba 'debs// ngor chen rdo rje 'chang dbang sems dpa' che// bdag chen chos rje kun spang rdo ring pa// tshar chen rje dang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang*// bslab gsum rgyal mtshan rnams la gsol ba 'debs// dbang phyug rab brtan bsod nams mchog ldan dang*// bsod nams mchog grub mkhyen rab byams pa'i dpal// rmor chen rje dang khyab bdag gnas gsar ba// kun dga' blo gros rnams la gsol ba 'debs// nam mkha' 'chi med bstan pa'i nyi ma dang*// ngag dbang rin chen rigs rnams kun gyi bdag /kun dga' bstan 'dzin 'jam dpal bzang po dang*// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bskyed rim zab mo mkha' spyod rnal 'byor dang*// rdzogs rim dbu ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i mthus// bde chen lhan skyes ye shes skye ba dang*// mkha' spyod go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs// yang yar klung pa nas brgyud pa ltar na/

brag phug pa yan chad 'dra de nas/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan grub mchog yar klung pa// bsod nams rgyal mchog rnams la gsol ba 'debs// 'jam dbyangs chen po nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dang*// bdag chen chos rje sogs man 'dra'o// zhes pa'ang rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs la/ bla ma phyi ma rnams kyi zhal skong mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bris pa dge/ ༈ /bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba'i gsol 'debs lam rim dang 'brel ba mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i them skas ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /sras bcas rgyal ba kun gyi yum gcig pu// dpal ldan bla ma mkha' spyod dbang mo'i zhabs// snying nas dran pa'i gdung bas gsol 'debs na// byin rlabs char chen phob cig rnal 'byor ma// bdag cag deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar// rdo rje'i lus thob theg chen rig sad nas// mtshan ldan bla ma tshul bzhin bsten nus pa'i// skal pa bzang por sbyor cig rnal 'byor ma// khams gsum 'khor ba sdug bsngal phung por rig /dal 'byor rnyed dka' nam 'chi nges med dran// las 'bras blang dor brtson sogs thun mong gi /lam rim rgyud la skyes cig rnal 'byor ma// khyad par rnam dag dbang dang byin rlabs kyis// rgyud smin dam tshig sdom par ldan pa las// smin grol lam bzang 'jug cing bsgom rung ba'i// zab mo'i rten 'brel bsgrigs shig rnal 'byor ma// de tshe dben zhing bsam gtan 'phel ba'i sar// nang gi rnal 'byor rtse gcig gzhol ba na// phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing*// mthun rkyen rgyas par mdzod cig rnal 'byor ma// nyal dus 'od gsal ngang du mnyam gzhag cing*// ldang tshe zung 'jug sgyu ma'i skur gsal bas// dga' ba gsum ldan bdud rtsi myang ba'i mthus// sgo gsum dag par mdzod cig rnal 'byor ma// bla ma mchog gsum skyabs kyi snying por bzung*// byams dang snying rje byang sems gting nas 'byong*// stobs bzhi tshang ba'i rdor sems bsgom bzlas kyis// sdig ltung byang bar mdzod cig rnal 'byor ma// dngos grub 'byung gnas khyab bdag rdo rje chos// dad pas bsgom zhing mchod cing gsol btab mthus// byin rlabs bdud rtsis dbang bzhi'i ye shes kyi// pad+mo lhag par rgyas mdzod rnal 'byor ma// bdag gzhan sbyangs shing bsgyur ba'i bskyed rim gyis// lhar snang gcig tu shar ba'i dam tshig par// ye shes pho nya gsum gyi byin rlabs rgyun// 'jug cing brtan par mdzod cig rnal 'byor ma// nga rgyal rnam pa'i sems 'dzin la brten nas// rim par dang po'i gsal snang mthar phyin cing*// ngag dang yid kyi bzlas pas mkha' spyod kyi// dngos grub 'grub par mdzod cig rnal 'byor ma// phyi nang khams gsum bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// 'od gsal ngang du thim pa'i skad cig la// lha sngags chos skur 'char ba'i spyod lam gyis// tshogs gnyis rdzogs par mdzod cig rnal 'byor ma// rtsa rlung thig le smin cing sbyang ba'i phyir// gtum mo'i me lces dbu ma'i sgo dbye zhing*// rlung gi sbyor bas lus sems sim pa las// bde stong ye shes 'grub mdzod rnal 'byor ma// de ltar bsgom bzlas bsgrub la brtson pa'i mthus// grub pa'i dbang po ku sā li pa bzhin// mngon sum lag pa'i mkhrig ma nas bzung nas// mkha' spyod grong du 'khrid cig rnal 'byor ma// der ni zhing skyes pho nya'i tshogs rnams kyis// rdo rje'i nyams 'gyur rdzogs pa'i yan lag gis// kun tu 'khyud cing tsum+ba sngon 'gro bas// snyoms 'jug bde chen bskyed mdzod rnal 'byor ma// de tshe bde bas drangs pa'i stong pa nyid// mthong ba'i lam gyi 'od gsal mngon gyur nas// slob dang mi slob kha sbyor bdun ldan gyi// zung 'jug thob par mdzod cig rnal 'byor ma// gal te tshe 'dir brtan pa ma thob na// 'chi tshe mgon dang dpa' bo ma tshogs kyis// yid 'phrog mchod pa'i sprin gyi mdun bsus te// dag pa'i zhing du drongs shig rnal 'byor ma// der yang 'khrul nas bar dor 'khyams srid na// bla ma mchog dang rdo rje btsun mo yis// ming nas lung ston dga' ba rnam gsum gyi// dbugs dbyung lhag par stsol cig rnal 'byor ma// mdor na skye zhing skye ba thams cad du// dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor mas// 'bral ba med par rtag tu rjes bzung zhing*// phan bde'i dge mtshan rgyas pa'i bkra shis stsol// ces pa'ang 'di phyi'i 'dun ma bla ma dang mchog gsum gyi bka' drin kho na la re ba rgyal khams kyi bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos/

khyab bdag 'khor lo sdom pa'i pho brang drang srong srin po rir dpal 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum gyi snang brnyan ye shes pa mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar ji ltar gsol ba btab pa bzhin/ slad nas kyang yang yang gsol ba btab pa'i dge bas bdag dang 'gro kun bla ma rje btsun mas dus rtag tu rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba dā shre yo bha ba tu// ༈ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga bsod nams sprin gyi rol mo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ rgyal kun yum gyur rdo rje btsun mo dang*// dbyer med dpal ldan bla mar gus btud nas// gang de mchod pa'i thabs tshul rmad byung ba// bsod nams sprin gyi rol mo 'dir 'khrol lo// de yang 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dang*/ rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs kyis rgyud smin cing dam tshig la gnas pa'i gang zag gis dpal ldan bla ma rigs thams cad kyi bdag por bltas nas tshogs gnyis rlabs po che myur du 'dums par 'dod pas mchod pa'i cho ga 'di brtsams par bya ste/ de la'ang sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ gnas dben zhing yid dang mthun par dkon mchog gi rten spyi dang*/ khyad par rtsa brgyud bla ma'i snang brnyan bris 'bur ji ltar rigs pa'i mdun/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod sogs ci 'byor pa'i bye brag gtsang zhing bkod pas mdzes pa phyag len ltar bshams/ rang gi mdun du gos zung*/ maṇ+ḍal dri bzang gi chu dang bcas pa/ me tog gi snod/ nang mchod/ rdor dril sogs rol ma'i bye brag ji ltar rigs pas mtshon dgos pa'i yo byad rnams 'du bya/ rang nyid stan bde ba la 'khod nas nges 'byung dang byang chub sems gnyis kyi blo khyad par can gyi ngang*/ gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇā pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ a na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra rā dza huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ rta bab bzhis mdzes pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams bzang zhing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa sa dang bar snang nam mkha' gang ba/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dpral bar bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ zhes pas mang por spel/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li te/ pradz+nyā pa ra mi ta/ nā da saṃ bha we ta/ badz+ra dharmā hṛ da ya ni/ san+to ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho ā khaṃ swā hā/ lan gsum gyis byin dbab/ skyabs yul gsal btab la/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/

chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes skyabs 'gro ci nus kyi mthar/ thal mo sbyar la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom pa rnams bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i cho ga la drug las/ dang po tshogs zhing bskyed pa ni/ rang sems lhan skyes ye shes gcig pu'i 'phrul// srid zhi'i nyams 'gyur du mar 'char ba las// ma dag snang ba rten dang brten par bcas// brjod bral bde chen dbyings su thim pa'i rtsal// phyi snod mkha' spyod rdo rje btsun mo'i zhing*// me tog char 'bebs rol mo sna tshogs sgrogs// rnam bkra'i 'ja' 'od 'khrigs pa'i bar bar na// ngo mtshar mchod sprin rgya mtshos rab mdzes pa'i// mdun gyi nam mkhar yid 'phrog rin chen khrir// mi 'jigs seṅge brgyad kyis btegs pa'i steng*// sna tshogs chu skyes nyi zla'i gdan gyi dbus// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// mtha' klas dkyil 'khor spro dang bsdu ba'i bdag /smin grol lam gyi ston pa rdo rje 'chang*// bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma ni// tshur mthong mos ngor dpa' bo rdo rje chos// sku mdog pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po la// nyin byed bye bas 'khyud pa'i gzi 'bar zhing*// brgyad gnyis lang tshor mtshan dper mtshar sdug rdzogs// phyag g.yas bde stong sgra sgrogs ḍā ma ru// gcig shos bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa dang*// g.yon pa'i gru mor rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams// phyin drug rnam dag rus pa'i phyag rgyas mdzes// zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis rol// mtha' bskor rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha// mchog gsum chos srung nor lha'i tshogs bcas rnams// bdag la dgyes shing 'dzum pas bzhugs pa yi// so so'i thugs las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis// ye shes spyan drangs gnyis su med par gyur// zhes pas gsal btab/

gnyis pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ rgyas par brgyud pa'i phyag 'tshal logs nas 'byung ba ltar bya zhing*/ bsdu na/ gang gi drin gyis lhan skyes bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba'i bka' drin can// rje btsun bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad+mor phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i rigs bdag rdo rje chos// mkha' spyod dbang mo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// grub pa'i sar bzhugs paṇa chen nā ro pa// pham mthing sku mched rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zab yangs chos kyi gter gyur shes rab brtsegs// gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag mal lo'i zhabs// rdo rje 'chang dngos bla chen sa skya pa// rje btsun sku mched rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gnas lnga rig pa sa skya paṇa chen dang*// 'dzam gling bstan pa'i mnga' bdag 'phags pa'i zhabs// rim gnyis thugs gzhol dkon mchog dpal ba dang*// brag phug chos rje rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba'i mgon po bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhabs// gdams pa rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag dpal ldan pa// shar chen ye rgyal ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*// kun dga' bzang po rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba gnyis pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang*// kun mkhyen mkhas pa'i dbang po seṅge'i mtshan// sa bcu'i dbang phyug sangs rgyas rin chen dang*// sa skya lo tsā rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// shes bya kun mkhyen dkon mchog lhun grub dang*// paṇa chen mkhas pa'i dbang po nam mkha'i mtshan// 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos kun dga' bsod nams dang*// dpal mchog rgyal mtshan rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// mkhas shing grub brnyes sangs rgyas phun tshogs dang*// rdo rje 'chang dbang bsod nams dpal ldan zhabs// bstan pa'i nyi ma nam mkha' bsam 'grub dang*// kun dga' blo gros rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rigs kun khyab bdag nam mkha' 'chi med dang*// skyabs gnas kun 'dus rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang*// bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs// dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gsum pa mchod pa la brgyad las/

dang po nyer spyod kyi mchod pa ni/ stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na// lha rdzas mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams// dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang la 'bul// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du mchod yon gyi tshab tu/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dang*/ sngags kyi ar+ghaṃ tshab tu/ pā d+yaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar rnams sbyar// gnyis pa gos zung gi mchod pa ni/ gos zung*/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las lha rdzas las grub na bza' srab la 'jam pa yangs ba zung du sbyar ba dang ldan par bsams la/ kha dog 'jam zhing dri zhim reg na bde// srab 'jam yangs mdzes lha las byung ba yi// na bza'i mchog 'di rdo rje'i sku la 'bul// bgres pa med pa rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra wa sa s+ya āḥhūm̐/ gsum pa rig ma bcu drug gi mchod pa ni/ rang gi snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa spros nas mchod par bsams la/ dbang sngon mdog mtshungs rdo rje pi waṃ ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dpal ldan bla ma pi waṃ sgra yis mchod// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra wī ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gser bzang mdog mtshungs rdo rje gling bu ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dpal ldan bla ma gling bu'i sgra yis mchod// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra waṃ se huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pad+ma rā ga'i mdog mtshungs rdza rnga ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dpal ldan bla ma rdza rnga'i sgra yis mchod// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra mṛ taṃ ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/

ma rgad mdog mtshungs rdo rje rnga zlum ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dpal ldan bla ma rnga zlum sgra yis mchod// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra mu rdzi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ li khri'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje bzhad pa ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyi rab sprul nas// dpal ldan bla ma bzhad pa'i bde bas mchod// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra hā s+ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nam mkha'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje sgeg mo ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dpal ldan bla ma sgeg mdzes bde bas mchod// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra lā s+ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gur gum mdog mtshungs rdo rje glu len ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dpal ldan bla ma snyan pa'i glu yis mchod// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra gī tī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pri yang ku mtshungs rdo rje gar mkhan ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dpal ldan bla ma mdzes ma'i gar gyis mchod// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra nṛ t+ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zla ba'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje me tog ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dpal ldan bla ma me tog sil mas mchod// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ in+d+ra ni li'i mdog mtshungs bdug spos ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dpal ldan bla ma bdug spos sprin gyis mchod// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra dhūp+pe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/

nyi ma'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje mar me ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dpal ldan bla ma mar me'i phreng bas mchod// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra dī pe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sin+dhū'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje dri chab ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dpal ldan bla ma dri bzang byugs pas mchod// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ chu shel mdog mtshungs gzugs kyi rdo rje ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dpal ldan bla ma gzugs kyi bde bas mchod// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ rū pa badz+rī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ btsod kyi mdog mtshungs ro yi rdo rje ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dpal ldan bla ma ro yi bde bas mchod// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ rā sa badz+rī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sna tshogs mdog mtshungs reg bya rdo rje ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dpal ldan bla ma reg bya'i bde bas mchod// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ spar+she badz+rī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ston zla'i mdog mtshungs chos dbyings rdo rje ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dpal ldan bla ma chos khams bde bas mchod// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ dharma dhā tu badz+rī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bzhi pa rin chen sna bdun gyi mchod pa ni/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ a warta ya a warta ya hoḥ

bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas la// 'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas// srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad de// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra tsakra rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas la// nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas// bkren cing phongs pa rgyun bcad de// 'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog /oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra ma ṇi rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ btsun mo rin chen 'di phul bas// ma rig mun pa rgyun bcad de// shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs nas// thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra wasti rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ blon po rin chen 'di phul bas// phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan// bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing*// yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra mahā ta rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ glang po rin chen 'di phul bas// lta ngan rnams ni rab bsal nas// bla med theg pa rab bzhon te// thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra hasti rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ rta mchog rin chen 'di phul bas// srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol nas// rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob ste// sangs rgyas zhing du bgrod par shog /oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra a shwa rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ dmag dpon rin chen 'di phul bas// nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas// phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de// bsnyengs bral mchog ni thob par shog /oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra khad+ga rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ lnga pa 'dod yon gyis mchod pa ni/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis rnams// mos blos bla ma mchog la bdag 'bul gyi// bzhes shing bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra rū pa kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te hūm̐/

phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i// yon tan tshig mchog sgra snyan ci mchis rnams// mos blos bla ma mchog la bdag 'bul gyi// bzhes shing bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra shab+da kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te hūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na tsan+dan sbrul snying dang*// a gar nag sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams// mos blos bla ma mchog la bdag 'bul gyi// bzhes shing bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra gan+dhe kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te hūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i// lus sems brtas byed ro mchog ci mchis rnams// mos blos bla ma mchog la bdag 'bul gyi// bzhes shing bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra sa kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te hūm̐?/ phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i// reg bya'i khyad par lus sems tshim byed rnams// mos blos bla ma mchog la bdag 'bul gyi// bzhes shing bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra spar+she kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te hūm̐/ drug pa maṇ+ḍal gyi mchod pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badz+ra re ṣe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su hūm̐/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lha 'dzam bu gling*/ nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ lus dang lus 'phags/ rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/ g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro/ sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla/ rin po che'i ri bo/ dpag bsam gyi shing*/ 'dod 'jo'i ba/ ma rmos pa'i log thog 'khor lo rin po che/ nor bu rin po che/ btsun mo rin po che/ blon po rin po che/ glang po rin po che/ rta mchog rin po che/

dmag dpon rin po che/ gter chen po'i bum pa/ sgeg pa ma/ phreng ba ma/ glu ma/ gar ma/ bdug spos ma/ me tog ma/ mar me ma/ dri chab ma/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ rin po che'i gdugs/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid drin chen rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma/ gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas bdag gi rgyud la bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rim pa gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sku gnyis kyi go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma rin po che// drin can chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// mnyam med bka' drin can gyi thugs rjes gzigs// 'di phyi bar do kun tu byin gyis rlobs// 'dren pa kun 'dus bla ma rin po che// drin can chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// mnyam med bka' drin can gyi thugs rjes gzigs// 'di phyi bar do kun tu byin gyis rlobs// yi dam kun 'dus bla ma rin po che// drin can chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// mnyam med bka' drin can gyi thugs rjes gzigs// 'di phyi bar do kun tu byin gyis rlobs// sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma rin po che// drin can chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// mnyam med bka' drin can gyi thugs rjes gzigs// 'di phyi bar do kun tu byin gyis rlobs// dam chos kun 'dus bla ma rin po che// drin can chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// mnyam med bka' drin can gyis thugs rjes gzigs// 'di phyi bar do kun tu byin gyis rlobs// dge 'dun kun 'dus bla ma rin po che// drin can chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// mnyam med bka' drin can gyi thugs rjes gzigs// 'di phyi bar do kun tu byin gyis rlobs// byang sems kun 'dus bla ma rin po che// drin can chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// mnyam med bka' drin can gyi thugs rjes gzigs// 'di phyi bar do kun tu byin gyis rlobs// nyan rang kun 'dus bla ma rin po che// drin can chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// mnyam med bka' drin can gyi thugs rjes gzigs// 'di phyi bar do kun tu byin gyis rlobs// chos skyong kun 'dus bla ma rin po che// drin can chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// mnyam med bka' drin can gyi thugs rjes gzigs// 'di phyi bar do kun tu byin gyis rlobs// nor lha kun 'dus bla ma rin po che// drin can chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// mnyam med bka' drin can gyi thugs rjes gzigs// 'di phyi bar do kun tu byin gyis rlobs// de nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i gsol 'debs brgya rtsa sogs ci nus dang*/

maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma brgya rtsa dang*/ so bdun ma gsol gdab bcas spel mar ci nus phul ba'i mthar/ gang gi mchod rdzas zhing khams rgya mtsho rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin phung gis// rnam par brgyan pa'i rgyan gyi 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba'i 'od kyi rtse mor rgya mtsho yi// rdul gyi grangs snyed rin chen pad+mo rin chen 'od 'byin kun nas rgyas pa'i snying po la// lha dang mi yi 'dod yon rmad 'di 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byung bye ba phrag brgyar legs gnas pa// kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul ji bzhin kun nas dge ba'i sems kyis sprul pa'i mchod sprin 'di// chos dbyings ji bzhin nam mkha'i khams kun kun la khyab cing sems can dbyings mtha' ji srid bar// rnam par gnas nas chos kyi rgyal po rgyal ba rgyal sras rang rgyal dgra las rnam rgyal bas// kun nas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor kun tu rnam par mchod pa'i mchod pa kun gyis mnyes gyur cig /deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar// bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*// dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po rnams// sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir// gus pas khyed la 'bul bar bgyi// kun nas gzigs pa'i spyan ldan pa'i// yon gnas dam pa khyed rnams kyis// bdag la brtse bar nyer dgongs te// bdag gi 'di dag bzhes su gsol// bzhes nas byin gyis brlabatu gsol// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra rat+na maṇ+ḍa la pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ bdun pa nang mchod ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bar ma dbugs dbyung mchog dag dang*// dri yi chu dang dag pa yi// zag med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho ches// he ru ka dpal bla ma mchod// oṃ sarba badz+ra ka mi ni/ sarba bhak+ṣa sho dhā ya/ gu h+ya badz+ri ṇī hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ spro na/ rdo rje 'chang chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// grub chen nā ro ta pa pham mthing pa// shes rab brtsegs dang mal gyo sa skya pa// rje btsun sku mched zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// sa skya paṇa chen 'phags pa rin po che// dkon mchog dpal dang chos rje bsod nams dpal// bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal ldan tshul khrims dang*// ye shes rgyal mtshan zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// kun dga' bzang po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan zhabs// gzhan yang dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs kyi sras// seṅge rgyal mtshan rgyal ba mchog dbyangs dang*// nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// brgyud srol kun 'dus bdag chen rdo rje 'chang*// kun spang chos rje tshar chen mkhyen brtse'i dbang*// bslab gsum rgyal mtshan dbang phyug rab brtan dpal// bsod nams mchog ldan zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// bsod nams mchog grub mkhyen rab byams pa'i dpal// rmor chen rje dang khyab bdag gnas gsar ba// kun dga' blo gros nam mkha' 'chi med dang*// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// gzhan yang rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha// sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma// rdo rje'i chos srung nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas// mchod 'os rgya mtsho'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

zhes 'bul/ brgyad pa yid byung gi mchod pa ni/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dpral bar bcas te/ na mo/ chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje rnam par dag pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthu dang*/ bdag gi mos pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ smon lam gyi dbang gis 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed yod pa dang*/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig ces brjod la se gol brdab/ yang phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā warta ya ā warta ya hoḥ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ a bhi sma ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ dharma dhā tu ā kā sha sa man+ta māṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta a pa ri sho dha ye/ maṇ+ḍa la ma ma pra ṇi dhi/ puṇ+ya dz+nyā na ba le na sarba ta thā ga ta ba len+dha/ ban+du swaḥs+tha na ba le na tsa ya swā hā/ zhes brjod de se gol brdab/ yang phyag rgya bcas te se gol brdab pa'i mthar rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas/ lha mi'i longs spyod phun tshogs thams cad dang*// kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin chen po dang*// gsang dang rab gsang gsang chen bla med kyi// mchod pa'i sprin chen rgya mtsho dag gis mchod// ces brjod la ci nus pa'i mchod pa dbul bar bya'o// bzhi pa sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag lhag ma rnams bya ba ni/ bdag gi lus dang ngag dang yid kyis kyang*// chags dang zhe sdang rnam par rmongs sems kyis// srid pa nyam ngar sdig pa ci bgyis pa// de rnams bsdams te thams cad so sor bshags// rdzogs sangs rgyas mgon byang chub sems dpa' dang*// 'phags pa gzhan gyi dge ba gang bgyis pa// de yang bla med byang chub 'bras thob bar// ma lus pa la rtag tu rjes yi rang*// rdzogs sangs rin chen rang gi sems gnas dang*// rtog pa'i drwa ba rab dral dam pa'i chos// sa dbang tshogs dang brtul zhugs dbang dge 'dun// rab tu dad pas rtag tu skyabs su mchi// rgyal dang bdag nyid legs skyob de dag la// kun nas kun tu bdag gis lus 'di 'bul// sems dpa' mchog gis bdag nyid yongs bzhes shig

/dad pas khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi bar bgyi// glo bur nyon mongs tshad pas gdung ba yi// skyob pa skye bo mtha' dag grol ba'i phyir// dam chos bdud rtsi'i chos rnams bshad pa ru// sman mchog mgon po la ni bdag bskul lo// mchog tu mi dge la sogs rab bcom pa'i// bdud rtsi skye rga na dang 'chi ba las// mya ngan 'da' bzhed gyur pa spang bar ni// sman mchog mgon po la ni bdag gsol 'debs// lus ngag yid kyis bsod nams ni// bgyis sam bgyid du stsal ba 'am// rjes su yi rang gang ci'ang rung*// des ni 'jig rten kun mkhyen shog /sam̐ngs rgyas 'jig rten gang byung la// skalam̐ ldan byang chub sems dpa' yis// byang chub tu ni sems bskyed ltar// de ring nyid du sems bskyed do// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// de bzhin brtan por bzung bar bgyi// ji ltar phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yis// sngon gyi bde gshegs grangs med la// thugs bskyed dam tshig dpag med dag /'tshang rgya'i bar mi btang ba ltar// bdag ni deng nas byang chub bar// lus srog ltos pa med par yang*// bslab 'di mig bzhin bsrung la gnas// ye shes thugs kyis dgongs su gsol// rnam dag ye shes lngar gyur lnga// rtag tu bsten cing spyad par bgyi// rgyal ba rigs lnga'i brtul zhugs dag /srog gi phyir yang mi gtong ngo*// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje dag /rtag tu mi phyed brtul zhugs bzung*// rgyal bas dgongs te gsungs pa yi// dam tshig bzhi po srung bar bgyi// rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu gcig sogs// rigs sngags 'chang kun mi 'da' ltar// deng nas bla med byang chub bar// bdag gis tshul bzhin bsrung bar bgyi// nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum bzla// zla re bcu phrag gnyis pa dang*// bco lnga la ni rab tu mchod// theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya// 'khor ba dag kyang mi spang zhing*// mya ngan 'das pa dgar mi 'gro// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma kun la// gus pas bsnyen bkur mchod par bya// bdag gis sems can thams cad la// brnyas pa nyid du mi bya 'o// phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang*// mtshan ma 'goms par mi bya'o// zhes dam bcas pa la brten nas lnga pa gnang ba nod pa ni/

bla ma la sogs pa'i tshogs zhing rnams thugs dgyes pa chen pos zhal 'dzum mdangs su bzhad cing*/ rigs kyi bu khyod gnas pa 'di la gnas na legs pa yin gyi/ gnas pa 'dis gnas na mchog gi dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur ro// zhes gsung gis dngos su gnang ba byin par bsam/ drug pa smon lam gdab pa ni/ de ltar bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la brten nas smon pa'i gnas 'di dag myur du 'grub par gyur cig snyam du bsam pa rtse gcig pas/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus gdan gsum tshang ba'i sku// nyon mongs gdung sel chos sgra sgrogs pa'i gsung*// ye shes lnga ldan bde gsal mi rtog thugs// dpal ldan bla ma dran cing gsol ba 'debs// mtha' yas rgyal ba'i bde stong zlos gar ni// sogs mkha' spyod zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam gdab/ gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga la drug las/ dang po 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ gong ltar mchod pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon sogs nas/ rol mo rnams dwangs zhing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis byin brlabs/ oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā zhes sogs chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ thal mo sbyar bas/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ chos kyi rje/ chos kyi rgyal po/ chos kyi dbang phyug chos dam pa'i 'byaur pa thams cad kyis phun sum tshogs shing 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i dpal dam par gyur pa bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mo dri ma med pa la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

bdag gi sngon gyi las las gyur pa dang*/ gnas skabs kyi rkyen las gyur pa'i mi dang mi ma yin pa dang*/ 'byung po'i gnod pa dang*/ nye bar 'tshe ba dang*/ byur dang skal ba ngan pa dang*/ phyi dang nang gi bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ tshe dang dpal dang 'byor pa dang dbangaphyug phun sum tshogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad dang mtshan ma'i rnam par g.yeng ba la sogs pa srid par 'khor bar 'gyur ba'i rnam par rtog pa dang*/ gzhan gyi don la skyo ba dang*/ rang nyid zhi bar 'dun pa la sogs pa mya ngan las 'da' bar gyur pa'i rnam par rtog pa gang lags pa thams cad mi 'byung bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gi sems las su rung ba dang*/ bag yod pa dang*/ dran pa dang*/ shes bzhin yang dag pa dang ldan par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gi tshul khrims kyi phung po dang*/ dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs rnam par dag cing*/ sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang*/ ltung ba dang*/ nyes pa'i dri mas ma gos par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dad pa dang snying rje dang shes rab phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan zhing byang chub kyi sems gnyis zung du chud nas lung dang mngon par rtogs pas bsdus pa'i chos kyi snang ba dam pa dang rtogs pa dge bar khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gang gi tshe bdag 'chi bar gyur pa de'i tshe tshe 'di dang 'jig rten 'di la mngon par zhen pa dang bral zhing*/ lus dang sems la zug rngu dang sdug bsngal cung zad tsam yang mi 'byung bar dga' ba dang spro ba dang yid gsal ba mchog dang ldan zhing*/ ting nge 'dzin dam pa rgyud la skyes nas/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs yang dag par mthong zhing*/ de dag gi rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pas mdun bsus te/ bar do'i 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral zhing*/

bdud dang gshin rje'i spyod yul thams cad las shin tu 'das nas rig pa 'dzin pa dang mkha' la spyod pa la sogs pa'i go 'phang mchog tu skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ skye ba dang srid pa thams cad du 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rgud pa thams cad dang bral zhing srid pa dang*/ zhi ba'i 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa thob ste/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung rab rgya mtsho'i tshogs yang dag par bzung nas/ chos kyi phongs pa'i sems can thams cad la chos kyi sbyin pa rgya chen po gtong zhing*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa dang*/ sems can yongs su smin par byas nas/ dngos po thams cad kyis bla ma dam pa mnyes par byas te sa dang lam thams cad bde blag tu bgrod nas/ sku bzhi ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang myur du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes mos gus shugs drag pos gsol ba gdab/ gnyis pa tshogs zhing bsdu ba ni/ de ltar gus pas mchod cing gsol btab mthus// mchod yul mgron rnams mtha' nas rim pa bzhin// 'od du zhu ste rtsa ba'i bla mar thim// de yang rang gi tshangs pa'i bu ga nas// zhugs te snying dbus pad dkar bzhad pa'i rtser// bde stong nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i dbus// dgyes pa chen po'i ngo bor rtag bzhugs nas// dbang dang dngos grub thams cad stsol bar gyur// zhes brjod cing bsam la/ dad mos rtse gcig pa'i ngang nas/ bla ma'i mtshan dpe'i snang cha gsal lam me ba la sems zhugs pa bzhin cher gyis gtad de cung zad mnyam par bzhag go /gsum pa thun las ldang ba ni/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che// bdag gi snying gar pad+ma'i gdan bzhugs nas// bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// thos pa rgya mtsho'i mchod yon kun nas 'khyil// yon tan me tog tshul khrims bdug spos sprin// shes rab sgron me dad pa spos chu'i mtsho// ting 'dzin bdud rtsi'i zhal zas dam pa dang*// bstod dbyangs snyan pa'i sil snyan sgra 'byin cing*// kun nas snying brtse rnam dpyod spobs pa yi// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan bsgreng ba yis// bdag lus gzhal med khang brtsegs rab brgyan nas// snying ga'i chu skyes thig le zla rgyas la// brtan par bzhugs pa'i chos rje mchod bgyid cing*// nges par 'dun pa'i yid kyis gsol btab nas// 'gro ba'i bla ma rtag tu mnyes gyur cig

/bzhi pa dge ba bsngo ba ni/ 'jam dpal dpa' bos ji ltar mkhyen pa dang*// kun tu bzang po de yang de bzhin te// de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag slob cing*// dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo// dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis// bsngo ba gang la mchog tu bsngags pa des// bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di kun kyang*// bzang por spyod phyir rab tu bsngo bar bgyi// lnga pa smon lam gdab pa ni/ skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang*// 'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod de// sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas// rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog /skye zhing skye ba dag ni thams cad du// rigs bzang blo gsal nga rgyal med pa dang*// snying rje che zhing bla ma la gus nas// dpal ldan bla ma'i dam tshig la gnas shog /bdag sogs gdul byar gyur pa thams cad kyang*// las 'bras lhur len gsung rab don la mkhas// tshul khrims dag cing thos la mngon brtson te// thub bstan phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzad du gsol// drug pa shis pa brjod pa ni/ spro na rnal 'byor ma'i bla ma brgyud pa'i bkra shis logs nas 'byung ba ltar ram/ de tsam mi nus na/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo dbang gi rgyal po ltar zhes sogs shis pa brjod pa ji ltar rigs pas mtha' brgyan cing me tog gi char sil mar dgram par bya'o// ༈ /gal te rnal 'byor ma'i 'khrid rim zab mos rgyud smin pa'i gang zag gis bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong ma yin pa la brten nas bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga nyams su blangs par 'dod na/ sbyor ba sngar bzhin dang*/ dngos gzhi la/ dang po tshogs zhing gsal gdab pa ni/ phun tshogs srid zhi'i dngos po mtha' dag rang sems lhan cig skyes pa yi// ye shes chen po'i rnam 'phrul las byung brjod bral mkha' dbyings dag pa'i klong*// phul byung sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin phung du mas mngon par mdzes pa'i dbus// mi 'jigs seṅge brgyad kyis rab btegs nor bu'i khri 'phang mthon po'i rtser// pad dkar 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i lte bar zla shel gsar pa'i gdan steng du// dus gsum rgyal kun 'dus pa'i ngo bor rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje chos// pad+ma rā ga'i rdul mang brtsegs par nyin byed bye bas 'khyud pa yi// brgyad gnyis lang tsho'i mtshan dpe'i mtshar sdug bde stong nyams brgyas rab tu sgeg

/phyag gnyis thabs shes rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bsnol ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin// gnag snum mthon mthing ral pa'i cod pan yid 'phrog nor bu'i zur phud can// dar dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis rab mdzes zhabs zung rdo rje'i skyil krung gis// 'od dang 'od zer du ma 'phro bzhin bdag la dges pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs// de mthar mdun gyi cha nas brtsams te sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen sogs// tshad med mkhyen dang brtse ba'i bdag nyid brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad kyang*// dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pas mngon sum lta bur bskor ba rnams// mkha' dbyings mdzes mar dbang po'i gzhu bzhin snang stong zung 'jug chen po'i skur// yongs shar gnas gsum yi ges mtshan las 'od zer dpag yas rab 'phros pas// brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam lha tshogs rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems// nyan thos rang rgyal dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma nor lhar bcas// skyabs gnas dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs gnyis su med par gyur// zhes gsal btab/ gnyis pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ gang gi drin gyis lhan skyes bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba'i bka' drin can// rje btsun bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad+mor phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i rigs bdag rdo rje 'chang*// rgyal ba'i yum mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// rgyal sras thu bo nā ro ta pa'i zhabs// gus pas phyag 'tshal brtse bas byin gyis rlobs// gsang chen slob bshad 'dzin pa'i pham mthing pa// gsang mdzod kun gyi gter gyur shes rab brtsegs// gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag mal lo'i zhabs// gus pas phyag 'tshal brtse bas byin gyis rlobs// rdo rje 'chang chen bla chen sa skya pa// rdo rje'i sras mchog rje btsun bsod nams rtse// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtsug rgyan grags pa'i zhabs// gus pas phyag 'tshal brtse bas byin gyis rlobs// sa skya paṇa chen gangs can mkhas pa'i rje// sa gsum skye rgu'i gtsug rgyan 'phags pa'i mchog

/sa skya'i bstan 'dzin zhang ston dkon mchog dpal// gus pas phyag 'tshal brtse bas byin gyis rlobs// grub pa'i dbang po na bza' brag phug pa// grub mchog mkhas pa'i ded dpon chos kyi rje// grub rigs snyan brgyud mnga' bdag yar klung par// gus pas phyag 'tshal brtse bas byin gyis rlobs// bdag gzhan 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon rgyal ba mchog /bdag nyid chen po 'jam dbyangs nam mkha'i mtshan// bdag chen chos rje blo gros rgyal mtshan zhabs// gus pas phyag 'tshal brtse bas byin gyis rlobs// bka' drin mnyam med rje btsun rdo ring pa// bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i bstan 'dzin blo gsal dbang*// bka' brgyud gsang chen smra ba mkhyen brtse'i zhabs// gus pas phyag 'tshal brtse bas byin gyis rlobs// rig sngags 'chang ba bslab gsum rgyal mtshan dang*// rigs brgya'i khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan dpal// rig grol mthar phyin rje btsun bka' 'gyur bar// gus pas phyag 'tshal brtse bas byin gyis rlobs// dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag zhwa lu pa// dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso bo mkhyen rab rje// dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i bdag po rnam gnyis la// gus pas phyag 'tshal brtse bas byin gyis rlobs// snyan brgyud gdams pa'i gter mdzod rmor chen rje// snyan brgyud mnga' bdag kun dga' legs 'byung zhabs// snyan brgyud spel mkhas kun dga' blo gros la// gus pas phyag 'tshal brtse bas byin gyis rlobs// sa gsum skye rgu'i gnyen gcig thar rtse rje// sa bstan nyin mor byed pa'i nam mkha' legs// sa bcu'i dbang phyug bstan pa'i nyi ma la// gus pas phyag 'tshal brtse bas byin gyis rlobs// grub pa'i sar bzhugs ngag dbang rin chen dang*// grub pa mchog brnyes kun dga' bstan 'dzin zhabs// grub gnyis dpal ster 'jam dpal bzang po la// gus pas phyag 'tshal brtse bas byin gyis rlobs// rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag mchog

/dran pas srid zhi'i gdung ba sel mdzad pa// bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gus pas phyag 'tshal brtse bas byin gyis rlobs// zhes pas phyag 'tshal/ gsum pa mchod pa la/ nyer spyod/ gos zung*/ rig ma bcu drug rin chen bdun/ 'dod yon lnga/ maṇ+ḍal/ nang mchod rnams thun mong ltar byas pa'i mthar/ nang gi tshogs kyi mchod pa la/ thog mar zhen pa spang ba ni/ gang la chags na nyes kun 'byung ba'i gzhi// nyon mongs kyis bsags zas nor longs spyod kun// rje btsun bla ma mchog la dbul bar bgyi// rgyags dang ser sna zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// rang gi zhe sdang rang gzugs shar ba yi// gnod byed dgra 'drer snang ba ci mchis pa// rje btsun bla ma'i 'khor du dbul bar bgyi// zhe sdang dbyings su zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// ltar snang phan pas 'khor bar 'ching ba'i grogs// gnyen dang mdza' bshes 'khor g.yog la sogs pa// de kun bla ma mchog la dbul bar bgyi// 'dod chags rnam rtog zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// tshe rabs du mar grangs med mar byas kyang*// las nyon dbang gis gnyen ngo ma shes pa'i// bar ma'i 'gro rnams khyed la dbul bar bgyi// rmongs dang phrag dog zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// mchod pa dngos ni/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// dbu ma'i lam brgyud tshangs pa'i sgo nas thon// rtsa ba'i bla mar 'khyud cing tsum+ba yis// zag med bde chen mchod pas rab tu mnyes// slar yang rang gi phung po rnying pa la// gzigs pas che zhing tsho la snum mthong nas// sngon chad 'di 'dra'i lus kun don med song*// da lan don chen bya 'o snyam du dgongs// phung po'i rtsar byon phyag g.yas gri gug gis// tha mal lus su snang ba'i mgo bo yi// ya thod bcad de thod pa'i sgyed pu'i khar// bzhag pas phyi dkar nang dmar ka pā la// stong gsum dang mnyam snod du gyur pa'i nang*// rkang g.yon g.yas pa khog smad nang khrol dang*// khog stod lag gnyis mgo bo lhag mar bcas// rim par bskyur pas sha khrag phung por gyur// 'og nas ye shes me sbar thod pa'i rdzas// bkol zhing 'od du mer gyis zhu ba las// rnam mang 'dod pa'i yon tan 'phro ba'i sprin// zag med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor oṃ āḥhūm̐// sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma rin po che// bdag gis mngon par bshams pa'i mchod pa 'di// bdag la brtse ba'i thugs kyis legs dgongs la// dgyes pa chen pos bzhes par mdzad du gsol// rang lus lha skur gsal ba'i thugs ka nas// yid 'phrog mchod pa'i lha mo mang spros pas// phyag gi thod pas bdud rtsi legs blangs nas// mchod yul rnams la 'phul te mchod par gyur// drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin can// 'khor lo'i mgon po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// skyabs gnas kun 'dus zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// zhes rtsa ba'i bla ma la lan bdun phul/
